English: PRESS RELEASE: JUNE 29, 2020 The EU through its Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations department (ECHO) has donated KES 270 million (2,573,105 Million Euros) to WHO Kenya.
Kiswahili: TAARIFA KWA VYOMBO VYA HABARI: JUNI 29, 2020 EU kupitia idara yake ya Ulinzi wa Raia na Uendeshaji wa Misaada ya Kibinadamu (ECHO) imetoa KES milioni 270 (Euro milioni 2,573,105) kwa WHO Kenya.

English: This grant will be used by the WHO to support the Government of Kenya's efforts to control the spread of the pandemic.
Kiswahili: Ruzuku hii itatumiwa na WHO kuunga mkono juhudi za Serikali ya Kenya za kudhibiti kuenea kwa janga hili.

English: Specifically, WHO Kenya will boost the response effort by training frontline health workers at national and county levels and strengthen the current work being done by the COVID-19 rapid response and clinical teams across all counties.
Kiswahili: Hasa, WHO Kenya itaongeza juhudi za kukabiliana na janga hili kwa kuwafunza wafanyakazi wa afya walio mstari wa mbele katika ngazi za kitaifa na kaunti na kuimarisha kazi inayofanywa sasa na timu za mwitikio wa haraka wa COVID-19 na kliniki katika kaunti zote.

English: Caring for patients with high-consequence infectious diseases requires highly skilled teams operating in full personal protective equipment under strict infection prevention protocols.
Kiswahili: Kuwatunza wagonjwa wenye magonjwa ya kuambukiza yenye matokeo makubwa kunahitaji timu zenye ujuzi wa hali ya juu zinazofanya kazi katika vifaa kamili vya kinga binafsi chini ya itifaki kali za kuzuia maambukizi.

English: These conditions are physically demanding and technically complex, requiring sustained precision in environments where even routine care becomes high risk.
Kiswahili: Hali hizi zinahitajika kimwili na kitaalamu ni ngumu, zinahitaji usahihi endelevu katika mazingira ambapo hata utunzaji wa kawaida unakuwa hatari kubwa.

English: To address this gap, countries are strengthening the systems that underpin clinical care, from building multidisciplinary teams and improving intensive and supportive care practices, to reinforcing infection prevention and WASH standards and ensuring facilities are equipped to operate safely during outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Ili kushughulikia pengo hili, nchi zinaimarisha mifumo inayounga mkono huduma ya kliniki, kuanzia kujenga timu za taaluma mbalimbali na kuboresha mbinu za utunzaji makini na unaounga mkono, hadi kuimarisha viwango vya kuzuia maambukizi na WASH na kuhakikisha vifaa vina vifaa vya kufanya kazi kwa usalama wakati wa milipuko.

English: From 27 April to 1 May 2026, clinicians, infection prevention specialists and experts from across the East African Community convened in Nairobi for a training focused on these priorities.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia tarehe 27 Aprili hadi 1 Mei 2026, madaktari, wataalamu wa kuzuia maambukizi na wataalamu kutoka kote katika Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki walikutana jijini Nairobi kwa ajili ya mafunzo yaliyolenga vipaumbele hivi.

English: The programme focused on critical care, patient monitoring, safe use of personal protective equipment, and maintaining high-quality clinical operations under outbreak conditions.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo ililenga katika utunzaji muhimu, ufuatiliaji wa wagonjwa, matumizi salama ya vifaa vya kinga binafsi, na kudumisha shughuli za kliniki zenye ubora wa hali ya juu chini ya hali ya mlipuko.

English: World Health Organization supported this effort through technical guidance, coordination and the strengthening of regional networks, helping to ensure that clinical capacity continues to grow across countries and is sustained between outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani liliunga mkono juhudi hii kupitia mwongozo wa kiufundi, uratibu na uimarishaji wa mitandao ya kikanda, na kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba uwezo wa kliniki unaendelea kukua katika nchi mbalimbali na unaendelea kudumu kati ya milipuko.

English: The next phase is to ensure that every patient benefits from the same standard of high-quality care.
Kiswahili: Hatua inayofuata ni kuhakikisha kwamba kila mgonjwa anafaidika na kiwango sawa cha huduma bora.

English: So far, 256 suspected cases and 13 deaths have been reported, with a case fatality rate of 5.2%, exceeding the 1% threshold which indicates early and adequate treatment of cholera patients.
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa, visa 256 vinavyoshukiwa na vifo 13 vimeripotiwa, huku kiwango cha vifo kikiwa 5.2%, kikizidi kiwango cha 1% ambacho kinaonyesha matibabu ya mapema na ya kutosha kwa wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.

English: Press Statement: Kenyan Government, World Health Organization, Bloomberg Philanthropies launch new initiative to reduce road crash deaths Road traffic crashes are a top-five cause of death for Kenyans between the ages of five and 70, and the leading killer of boys aged 15-19.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kwa Vyombo vya Habari: Serikali ya Kenya, Shirika la Afya Duniani, Bloomberg Philanthropies yazindua mpango mpya wa kupunguza vifo vya ajali za barabarani Ajali za barabarani ni miongoni mwa sababu tano kuu za vifo kwa Wakenya wenye umri wa kati ya miaka mitano na 70, na ni miongoni mwa wauaji wakuu wa wavulana wenye umri wa kati ya miaka 15-19.

English: WHO Kenya works through three strategic clusters; (1) Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Control, (2) Health Emergencies, and (3) Health Systems and Services, to support the Government of Kenya in building resilient health systems and advancing toward UHC.
Kiswahili: WHO Kenya inafanya kazi kupitia makundi matatu ya kimkakati; (1) Kukuza Afya, Kuzuia na Kudhibiti Magonjwa, (2) Dharura za Afya, na (3) Mifumo na Huduma za Afya, ili kuisaidia Serikali ya Kenya katika kujenga mifumo imara ya afya na kusonga mbele kuelekea UHC.

English: A record 349 million people globally are facing acute food insecurity Meanwhile, tobacco is grown in over 124 countries, taking up 3.2 million hectares of fertile land that could be used to grow food, address food insecurity and nutrition challenges and help feed families.
Kiswahili: Watu milioni 349 waliorekodiwa duniani kote wanakabiliwa na uhaba mkubwa wa chakula Wakati huo huo, tumbaku inalimwa katika zaidi ya nchi 124, ikichukua hekta milioni 3.2 za ardhi yenye rutuba ambayo inaweza kutumika kulima chakula, kushughulikia changamoto za uhaba wa chakula na lishe na kusaidia kulisha familia.

English: Kenya launches 5-year health security plan to strengthen health emergency readiness Nairobi- Kenya has launched its Second National Action Plan for Health Security 2026–2030, marking a significant step toward strengthening the country's ability to prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats.
Kiswahili: Kenya yazindua mpango wa usalama wa afya wa miaka 5 ili kuimarisha utayari wa dharura wa afya Nairobi- Kenya imezindua Mpango wake wa Pili wa Kitaifa wa Utekelezaji wa Usalama wa Afya 2026–2030, ikiashiria hatua muhimu kuelekea kuimarisha uwezo wa nchi kuzuia, kugundua, na kukabiliana na vitisho vya afya ya umma.

English: "Today's event reflects Kenya's continued commitment to building a strong, resilient and coordinated system for preventing, detecting and responding to public health threats," said Dr Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Acting WHO representative to Kenya.
Kiswahili: "Tukio la leo linaonyesha kujitolea kwa Kenya kuendelea kujenga mfumo imara, imara na ulioratibiwa kwa ajili ya kuzuia, kugundua na kukabiliana na vitisho vya afya ya umma," alisema Dkt. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Kaimu mwakilishi wa WHO nchini Kenya.

English: "But if we do not put commensurate resources behind this plan, it just becomes a document on the shelf.
Kiswahili: "Lakini tusipoweka rasilimali zinazolingana nyuma ya mpango huu, unakuwa hati tu kwenye rafu."

English: Since 1 October 2025, over 231 cases and 13 deaths were reported across three counties, including Narok, one of the hardest hit.
Kiswahili: Tangu tarehe 1 Oktoba 2025, zaidi ya visa 231 na vifo 13 viliripotiwa katika kaunti tatu, ikiwa ni pamoja na Narok, mojawapo ya zilizoathiriwa zaidi.

English: Hosted by WHS and Aga Khan University and held in partnership with WHO, the Ministry of Health in Kenya and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, the meeting will bring together over 1000 delegates from around 50 countries, participating in 80 sessions focused on strengthening health systems resilience, advancing universal health coverage and accelerating innovation in global health.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo, ulioandaliwa na WHS na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan na kufanyika kwa ushirikiano na WHO, Wizara ya Afya nchini Kenya na Vituo vya Afrika vya Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Magonjwa, utawaleta pamoja zaidi ya wajumbe 1000 kutoka nchi takriban 50, wakishiriki katika vikao 80 vinavyolenga kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa mifumo ya afya, kuendeleza huduma za afya kwa wote na kuharakisha uvumbuzi katika afya ya kimataifa.

English: WHO has been actively engaged in the development of 80% of the meeting sessions, helping shape an agenda which focuses on strengthening health systems resilience, advancing universal health coverage and accelerating practical solutions to emerging health challenges.
Kiswahili: WHO imekuwa ikishiriki kikamilifu katika uundaji wa 80% ya vikao vya mikutano, ikisaidia kuunda ajenda inayolenga kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa mifumo ya afya, kuendeleza huduma za afya kwa wote na kuharakisha suluhisho za vitendo kwa changamoto zinazoibuka za kiafya.

English: In 2025 alone, more than 2000 consignments of medical supplies and equipment were shipped from the hub's warehouse to around 20 countries in the region.
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwaka wa 2025 pekee, zaidi ya shehena 2000 za vifaa vya matibabu na vifaa vilisafirishwa kutoka ghala la kituo hicho hadi karibu nchi 20 katika eneo hilo.

English: "The visual impact of what we have seen here is something we should make public, to bring the importance of countries working together, and with WHO, using cutting-edge tools to address pandemic preparedness and response," said Ernesto Zedillo, former President of Mexico and member of The Elders.
Kiswahili: "Athari inayoonekana ya kile tulichokiona hapa ni jambo ambalo tunapaswa kulifanya hadharani, ili kukumbusha umuhimu wa nchi kufanya kazi pamoja, na WHO, kutumia zana za kisasa kushughulikia utayari na mwitikio wa janga," alisema Ernesto Zedillo, Rais wa zamani wa Mexico na mwanachama wa The Elders.

English: This is a best practice in Africa and a great cause for humanity," said Elbegdorj Tsakhia, former Prime Minister and President of Mongolia and member of The Elders.
Kiswahili: Huu ni utaratibu bora barani Afrika na ni sababu kubwa ya ubinadamu," alisema Elbegdorj Tsakhia, Waziri Mkuu wa zamani na Rais wa Mongolia na mwanachama wa The Elders.

English: Together for a healthier world WHO's work is founded on the principle that all people, everywhere, should enjoy the highest standard of health.
Kiswahili: Pamoja kwa ajili ya ulimwengu wenye afya njema Kazi ya WHO imejengwa juu ya kanuni kwamba watu wote, kila mahali, wanapaswa kufurahia kiwango cha juu cha afya.

English: Trained in emergency obstetric and newborn care through programmes also supported by WHO, she quickly assessed Leaungokiok's condition and began monitoring the progress of labour.
Kiswahili: Akiwa amefunzwa katika huduma ya dharura ya uzazi na watoto wachanga kupitia programu zinazoungwa mkono pia na WHO, alitathmini haraka hali ya Leaungokiok na kuanza kufuatilia maendeleo ya uchungu wa kujifungua.

English: "I found her already in active labour" Makena recalls.
Kiswahili: "Nilimkuta tayari akiwa katika uchungu wa uzazi" Makena anakumbuka.

English: "I stayed with her, monitored her progress closely and supported the delivery." Makena's presence came at a critical moment.
Kiswahili: "Nilikaa naye, nikafuatilia maendeleo yake kwa karibu na kuunga mkono utoaji." Uwepo wa Makena ulikuja wakati muhimu.

English: She also supported the mother to initiate breastfeeding within the first hour, an essential step in protecting the newborn's health.
Kiswahili: Pia alimsaidia mama kuanza kunyonyesha ndani ya saa ya kwanza, hatua muhimu katika kulinda afya ya mtoto mchanga.

English: In the past year, WHO has supported 14 of the 47 counties in Kenya to develop a pool of facility-based mentors of emergency obstetric and newborn care, helping ensure that more women can access skilled care during pregnancy and childbirth, even in the most hard-to-reach areas.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka uliopita, WHO imesaidia kaunti 14 kati ya 47 nchini Kenya kuunda kundi la washauri wa dharura wa uzazi na watoto wachanga wanaopatikana katika vituo vya afya, na kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba wanawake wengi zaidi wanaweza kupata huduma stadi wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua, hata katika maeneo ambayo ni magumu kufikiwa.

English: The handover builds on commitments made on 28 May 2026, when President William Ruto launched the EWENE Acceleration Plan 2026 to 2028 and the Maternal and Newborn Health Rapid Results Initiative at State House, Nairobi, pledging KES 7.5 billion towards maternal, newborn and reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Makabidhiano hayo yanatokana na ahadi zilizotolewa tarehe 28 Mei 2026, wakati Rais William Ruto alipozindua Mpango wa Kuongeza Kasi wa EWENE 2026 hadi 2028 na Mpango wa Matokeo ya Haraka ya Afya ya Mama na Mtoto Mchanga katika Ikulu ya Serikali, Nairobi, akiahidi shilingi bilioni 7.5 kwa huduma za afya ya uzazi, watoto wachanga na uzazi.

English: "Behind every bed and every piece of equipment is a woman whose life may be saved, a newborn who will have a healthier start in life, and a family whose future will be protected," he said.
Kiswahili: "Nyuma ya kila kitanda na kila kifaa kuna mwanamke ambaye maisha yake yanaweza kuokolewa, mtoto mchanga ambaye atakuwa na mwanzo mzuri wa maisha, na familia ambayo mustakabali wake utalindwa," alisema.

English: He added that a resilient health system must support women across the life course, not only during pregnancy and childbirth, central to the government's commitment to Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Aliongeza kuwa mfumo thabiti wa afya lazima uwasaidie wanawake katika maisha yao yote, si tu wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua, jambo muhimu katika ahadi ya serikali ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote.

English: To support effective use, WHO and the Ministry of Health matched the equipment to facilities with capacity to deliver the relevant services and coordinated installation, training and mentorship support.
Kiswahili: Ili kusaidia matumizi bora, WHO na Wizara ya Afya walilinganisha vifaa hivyo na vifaa vyenye uwezo wa kutoa huduma husika na kuratibu usakinishaji, mafunzo na usaidizi wa ushauri.

English: Oluga called on beneficiary counties and facilities to ensure proper use, maintenance and accountability.
Kiswahili: Oluga alitoa wito kwa kaunti na vifaa vinavyonufaika kuhakikisha matumizi, matengenezo na uwajibikaji unaofaa.

English: "The true value of this equipment will be measured by the lives saved, the complications prevented, the women treated with dignity, the cancers detected early, and the health workers empowered to provide quality care," Kimambo said.
Kiswahili: "Thamani halisi ya vifaa hivi itapimwa kwa maisha yaliyookolewa, matatizo yaliyozuiliwa, wanawake watakaotendewa kwa heshima, saratani zilizogunduliwa mapema, na wafanyakazi wa afya waliowezeshwa kutoa huduma bora," Kimambo alisema.

English: Too many cancers that can be prevented, found early and treated are still catching women too late.
Kiswahili: Saratani nyingi sana ambazo zinaweza kuzuiwa, kupatikana mapema na kutibiwa bado zinawapata wanawake kuchelewa sana.

English: The collaboration will advance three pillars: generating evidence to inform WHO norms and national policy; building the skills of health workers, from specialists to community providers, to detect and manage these cancers earlier; and validating innovative tools, including AI-enabled breast ultrasound and AI-assisted cervical screening, for use in primary care.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huo utaendeleza nguzo tatu: kutoa ushahidi ili kuelimisha kanuni za WHO na sera ya kitaifa; kujenga ujuzi wa wafanyakazi wa afya, kuanzia wataalamu hadi watoa huduma za jamii, ili kugundua na kudhibiti saratani hizi mapema; na kuthibitisha zana bunifu, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchunguzi wa matiti unaotumia akili bandia (AI) na uchunguzi wa shingo ya kizazi unaosaidiwa na akili bandia (AI), kwa ajili ya matumizi katika huduma ya msingi.

English: "This Memorandum of Understanding reflects AKU's commitment to advancing awareness, re , innovation, and capacity building to improve access to equitable, quality cancer prevention and care.
Kiswahili: "Muamala huu wa Maelewano unaonyesha kujitolea kwa AKU katika kukuza uelewa, utafiti, uvumbuzi, na kujenga uwezo ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa kinga na huduma bora za saratani zenye usawa na zenye ubora."

English: This partnership will help drive action to improve prevention, cancer diagnosis and care," said Professor Tania Bubela, Provost and Vice President Academic, Aga Khan University.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huu utasaidia kuchochea hatua za kuboresha kinga, utambuzi wa saratani na utunzaji," alisema Profesa Tania Bubela, Msimamizi na Makamu wa Rais wa Taaluma, Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan.

English: For the thousands of women in Kenya and across the region whose cancers can be prevented, found early and treated, this partnership is one step towards ensuring that a diagnosis is the start of a treatment journey, not the end of hope.
Kiswahili: Kwa maelfu ya wanawake nchini Kenya na kote katika eneo hilo ambao saratani zinaweza kuzuiwa, kupatikana mapema na kutibiwa, ushirikiano huu ni hatua moja kuelekea kuhakikisha kwamba utambuzi ni mwanzo wa safari ya matibabu, si mwisho wa matumaini.

English: Kenya Commemorates The 12th World No-Tobacco Day As Global Tobacco Survey Report Is Launched 31 May 2003 World No Tobacco Day 2003 whose theme is "Tobacco Free Film.
Kiswahili: Kenya Yaadhimisha Siku ya 12 ya Dunia ya Kupinga Tumbaku Huku Ripoti ya Utafiti wa Tumbaku Duniani Ikizinduliwa Mei 31, 2003 Siku ya Dunia ya Kupinga Tumbaku 2003 ambayo mada yake ni "Filamu Isiyo na Tumbaku."

English: The hub has shipped 11 tonnes of health emergency supplies and equipment from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport directly to Bunia in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak of Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus was declared on 15 May 2026.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho kimesafirisha tani 11 za vifaa na vifaa vya dharura vya afya kutoka Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa wa Jomo Kenyatta moja kwa moja hadi Bunia katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo, ambapo mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Ebola unaosababishwa na virusi vya Bundibugyo ulitangazwa tarehe 15 Mei 2026.

English: "I need to ensure that the cargo leaving for the Democratic Republic of the Congo is well taken care of and loaded in a clear way so that it may not be damaged," says Oloo.
Kiswahili: "Ninahitaji kuhakikisha kwamba mizigo inayoondoka kwenda Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo inatunzwa vizuri na kupakiwa kwa njia iliyo wazi ili isiharibike," anasema Oloo.

English: The consignment included personal protective equipment, case management kits and supplies to facilitate safe and dignified burials.
Kiswahili: Shehena hiyo ilijumuisha vifaa vya kinga binafsi, vifaa vya usimamizi wa kesi na vifaa ili kuwezesha mazishi salama na ya heshima.

English: These supplies save lives and protect health workers, family and community members.
Kiswahili: Vifaa hivi huokoa maisha na kuwalinda wafanyakazi wa afya, familia na wanajamii.

English: "The cargo should reach the Democratic Republic of the Congo safely in order to save lives of the people living there," he says.
Kiswahili: "Mzigo unapaswa kufika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo salama ili kuokoa maisha ya watu wanaoishi huko," anasema.

English: Seasonal long rains have caused widespread flooding across Kenya, resulting in loss of life, destruction of critical infrastructure, mass displacement, and significant disruption to health services.
Kiswahili: Mvua ndefu za msimu zimesababisha mafuriko makubwa kote Kenya, na kusababisha vifo, uharibifu wa miundombinu muhimu, kuhama kwa watu wengi, na usumbufu mkubwa kwa huduma za afya.

English: This particularly endangers vulnerable groups like children, seniors, and the chronically ill as displacement rapidly cuts off access to essential medications, vaccines, and routine medical care.
Kiswahili: Hii inahatarisha hasa makundi yaliyo hatarini kama vile watoto, wazee, na wagonjwa sugu kwani kuhama makazi yao kunapunguza upatikanaji wa dawa muhimu, chanjo, na huduma za kawaida za matibabu.

English: The Ministry of Health deployed eight field teams of 41 health professionals across 14 counties to strengthen coordination, surveillance, infection prevention, and WASH measures.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ilituma timu nane za wataalamu wa afya 41 katika kaunti 14 ili kuimarisha uratibu, ufuatiliaji, kinga dhidi ya maambukizi, na hatua za WASH.

English: When a burst in a draingage water source caused a sharp rise in diarrhoeal diseases, her team distributed water treatment tablets through community health promoters.
Kiswahili: Wakati mlipuko katika chanzo cha maji ya mifereji ya maji ulisababisha ongezeko kubwa la magonjwa ya kuhara, timu yake ilisambaza vidonge vya kutibu maji kupitia wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii.

English: As immunization coverage dropped because families had lost child health booklets, the facility regenerated records and re-enrolled affected children into care.
Kiswahili: Kadri chanjo ilivyopungua kwa sababu familia zilikuwa zimepoteza vijitabu vya afya ya watoto, kituo kilirejesha kumbukumbu na kuwaandikisha tena watoto walioathiriwa katika huduma ya uangalizi.

English: Community health promoters proved essential throughout, serving as the most trusted link between the health system and displaced families, delivering supplies, information, and support to households that could not reach a facility.
Kiswahili: Wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii walithibitika kuwa muhimu sana, wakitumika kama kiungo kinachoaminika zaidi kati ya mfumo wa afya na familia zilizohamishwa, wakitoa vifaa, taarifa, na usaidizi kwa kaya ambazo hazikuweza kufikia kituo.

English: The facility now holds a three-month medicine buffer stock and a cold chain system keeping vaccines safe for 90 days without power.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho sasa kina akiba ya dawa ya miezi mitatu na mfumo wa mnyororo wa baridi unaoweka chanjo salama kwa siku 90 bila umeme.

English: The Ministry of Health and WHO are working to ensure these lessons translate into stronger emergency plans, better-resourced facilities, and more resilient communities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya na WHO zinafanya kazi kuhakikisha masomo haya yanatafsiriwa kuwa mipango imara ya dharura, vifaa vyenye rasilimali bora, na jamii zenye ustahimilivu zaidi.

English: For Catherine and families like hers, that resilience is the difference between losing everything and being protected when the rains return.
Kiswahili: Kwa Catherine na familia kama yake, ustahimilivu huo ndio tofauti kati ya kupoteza kila kitu na kulindwa mvua zinaporudi.

English: Nairobi, 21 May 2020 – Over three million children across 13 counties of Kenya are to be vaccinated against polio by the Government, UNICEF, WHO and partners, after the virus was confirmed to be circulating in Garissa and Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Nairobi, 21 Mei 2020 - Zaidi ya watoto milioni tatu katika kaunti 13 za Kenya watapewa chanjo dhidi ya polio na Serikali, UNICEF, WHO na washirika, baada ya virusi hivyo kuthibitishwa kuenea Garissa na Mombasa.

English: Yet beneath the calm, there is a quiet sadness as he recalls the past.
Kiswahili: Lakini chini ya utulivu, kuna huzuni tulivu anapokumbuka yaliyopita.

English: "Long ago," he begins, "our Samburu warriors left to protect our grazing lands from neighboring communities.
Kiswahili: "Zamani sana," anaanza, "mashujaa wetu wa Samburu waliondoka nyumbani ili kulinda ardhi zetu za malisho kutoka kwa jamii jirani.

English: They were away for many months, guarding what belongs to us." During their absence, women stayed behind in the manyattas, managing steads, raising children, and keeping families together.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa mbali kwa miezi mingi, wakilinda mali yetu." Wakati wa kutokuwepo kwao, wanawake walibaki nyuma katika manyatta, wakisimamia makazi, kulea watoto, na kuweka familia pamoja.

English: "The community felt betrayed," Mzee Lekimain recalls, his voice tinted with sorrow.
Kiswahili: "Jumuiya ilihisi kusalitiwa," Mzee Lekimain anakumbuka, sauti yake ikiwa na rangi ya huzuni.

English: The elders declared that women must undergo circumcision, believing it would prevent such situations from happening again.
Kiswahili: Wazee walitangaza kwamba wanawake lazima watahiriwe, wakiamini kwamba ingezuia hali kama hizo kutokea tena.

English: Older women often enforced FGM, while men held near-total authority over households and community matters.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wazee mara nyingi walilazimisha ukeketaji, huku wanaume wakiwa na mamlaka karibu yote juu ya masuala ya kaya na jamii.

English: "People now understand that these practices increase disease risk and cause conflict," says elder Etemesi Lentoijoni.
Kiswahili: "Watu sasa wanaelewa kwamba desturi hizi huongeza hatari ya magonjwa na kusababisha migogoro," anasema mzee Etemesi Lentoijoni.

English: Alice Muthoni, a clinician and education advocate highlights the role of awareness campaigns in keeping girls in school.
Kiswahili: Alice Muthoni, daktari na mtetezi wa elimu anaangazia jukumu la kampeni za uhamasishaji katika kuwaweka wasichana shuleni.

English: "In 2025, two cases were reported but both girls went back and have since completed Grade Nine." Community sensitization has reinforced a clear message: every child has a right to education.
Kiswahili: "Mwaka 2025, visa viwili viliripotiwa lakini wasichana wote wawili walirudi na tangu wakati huo wamemaliza Darasa la Tisa." Uhamasishaji wa jamii umeimarisha ujumbe ulio wazi: kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu.

English: Where injustices once went unreported, the Samburu community now has structured pathways for addressing gender-based violence, or as they call it, nkutorogonyo.
Kiswahili: Ambapo hapo awali ukosefu wa haki haukuripotiwa, jamii ya Samburu sasa imeunda njia za kushughulikia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia, au kama wanavyouita, nkutorogonyo.

English: "Women now reject kangaroo courts because they offer no justice," notes a local activist.
Kiswahili: "Wanawake sasa wanakataa mahakama za kangaroo kwa sababu hazitoi haki," anasema mwanaharakati wa eneo hilo.

English: "We demand proper legal processes that protect survivors rather than punish them further." The Kenya Red Cross has held community sessions to educate residents on presenting their cases in court.
Kiswahili: "Tunadai michakato sahihi ya kisheria inayowalinda manusura badala ya kuwaadhibu zaidi." Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya limefanya vikao vya kijamii ili kuwaelimisha wakazi kuhusu kuwasilisha kesi zao mahakamani.

English: "The Kenya Red Cross Society called for men's and women's engagement forums to speak openly about GBV," he explains.
Kiswahili: "Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kimetoa wito kwa mabaraza ya ushiriki wa wanaume na wanawake kuzungumza waziwazi kuhusu GBV," anaelezea.

English: "That openness has helped families confront issues they once ignored." As harmful practices declined locally, some perpetrators tried to move girls to other areas to continue FGM in secret.
Kiswahili: "Uwazi huo umesaidia familia kukabiliana na masuala ambayo hapo awali yalipuuzwa." Kadri desturi zenye madhara zilivyopungua katika maeneo hayo, baadhi ya wahalifu walijaribu kuwahamisha wasichana hadi maeneo mengine ili kuendelea na ukeketaji kwa siri.

English: They now identify and report suspicious movements involving girls, playing a vital role in prevention.
Kiswahili: Sasa wanatambua na kuripoti mienendo inayotiliwa shaka inayowahusisha wasichana, na kuchukua jukumu muhimu katika kuzuia.

English: The riders have also organized themselves into savings groups, improving livelihoods while strengthening community protection.
Kiswahili: Waendeshaji pia wamejipanga katika vikundi vya kuweka akiba, wakiboresha riziki huku wakiimarisha ulinzi wa jamii.

English: They refer cases to Baragoi Sub-County Hospital, which offers maternal and child health services, HIV/TB care, GBV support, and ensures legal documentation is complete for court proceedings.
Kiswahili: Wanapeleka kesi katika Hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Baragoi, ambayo hutoa huduma za afya ya mama na mtoto, huduma ya VVU/TB, usaidizi wa GBV, na kuhakikisha nyaraka za kisheria zimekamilika kwa ajili ya kesi mahakamani.

English: Morans now marry uncircumcised girls, consult wives on household decisions, and share chores and resources.
Kiswahili: Wamorani sasa wanaoa wasichana wasiotahiriwa, wanashauriana na wake kuhusu maamuzi ya nyumbani, na wanashiriki kazi za nyumbani na rasilimali.

English: Under-reporting of gender-based violence is still high, particularly in remote areas.
Kiswahili: Ripoti chache za ukatili wa kijinsia bado ziko juu, hasa katika maeneo ya mbali.

English: Stigma, cultural pressures, fear of retaliation, and illiteracy prevent survivors from seeking help.
Kiswahili: Unyanyapaa, shinikizo la kitamaduni, hofu ya kulipiza kisasi, na kutojua kusoma na kuandika huwazuia manusura kutafuta msaada.

English: "SGBV cases are often silent because survivors fear speaking out," explains Esther, a clinician at Baragoi Sub-County Hospital.
Kiswahili: "Visa vya SGBV mara nyingi huwa kimya kwa sababu manusura huogopa kusema," anaelezea Esther, daktari katika Hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Baragoi.

English: Survivor groups report improved family relationships, shared decision-making on livestock and household matters, and better communication between spouses.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya walionusurika vinaripoti kuimarika kwa mahusiano ya kifamilia, kufanya maamuzi ya pamoja kuhusu mifugo na masuala ya kaya, na mawasiliano bora kati ya wanandoa.

English: At the barazas, elders recall the historic Samburu Declaration made in early 2021, witnessed by former President Uhuru Kenyatta.
Kiswahili: Katika mabaraza hayo, wazee wanakumbuka Azimio la kihistoria la Samburu lililotolewa mapema 2021, lililoshuhudiwa na aliyekuwa Rais Uhuru Kenyatta.

English: The declaration marked the official blessing of a new way of life: no FGM, no domestic violence, and zero tolerance for sexual abuse.
Kiswahili: Tamko hilo liliashiria baraka rasmi ya mtindo mpya wa maisha: kutokeketwa kwa wanawake, kutokunyanyaswa majumbani, na kutovumilia kabisa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.

English: All this has been made possible by the Gender-Based Violence Awareness and Prevention Project, implemented by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Embassy of Finland Kenya office in partnership with the Kenya Red Cross Society.
Kiswahili: Haya yote yamewezekana kutokana na Mradi wa Uelewa na Kuzuia Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia, unaotekelezwa na Ofisi ya Ubalozi wa Finland Kenya kwa ushirikiano na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya.

English: The Centre is strategically located in Kisumu City, western Kenya region, in an area that is endemic for major infectious diseases.
Kiswahili: Kituo hiki kiko katika eneo la kimkakati katika Jiji la Kisumu, magharibi mwa Kenya, katika eneo ambalo ni la kawaida kwa magonjwa makubwa ya kuambukiza.

English: Specifically, the Centre has carried out cutting-edge re focusing on trials on the efficacy of drugs, emergence of drug and vector resistance, epidemiology, immunology, molecular biology, vector biology, climate and human health, characterization of malaria vaccine candidate antigens, malaria vaccine trials, malaria in pregnancy and interaction of malaria and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), schistosomiasis, intestinal helminthes, HIV/AIDS and its impact on the community, HIV interaction with other infectious diseases, tuberculosis and reproductive health.
Kiswahili: Hasa, Kituo kimefanya utafiti wa kina unaozingatia majaribio kuhusu ufanisi wa dawa, kuibuka kwa upinzani wa dawa na vekta, epidemiolojia, kinga mwilini, biolojia ya molekuli, biolojia ya vekta, hali ya hewa na afya ya binadamu, uainishaji wa antijeni zinazohitajika kwa chanjo ya malaria, majaribio ya chanjo ya malaria, malaria wakati wa ujauzito na mwingiliano wa malaria na virusi vya UKIMWI (VVU), kichocho, helminthi ya utumbo, VVU/UKIMWI na athari zake kwa jamii, mwingiliano wa VVU na magonjwa mengine ya kuambukiza, kifua kikuu na afya ya uzazi.

English: Mandates - To conduct evidence based re aimed at providing solutions for the reduction of infectious, parasitic, non-infectious diseases and other causes of ill-health in Kenya.This includes, but not limited to: - Epidemiology and control of Infectious, Non-Communicable and Lifestyle Diseases.
Kiswahili: Maagizo - Kufanya utafiti unaotegemea ushahidi unaolenga kutoa suluhisho za kupunguza magonjwa ya kuambukiza, vimelea, yasiyoambukiza na sababu zingine za afya mbaya nchini Kenya. Hii inajumuisha, lakini sio tu: - Epidemiolojia na udhibiti wa Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza, Yasiyoambukiza na ya Mtindo wa Maisha.

English: Evidence of Schistosomiasis in pre-school age children (< 5 years) and need for change in deworming policy: The WHO recommended control strategy of Schistosomiasis is based on preventive chemotherapy interventions targeting the majority of the at-risk population The current gold standard treatment employs annual single oral dose of the drug Praziquantel (PZQ) 600 mg tablets for adults and school age children at 40 mg/kg.
Kiswahili: Ushahidi wa Skistosomiasis kwa watoto wa umri wa shule ya awali (< miaka 5) na hitaji la mabadiliko katika sera ya kuondoa minyoo: WHO ilipendekeza mkakati wa kudhibiti Skistosomiasis unategemea hatua za kinga za kidini zinazolenga idadi kubwa ya watu walio katika hatari. Matibabu ya kiwango cha dhahabu ya sasa hutumia kipimo kimoja cha kila mwaka cha dawa ya Praziquantel (PZQ) 600 mg kwa watu wazima na watoto wa umri wa kwenda shule kwa kipimo cha 40 mg/kg.

English: These findings have informed the inclusion of such otherwise neglected settings in National deworming programs, and the strategies to use in such settings.

Kiswahili: Jaribio lilisitishwa kwa muda wakati mjitolea mmoja alipopata ugonjwa usiotarajiwa.

English: Trial pausing is a standard procedure which allows an independent body to investigate the cause of an illness that has occurred in a trial volunteer.
Kiswahili: Kusitisha kesi ni utaratibu wa kawaida unaoruhusu chombo huru kuchunguza chanzo cha ugonjwa uliotokea kwa mjitolea wa majaribio.

Kiswahili: Wakati jaribio lilipositishwa, hakuna uandikishaji wa washiriki uliokuwa ukiendelea nchini Kenya.

Kiswahili: Kufuatia mapitio huru ya chanzo cha ugonjwa wa mjitolea wa jaribio na kugundua kuwa huenda haukuhusiana na chanjo ya majaribio, Bodi ya Usalama na Ufuatiliaji wa Data (DSMB), imeruhusu jaribio kuendelea.

Kiswahili: Utahakikishaje usalama wa washiriki?

English: When to end isolation (staying ) - People with COVID-19 who have stayed (are isolated) can stop isolation under the following conditions: - If they will not have a test to determine if they are still contagious, they can leave after these three things have happened: - They have had no fever for at least 72 hours (that is three full days of no fever without the use medicine that reduces fevers) AND - other symptoms have improved (for example, when their cough or shortness of breath have improved) AND - at least 7 days have passed since their symptoms first appeared - They have had no fever for at least 72 hours (that is three full days of no fever without the use medicine that reduces fevers) - If they will be tested to determine if they are still contagious, they can leave after these three things have happened: - They no longer have a fever (without the use medicine that reduces fevers) AND - other symptoms have improved (for example, when their cough or shortness of breath have improved) AND - They received two negative tests in a row, 24 hours apart.

English: Nairobi, Kenya, 12 May 2026 — The United Nations Population Fund, UNFPA, in partnership with the Government of Japan, today launched two new projects aimed at strengthening sexual and reproductive health and rights, preventing and responding to gender-based violence, and empowering women and young people in Kenya.

English: They include an initiative aimed at strengthening access to integrated health and protection services for refugees and host communities in Kakuma and Dadaab municipalities, which is expected to benefit 107,136 people and support peaceful coexistence through improved access to quality sexual and reproductive health information, maternal health care, family planning services, psychosocial support, and survivor-centred GBV prevention and response services.

English: The second initiative, "Kenya-Japan ARISE: Action for Resilience, Innovation, Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights and Empowerment for Women and Youth," will leverage technology and innovative digital solutions to reach 88,500 adolescents, youth and women in Nairobi and Narok Counties with sexual and reproductive health, gender-based violence prevention, menstrual health management and economic empowerment support services.

English: A total of 10000 scholarship slots are available: 4000 for refugee learners in camps and refugee hosting counties and 6000 allocated to learners from counties that do not host refugees.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya nafasi 10000 za ufadhili wa masomo zinapatikana: 4000 kwa wanafunzi wakimbizi katika kambi na kaunti zinazowahifadhi wakimbizi na 6000 zilizotengwa kwa wanafunzi kutoka kaunti ambazo hazihifadhi wakimbizi.

English: Today Ministry officials were in Muranga County to monitor the Elimu Scholarships programme for the 2026 cohort.
Kiswahili: Leo maafisa wa Wizara walikuwa katika Kaunti ya Muranga kufuatilia mpango wa Ufadhili wa Elimu kwa kundi la wanafunzi wa mwaka 2026.

English: While the photos are from Muranga the monitoring and selection process is happening concurrently across all 46 counties nationwide.
Kiswahili: Ingawa picha ni za Muranga, mchakato wa ufuatiliaji na uteuzi unafanyika kwa wakati mmoja katika kaunti zote 46 kote nchini.

English: All results related queries must be lodged through the heads of institutions within 30 days after release of results.
Kiswahili: Maswali yote yanayohusiana na matokeo lazima yawasilishwe kupitia wakuu wa taasisi ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kutolewa kwa matokeo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education Julius Migos Ogamba yesterday embarked on a working tour of Muranga County to evaluate resumption of school operations and monitor the Grade 10 learners reporting and admission exercise.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu Julius Migos Ogamba jana alianza ziara ya kikazi katika Kaunti ya Muranga ili kutathmini kurejeshwa kwa shughuli za shule na kufuatilia wanafunzi wa darasa la 10 wanaoripoti na zoezi la udahili.

English: From these engagements and reports from across the country it is clear that the transition is progressing well.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na shughuli hizi na ripoti kutoka kote nchini ni wazi kwamba mpito unaendelea vizuri.

English: Most schools have already reached over 90 percent enrollment and the remaining learners are expected to report by tomorrow.
Kiswahili: Shule nyingi tayari zimefikia zaidi ya asilimia 90 ya uandikishaji na wanafunzi waliobaki wanatarajiwa kuripoti ifikapo kesho.

English: PS Bitok today visited Moi Girls Kamangu and Alliance High as part of monitoring the transition of Grade 10 learners into Junior School under the Competency Based Education system.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu Bitok leo ametembelea Shule ya Wasichana ya Moi Kamangu na Alliance High kama sehemu ya kufuatilia mabadiliko ya wanafunzi wa Darasa la 10 kuingia Shule ya Vijana chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo.

English: The visit focused on learner integration school preparedness and early progress with positive feedback from students and school leadership.
Kiswahili: Ziara hiyo ililenga katika maandalizi ya shule ya ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi na maendeleo ya awali pamoja na maoni chanya kutoka kwa wanafunzi na uongozi wa shule.

English: He emphasized that reforms are ongoing data driven and focused on improving quality access and integrity.
Kiswahili: Alisisitiza kwamba mageuzi yanaendeshwa na data inayoendelea na yanalenga kuboresha upatikanaji na uadilifu wa ubora.

English: We have experienced some challenges in the transition from Grade 9 to Grade 10 since it is a new system but we have managed to ensure that 85 percent of the students who were expected to report have already done so.
Kiswahili: Tumepitia changamoto kadhaa katika mpito kutoka Darasa la 9 hadi Darasa la 10 kwa kuwa ni mfumo mpya lakini tumeweza kuhakikisha kwamba asilimia 85 ya wanafunzi waliotarajiwa kuripoti tayari wamefanya hivyo.

English: At the forum I had the opportunity to hear candid feedback from stakeholders and to explain what we are doing at the Ministry to ensure policy that shows up policy informed by real classroom experiences.
Kiswahili: Katika jukwaa hilo nilipata fursa ya kusikia maoni ya wazi kutoka kwa wadau na kuelezea tunachofanya Wizarani ili kuhakikisha sera inayoonyesha sera inayotokana na uzoefu halisi wa darasani.

English: An official online platform is now open for reporting any allegations of corruption or malpractice in the placement of Grade 10 learners in senior schools.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa rasmi la mtandaoni sasa limefunguliwa kwa ajili ya kuripoti madai yoyote ya ufisadi au ubadhirifu katika uwekaji wa wanafunzi wa darasa la 10 katika shule za upili.

English: Heads of Institution are under duty to ensure that learners' registration details are correctly captured, so that no learner is disenfranchised.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa Taasisi wana wajibu wa kuhakikisha kwamba maelezo ya usajili wa wanafunzi yanaandikwa kwa usahihi, ili hakuna mwanafunzi anayenyimwa haki ya kujiunga na chuo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education held a meeting with the Cabinet Secretary for Health at the Ministry of Health offices at Afya House, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alifanya mkutano na Waziri wa Afya katika ofisi za Wizara ya Afya House, Nairobi.

English: The two-day summit brought together South Africa's Minister for Higher Education, international university presidents, Vice-Chancellors, and civil society leaders, focused on powering Africa's future through talent development, innovation, and inclusion.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo wa siku mbili uliwakutanisha Waziri wa Elimu ya Juu wa Afrika Kusini, marais wa vyuo vikuu vya kimataifa, Makamu wa Chansela, na viongozi wa asasi za kiraia, uliolenga kuimarisha mustakabali wa Afrika kupitia ukuzaji wa vipaji, uvumbuzi, na ujumuishaji.

English: This morning, the Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, together with his Health counterpart, Hon. Aden Duale, inaugurated the Multi-Sectoral Technical Working Group on Education and Training of Healthcare Providers at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi ya leo, Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, pamoja na mwenzake wa Afya, Mhe. Aden Duale, walizindua Kikosi Kazi cha Kiufundi cha Sekta Mbalimbali kuhusu Elimu na Mafunzo ya Watoa Huduma za Afya katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.

English: The Working Group brings together officers from professional and regulatory bodies at the Ministries of Education and Health, to ensure alignment in the education and training of healthcare professionals in the country.
Kiswahili: Kundi Kazi linawaleta pamoja maafisa kutoka vyombo vya kitaaluma na udhibiti katika Wizara za Elimu na Afya, ili kuhakikisha upatanifu katika elimu na mafunzo ya wataalamu wa afya nchini.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, held a high-level meeting at TSC House in Upper Hill on the implementation of Chinese language education in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alifanya mkutano wa ngazi ya juu katika Jumba la TSC huko Upper Hill kuhusu utekelezaji wa elimu ya lugha ya Kichina nchini Kenya.

English: Under the programme, teachers will undertake one year of training locally at the Confucius Institute and the University of Nairobi's Faculty of Education, culminating in a Postgraduate Diploma in Education (Chinese Language Track), before proceeding to Tianjin Normal University for a second year of advanced training.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango huo, walimu watachukua mwaka mmoja wa mafunzo katika Taasisi ya Confucius na Kitivo cha Elimu cha Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi, wakiishia katika Stashahada ya Uzamili katika Elimu (Kiingereza), kabla ya kuendelea na Chuo Kikuu cha Kawaida cha Tianjin kwa mwaka wa pili wa mafunzo ya juu.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, and Her Excellency Mama Rachel Ruto at the 64th Kenya National Drama and Film Festival State Concert held at State House, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, na Mheshimiwa Mama Rachel Ruto katika Tamasha la 64 la Kitaifa la Tamthilia na Filamu la Kenya lililofanyika katika Ikulu ya Nairobi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, granted a Letter of Interim Authority to the African Talent University at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitoa Barua ya Mamlaka ya Muda kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Vipaji vya Kiafrika katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.

English: The Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to Kenya, H.E. Kang Hyungshik, paid a courtesy call on the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, at Jogoo House B.
Kiswahili: Balozi wa Jamhuri ya Korea nchini Kenya, Mhe. Kang Hyungshik, alimtembelea Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, katika Jumba la Jogoo B.

English: Discussions focused on the evolving world of work driven by technology, modern training facilities, enhanced capacity development, and the establishment of a Career Development Unit.
Kiswahili: Majadiliano yalilenga ulimwengu unaobadilika wa kazi unaoendeshwa na teknolojia, vifaa vya kisasa vya mafunzo, ukuzaji wa uwezo ulioimarishwa, na uanzishwaji wa Kitengo cha Maendeleo ya Kazi.

English: Partnerships with universities locally and internationally continue to drive capacity building in innovative pedagogy, as curricula undergo review.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano na vyuo vikuu vya ndani na kimataifa unaendelea kuchochea ujenzi wa uwezo katika ufundishaji bunifu, huku mitaala ikipitiwa.

English: The Principal Secretary, State Department for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, appeared before the Public Accounts Committee to review the Auditor-General's Report on the Financial Statements for FY 2023/2024.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu, Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alifika mbele ya Kamati ya Hesabu za Umma ili kupitia Ripoti ya Mkaguzi Mkuu wa Hesabu za Fedha kwa mwaka wa fedha wa 2023/2024.

English: The session provided an opportunity to reaffirm the Department's commitment to accountability, transparency, and the prudent use of public resources in the higher education sector.
Kiswahili: Kikao hicho kilitoa fursa ya kuthibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Idara katika uwajibikaji, uwazi, na matumizi ya busara ya rasilimali za umma katika sekta ya elimu ya juu.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, presided over the official opening of the 3rd Annual Educational Assessment Symposium at the New Mitihani House in South C.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, aliongoza ufunguzi rasmi wa Kongamano la Tathmini ya Elimu la Mwaka la 3 katika Jumba Jipya la Mitihani huko South C.

English: The team presented findings of re on the challenges facing women's leadership in academia, and proposed interventions to ensure women are not unduly prevented from ascending to leadership roles.
Kiswahili: Timu hiyo iliwasilisha matokeo ya utafiti kuhusu changamoto zinazowakabili uongozi wa wanawake katika taaluma, na ilipendekeza hatua za kuchukua ili kuhakikisha wanawake hawazuiliwi kupita kiasi kupanda nafasi za uongozi.

English: The Conference was convened to review progress made, especially in the rollout of Competency-Based Education, and to examine transformative reforms being implemented to ensure the education system remains fit for purpose in the 21st century.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo uliitishwa ili kupitia maendeleo yaliyopatikana, hasa katika utekelezaji wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo, na kuchunguza mageuzi yanayoleta mabadiliko yanayotekelezwa ili kuhakikisha mfumo wa elimu unabaki unafaa kwa madhumuni katika karne ya 21.

English: The Conference aims to shape markets, safeguard livelihoods, and protect the welfare of all Kenyans in line with the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA).
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo unalenga kuunda masoko, kulinda riziki, na kulinda ustawi wa Wakenya wote kulingana na Ajenda ya Mabadiliko ya Kiuchumi ya Chini-Kupanda (BETA).

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, hosted the Governor of Samburu County, Hon. Lati Lelelit, the Chair of the Laikipia University Council, Dr. Lemein Korei, and the Vice-Chancellor of Laikipia University, Prof. Kibett Rotich, at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alimkaribisha Gavana wa Kaunti ya Samburu, Mheshimiwa Lati Lelelit, Mwenyekiti wa Baraza la Chuo Kikuu cha Laikipia, Dkt. Lemein Korei, na Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Laikipia, Prof. Kibett Rotich, katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, was honoured with a conferment at Kenya-AIST, marking institutions with highly specialized mandates focused on training and advanced re in fields critical to Kenya's future competitiveness.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitunukiwa tuzo katika Kenya-AIST, akiashiria taasisi zenye mamlaka maalum ya juu zinazolenga mafunzo na utafiti wa hali ya juu katika nyanja muhimu kwa ushindani wa Kenya katika siku zijazo.

English: Our education thrives because of our teachers, who teach and inspire millions of learners in our educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Elimu yetu inastawi kwa sababu ya walimu wetu, ambao hufundisha na kuwatia moyo mamilioni ya wanafunzi katika taasisi zetu za elimu.

English: Following the Utumishi Girls fire tragedy, the Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Ogamba, announced hotline number 1199 for parents to report information, especially those who left with their children when they came earlier, with the line also available for counselling.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia mkasa wa moto wa Utumishi Girls, Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Ogamba, alitangaza nambari ya simu 1199 kwa wazazi kuripoti taarifa, hasa wale walioondoka na watoto wao walipokuja mapema, huku simu hiyo pia ikipatikana kwa ajili ya ushauri nasaha.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, served as guest of honour, alongside vice-chancellors and university panelists from institutions including South Eastern Kenya University, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, and Bomet.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alihudumu kama mgeni wa heshima, pamoja na makamu wa machansela na wanajopo wa vyuo vikuu kutoka taasisi zikiwemo Chuo Kikuu cha Kusini Mashariki mwa Kenya, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, na Bomet.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, hosted the incoming Principal Secretary for Basic Education, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, and the outgoing Principal Secretary, Amb. Prof. Julius Bitok, at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri la Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alimkaribisha Katibu Mkuu mpya wa Elimu ya Msingi, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, na Katibu Mkuu anayemaliza muda wake, Balozi Profesa Julius Bitok, katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.

English: The Cabinet Secretary emphasized that through a multi-stakeholder approach, the Government will continue engaging all relevant actors to develop and implement sustainable strategies aimed at preventing the recurrence of such incidents in educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Waziri alisisitiza kwamba kupitia mbinu ya wadau wengi, Serikali itaendelea kuwashirikisha wahusika wote husika ili kuendeleza na kutekeleza mikakati endelevu inayolenga kuzuia kujirudia kwa matukio kama hayo katika taasisi za elimu.

English: The event celebrated 8 decades of dedicated service to learners with visual impairments while highlighting the importance of inclusion, equality, and the protection of the rights and dignity of persons with albinism and other disabilities.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo iliadhimisha miongo 8 ya huduma ya kujitolea kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wa kuona huku ikisisitiza umuhimu wa ujumuishi, usawa, na ulinzi wa haki na utu wa watu wenye ualbino na ulemavu mwingine.

English: The event was attended by a host of Members of Parliament, including Hon. Steve Mogaka (West Mugirango), Hon. Jerusha Momanyi (Nyamira County), Hon. Japheth Nyakundi (Kitutu Chache North), Hon. John Bwire (Taveta), Hon. Didmus Barasa (Kimilili), Hon. Mwengi Mutuse (Kibwezi), and Hon. Renee Nyakerario (nominated).
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilihudhuriwa na Wabunge wengi akiwemo Mhe. Steve Mogaka (Mugirango Magharibi), Mhe. Jerusha Momanyi (Kaunti ya Nyamira), Mhe. Japheth Nyakundi (Kitutu Chache Kaskazini), Mhe. John Bwire (Taveta), Mhe. Didmus Barasa (Kimilili), Mhe. Mwengi Mutuse (Kibwezi), na Mhe. Renee Nyakerario (aliyeteuliwa).

English: The person providing assistance to a voter must be eighteen years of age or older, only one assistant is permitted, and no person shall assist more than one voter.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayetoa msaada kwa mpiga kura lazima awe na umri wa miaka kumi na minane au zaidi, msaidizi mmoja tu ndiye anayeruhusiwa, na hakuna mtu atakayeruhusiwa kuwasaidia zaidi ya mpiga kura mmoja.

English: Eligible voters are identified biometrically at the polling station using the Kenya Integrated Elections Management System (KIEMS) kit.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wanaostahiki hutambuliwa kwa kibayometriki katika kituo cha kupigia kura kwa kutumia kifurushi cha Mfumo Jumuishi wa Usimamizi wa Uchaguzi wa Kenya (KIEMS).

English: Only one mark should be used on the ballot paper when voting.
Kiswahili: Alama moja tu ndiyo inapaswa kutumika kwenye karatasi ya kupigia kura wakati wa kupiga kura.

English: To vote, a person must present their original Kenyan national identity card or a valid Kenyan passport at their polling station.
Kiswahili: Ili kupiga kura, mtu lazima aonyeshe kitambulisho chake cha kitaifa cha Kenya au pasipoti halali ya Kenya katika kituo chake cha kupigia kura.

English: Before approaching the courts over a nomination dispute, political parties and candidates are expected to first use the IEBC's Dispute Resolution Committee, the constitutionally designated mechanism for resolving such disputes.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kuwasilisha kesi mahakamani kuhusu mzozo wa uteuzi, vyama vya siasa na wagombea wanatarajiwa kwanza kutumia Kamati ya Utatuzi wa Migogoro ya IEBC, utaratibu uliowekwa kikatiba wa kutatua mizozo kama hiyo.

English: Legal frameworks governing elections must adequately address data protection, cybersecurity, transparency in electoral technologies, and accountability in electronic electoral processes, so that innovation strengthens rather than undermines public confidence.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kisheria inayosimamia uchaguzi lazima ishughulikie vya kutosha ulinzi wa data, usalama wa mtandao, uwazi katika teknolojia za uchaguzi, na uwajibikaji katika michakato ya uchaguzi wa kielektroniki, ili uvumbuzi uimarike badala ya kudhoofisha imani ya umma.

English: Public trust in electoral processes cannot be demanded; it must be earned through integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement, and requires commitment and cooperation from all sectors of society, not the Commission alone.
Kiswahili: Imani ya umma katika michakato ya uchaguzi haiwezi kudaiwa; lazima ipatikane kupitia uadilifu, uwajibikaji, na uboreshaji endelevu, na inahitaji kujitolea na ushirikiano kutoka kwa sekta zote za jamii, si Tume pekee.

English: The IEBC Strategic Plan is anchored on the theme 'Inclusion and Participation in Deepening Democracy in Kenya,' under the call 'Your Vote, Your Voice - Kura Yako, Sauti Yako.'
Kiswahili: Mpango Mkakati wa IEBC umejikita katika mada 'Ujumuishi na Ushiriki katika Kuimarisha Demokrasia nchini Kenya,' chini ya wito 'Kura Yako, Sauti Yako - Kura Yako, Sauti Yako.'

English: Democracy must never become captive to technology; every stage of the electoral process must remain transparent and audited, since public confidence can rise or fall based on how election results are transmitted.
Kiswahili: Demokrasia haipaswi kamwe kuwa mateka wa teknolojia; kila hatua ya mchakato wa uchaguzi lazima ibaki wazi na kukaguliwa, kwani imani ya umma inaweza kuongezeka au kushuka kulingana na jinsi matokeo ya uchaguzi yanavyosambazwa.

English: A public officer who intends to contest in the General Election must resign from public office at least six months before election day, on or before Tuesday, 9th February 2027.
Kiswahili: Afisa wa umma anayekusudia kugombea katika Uchaguzi Mkuu lazima ajiuzulu kutoka ofisi ya umma angalau miezi sita kabla ya siku ya uchaguzi, mnamo au kabla ya Jumanne, tarehe 9 Februari 2027.

English: Political parties must submit their party membership lists, and the names, dates, and venues of party primaries, to the Commission on or before Tuesday, 16th March 2027.
Kiswahili: Vyama vya siasa lazima viwasilishe orodha zao za uanachama wa chama, na majina, tarehe, na mahali pa kura za mchujo za chama, kwa Tume mnamo au kabla ya Jumanne, Machi 16, 2027.

English: Disputes relating to or arising from candidate nominations must be lodged with the Commission no later than Saturday, 12th June 2027, and must be determined within ten days of lodging.
Kiswahili: Migogoro inayohusiana na au inayotokana na uteuzi wa wagombea lazima iwasilishwe kwa Tume kabla ya Jumamosi, tarehe 12 Juni 2027, na lazima iamuliwe ndani ya siku kumi baada ya kuwasilishwa.

English: Organizations wishing to be accredited as Election Observers or Media Practitioners for a by-election must apply through the IEBC Accreditation Management System before the Commission's published deadline.
Kiswahili: Mashirika yanayotaka kuidhinishwa kama Waangalizi wa Uchaguzi au Watendaji wa Vyombo vya Habari kwa uchaguzi mdogo lazima yatume maombi kupitia Mfumo wa Usimamizi wa Ithibati wa IEBC kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho iliyochapishwa na Tume.

English: The public is warned to beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements falsely claiming to be an official IEBC job intake; the Commission's only official jobs portal is jobs.iebc.or.ke, and applicants should never submit personal information through unofficial recruitment links.
Kiswahili: Umma unaonywa kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya matangazo ya ulaghai ya kuajiri yanayodai kwa uongo kuwa ni nafasi rasmi ya kazi ya IEBC; lango pekee rasmi la kazi la Tume ni jobs.iebc.or.ke, na waombaji hawapaswi kamwe kuwasilisha taarifa binafsi kupitia viungo visivyo rasmi vya kuajiri.

English: No person may be admitted into a polling station while wearing a badge, clothing, or any symbol signifying support for a political party or candidate.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kuruhusiwa kuingia katika kituo cha kupigia kura akiwa amevaa beji, nguo, au alama yoyote inayoashiria uungwaji mkono kwa chama cha siasa au mgombea.

English: Stay alert in locations frequented by tourists/foreigners.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho katika maeneo yanayotembelewa na watalii/wageni mara kwa mara.

English: Monitor local media for updates
Kiswahili: Fuatilia vyombo vya habari vya ndani kwa ajili ya masasisho

English: Avoid protest areas and demonstrations
Kiswahili: Epuka maeneo ya maandamano na maandamano

English: Avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Epuka umati wa watu

English: Keep a low profile
Kiswahili: Weka wasifu mdogo

English: Keep doors locked and windows rolled up while in a vehicle
Kiswahili: Weka milango imefungwa na madirisha yamefungwa ukiwa ndani ya gari

English: Wanjiku Thiga: Minister Murkomen should resign because he has failed to address security issues in the country
Kiswahili: Wanjiku Thiga: Waziri Murkomen anapaswa kujiuzulu kwa sababu ameshindwa kushughulikia masuala ya usalama nchini

English: State calls for stronger cybersecurity and responsible AI governance to safeguard Kenya's digital future
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa wito wa usalama wa mtandao ulioimarishwa na utawala bora wa akili bandia ili kulinda mustakabali wa kidijitali wa Kenya

English: Former Law Society of Kenya (LSK) president Faith Odhiambo has called for urgent national action to address the rising wave of school unrest.
Kiswahili: Rais wa zamani wa Chama cha Wanasheria cha Kenya (LSK) Faith Odhiambo ametoa wito wa hatua za haraka za kitaifa kushughulikia wimbi linaloongezeka la machafuko shuleni.

English: Kenyans react to Saba Saba with fear, defiance and calls for justice
Kiswahili: Wakenya waitikia Saba Saba kwa hofu, ukaidi na waomba haki itendeke

English: Kenya transport strike paused after deadly protests
Kiswahili: Mgomo wa usafiri wa Kenya wasitishwa baada ya maandamano makubwa

English: Kenya strike over rising fuel prices pauses after mass shutdown
Kiswahili: Mgomo wa Kenya kuhusu kupanda kwa bei ya mafuta wasimama baada ya kufungwa kwa wingi

English: Karua: State failing to protect women, children from violence
Kiswahili: Karua: Serikali yashindwa kuwalinda wanawake na watoto dhidi ya ukatili

English: Kega reports to police day after alleged attack in Ol Joro Orok
Kiswahili: Kega aripoti polisi siku moja baada ya shambulio linalodaiwa kutokea Ol Joro Orok

English: One-year-old girl dies in Thinka house fire
Kiswahili: Msichana wa mwaka mmoja afariki katika moto wa nyumba ya Thinka

English: 2027 violence alert: Annan report predicts high probability of chaos
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya vurugu za 2027: Ripoti ya Annan inatabiri uwezekano mkubwa wa machafuko

English: Heavy rains in your areas may cause flash floods
Kiswahili: Mvua kubwa katika maeneo yako inaweza kusababisha mafuriko makubwa

English: Call 1199 for more inquiries
Kiswahili: Piga simu 1199 kwa maswali zaidi

English: A new bat-escaping sorghum variety developed by KALRO can cut crop losses caused by bats by as much as 90 percent in arid and semi-arid regions.

English: We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.

English: Restaurants must; 1.ensure quality & safety of food, rinse &sanitize food contact surfaces, disinfect surfaces, floors & counters. 2.Install adequate portable running water & accessible washing basins for hand washing purposes, at the entrance & exit points.

Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.

English: This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19; 1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water 2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing. 3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms
Kiswahili: Hizi ni hatua za kwanza za kulinda familia yako kutokana na Covid 19; 1. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka 2. Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kiwiko au tishu iliyokunjwa, unapokohoa au kupiga chafya. 3. Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye ana dalili za mafua au mafua.
Dholuo: Magi gin yore mokwongo mag rito joodu mondo kik giyud Covid 19; 1. Luok lweteni pile ka pile gi sabun kod pi ma ng'ich 2. Uum dhogi kod okumbo ni kata tishu, ka igoyo kata iting'o. 3. Wek tudruok machiegni gi ng'ato ang'ata man kod tuoche mag hoyo kata athung'a.

English: Alcohol and Smoking will increase the risks of having high blood pressure. While you STAY AT reduce alcohol intake and smoking.
Kiswahili: Pombe na Uvutaji Sigara vitaongeza hatari za kuwa na shinikizo la damu. Unapokaa NYUMBANI punguza unywaji wa pombe na uvutaji sigara.
Dholuo: Kongo kod madho ndawa biro medo nyalo mar bedo gi presa mamalo mar remo. Ka ibedo e ot, duok piny madho kong'o kod madho ndawa.

English: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1. Lowesha mikono 2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha 3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka 5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
Dholuo: Bed gi arita maber kuom korona. Lwoko lweteni en yo maduong' mogik mar geng'o lando tuwo. 1. Lwoko lweteni gi pi 2. Ket sabun moromo 3. Goch lweteni duto kuom sekon 20-30. 4. Luw lweteni maber gi pi moting'o 5. Luw lweteni gi nanga maler kata matiyo go dichiel.

English: How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19; 1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily. 2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Exercise 4. Meditation 5. Quality sleep

Chukua lishe yenye vioksidishaji vingi - amla, guava, mboga za majani mabichi, mchicha, kitunguu saumu, chai ya kijani, pilipili hoho, manjano 3. Mazoezi 4. Kutafakari 5. Usingizi bora

Kaw chiemo ma nigi antioxidant mang'eny - amla, guava, alode ma nigi oboke, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Timo gik matego del 4. Paro matut 5. Nindo e yor chuny

English: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.
Dholuo: Kwan matin mar ji moseyudo chanjo nyalo yudo tuo mar COVID-19 bang' yudo chanjo; mano iluongo ni tuo mar breakthrough, to nyalo bedo ni gin gi ranyisi matin moloyo ka dine bed ni ok omigi chanjo.

English: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zote za COVID-19 ni salama kwa matumizi ya watu wazima, akina mama wanaonyonyesha na kulingana na miongozo ya sasa ya WHO, zinaweza pia kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwa mapendekezo ya daktari aliyehitimu.
Dholuo: Geng'o mag COVID-19 duto ni kare ne joma dongo, mine mapidho nyithindo, kendo kaluwore gi chike mag riwruok mar piny mangima mar thieth, mon ma yach bende nyalo tiyo kodgi ka laktar okonyogi.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate from the MOH website
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mopogore mag yudo thieth ok en gima owinjore. Bang' yudo chanjo duto ibiro yudo satifiket mar COVID-19 e websait mar MOH

English: Key causes of TB include undernutrition, HIV, alcohol use disorders, smoking, and diabetes. Get the word out! We can eradicate TB together
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za Kifua Kikuu ni pamoja na lishe duni, VVU, matatizo ya matumizi ya pombe, uvutaji sigara, na kisukari. Fahamu! Tunaweza kutokomeza Kifua Kikuu pamoja

English: To get cured of TB, you must complete the entire course of treatment as advised by the health worker.
Kiswahili: Ili kupona kifua kikuu, ni lazima ukamilishe matibabu yote kama ilivyoshauriwa na mfanyakazi wa afya.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Weche madongo mag geng'o landruok mar Mpox: Kik ibed machiegni gi joma nigi ranyisi mag tuwono. Kik inyis ng'at machielo gik ma in-go, kaka togo, sende, kata lewni. Bed ng'ama ler kuom luoko lweteni kinde ka kinde.

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag Mpox oriwo tuo mar midhusi, chwat, kod chwoyo mar lymph nodes. Kapo ni ineno moro amora kuom gigo, ne laktar.

English: Mpox outbreak in Mombasa. Two people have died from Monkey Pox disease. Mombasa County has reported 98 Monkey Pox cases. There is a lot of active community transmission
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mpox Mombasa. Watu wawili wamefariki kutokana na ugonjwa wa Tumbili. Kaunti ya Mombasa imeripoti visa 98 vya Tumbili. Kuna maambukizi mengi ya kijamii yanayoendelea
Dholuo: Tuwo mar Mpox ne ochakore Mombasa. Ji ariyo osetho nikech tuo mar Monkey Pox. Kaunti mar Mombasa osechiwo ripot mar ji 98 ma nigi tuo mar Monkey Pox. Nitie kwan mang'eny mag tuoche mayudo ji e alworano

English: I have invoked the public health act after it was declared a pandemic. Thoroughly wash hands and use alcohol based sanitizers. Keep 1-meter distance from a person who is sneezing or coughing. A person who is coughing or sneezing should stay at and avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Nimeitisha sheria ya afya ya umma baada ya kutangazwa kuwa janga. Osha mikono vizuri na utumie vitakasa mikono vyenye pombe. Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa. Mtu anayekohoa au kupiga chafya anapaswa kukaa nyumbani na kuepuka misongamano ya watu.
Dholuo: Asetiyo gi chik mar thieth mar oganda bang' kane oland ni en tuwo malandore. Luok lweteni maber kendo iti gi gik ma geng'o tuoche ma nigi kong'o. Bed mita 1 mabor gi ng'at ma ng'ol kata ma ywak. Ng'at ma ywak kata ng'ol onego osik e pacho kendo kik odhi kama ji ng'enyie.

English: Kenya on high alert over new and deadly mosquito. Anopheles Stephensi causes the deadliest type of Malaria. Health re ers have found the mosquito in Mandera. Mosquito spreads Malaria in both urban and rural areas
Kiswahili: Kenya iko macho kuhusu mbu mpya na hatari. Anopheles Stephensi husababisha aina mbaya zaidi ya Malaria. Watafiti wa afya wamegundua mbu huko Mandera. Mbu hueneza Malaria katika maeneo ya mijini na vijijini
Dholuo: Piny Kenya ni e bwo rit maduong' nikech kute manyien ma nego ji mang'eny. Anopheles Stephensi en tuwo mar malaria makelo tho ahinya. Jotim nonro e weche thieth oseyudo kutego e Mandera. Tunge keyo malaria e taonde koda e gwenge

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.

English: State launches Kenya National Public Health Institute to bolster disease prevention

Dholuo: Sirkal chako Kenya National Public Health Institute mondo okony e geng'o tuoche

English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unajisikia vibaya, una mafua, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe mfupi *719#
Dholuo: Kapo ni iwinjo ka ok iwinj maber, ka ituwo, ikayo, kata ibedo gi tuwo mar ndulme, tudri gi namba 719 kata oro sms *719#

English: Kenya reports record daily jump in Covid-19 cases; 123 new infections from 3,077 samples tested.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaripoti ongezeko kubwa la visa vya Covid-19 kila siku; maambukizi mapya 123 kutoka kwa sampuli 3,077 zilizopimwa.
Dholuo: Kenya chiwo ripot mar medruok mar kwan mar joma nigi Covid-19 pile ka pile; ji 123 ma nigi tuo manyien kuom sampul 3,077 ma ne otem.

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.
Dholuo: Pesa ma itiyogo e timo nonro mar Covid-19 kod keto ji kar kendgi biro dhi ne sirkal chakre kawuono. Jo-Kenya ok onego oluor dhi e nonro

English: Announcement encouraging daily consumption of five fruit/veg portions for wellness and disease prevention.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuhimiza ulaji wa kila siku wa sehemu tano za matunda/mboga kwa ajili ya ustawi na kinga dhidi ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: Weche mag lendo majiwo ji mondo ocham olemo/olembe abich e odiechieng' mondo omi gibed gi ngima maber kendo geng'o tuoche.
