Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal koro dwaro ni ji orwak lep lak, kendo gichiw thieth e kinde ma Kenya romo gi COVID-19 mar auchiel

English: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
Kiswahili: Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid-19: Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusa vitasambazwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi. Vibanda havina mguso wowote kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda visivyogusa vinaruhusu upimaji salama na wa haraka wa wingi. Vibanda vilivyokusanyika ndani ya eneo husika vinabadilisha mchezo.
Dholuo: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Kembe mag pimo ma ok ochom gi ng'ato ibiro pog e kidienje auchiel. Kuondego onge tudruok moro amora e kind laktar kod jatuwo. Kuonde ma ok nyal tudore gi ng'ato, konyo e timo nonro mang'eny e yo mapiyo kendo maonge hinyruok. Sanduge molos e alworawa kelo lokruok maduong' ahinya

English: Malaria vaccine advisory: More children in malaria endemic counties to be vaccinated. WHO has given an approval for expanded use of the vaccine. 275,000 children partially jabbed, 45,000 are fully vaccinated. Data shows the number of malaria cases has gone down
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa chanjo ya malaria: Watoto zaidi katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na malaria watachanjwa. WHO imetoa idhini ya matumizi ya chanjo hiyo kwa upana zaidi. Watoto 275,000 wachapwa sehemu, 45,000 wamechanjwa kikamilifu. Data inaonyesha idadi ya visa vya malaria imepungua
Dholuo: Giko mar chanjo mar malaria: Nyithindo mang'eny e gwenge ma malaria opong'o ibiro chanjo. WHO osechiwo thuolo mar tiyo gi chanjo mar Corona e okang' momedore. Nyithindo 275,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona e okang' matin, kendo nyithindo 45,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona chuth. Nonro nyiso ni kwan mar joma nigi malaria osedok chien

English: We encourage people to seek treatment at health care facilities once they experience any symptoms. When you seek treatment early, you protect yourself against severe malaria.
Kiswahili: Tunawahimiza watu kutafuta matibabu katika vituo vya afya mara tu wanapopata dalili zozote. Unapotafuta matibabu mapema, unajikinga dhidi ya malaria kali.
Dholuo: Wajiwo ji mondo omany thieth e kuonde thieth mapiyo bang' fwenyo ni gin gi ranyisi mag tuwono. Ka ichako yudo thieth chon, inyalo geng'o malaria.

English: Happy World Malaria Day! Here's to raising awareness, protecting our communities, and pushing closer to a world free from malaria.
Kiswahili: Heri ya Siku ya Malaria Duniani! Hapa ni kwa ajili ya kuongeza uelewa, kulinda jamii zetu, na kusukuma karibu na ulimwengu usio na malaria.
Dholuo: Moruru Nikech Odiechieng Maler mar Piny Mangima! Wagoyo erokamano ne ji duto kuom ng'eyo, rito ogandawa, kendo medo jiwo piny maonge malaria.

English: Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you. Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kinatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha bila malipo masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki? Tupigie simu kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako. Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Usaidizi wa Kisaikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society chiwo kony maonge chudo odiechieng' gotieno? Wuo kodwa e namba 1199 mondo wakonyi. Chakre Januar-Juni 2019, riwruok marwa mar Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services ne orwako luong 513.

English: Definitition of schizophrenia,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
Kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa skizofrenia, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.
Dholuo: Tiend schizophrenia, gik makelo, ranyisi mag tuono, yore mag fwenyo tuo kod thieth.

English: Definitition of bipolar,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
Kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa bipolar, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag pimo tuwo mar bipolar, gik ma kelo tuwono, ranyisi mag tuwono, yore mag thiedho tuwono kod kaka inyalo thiedhe.

English: The US government's freeze on foreign aid, especially through USAid has caused major disruptions in Kenya's health sector, particularly in HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis programmes that heavily rely on donor support.
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa misaada ya kigeni na serikali ya Marekani, hasa kupitia USAid, kumesababisha usumbufu mkubwa katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, hasa katika programu za VVU, malaria, na kifua kikuu ambazo hutegemea sana msaada wa wafadhili.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Amerka chungo kony mag pinje mamoko, to moloyo kokalo kuom USAid, osekelo chandruok maduong' e yore mag thieth e piny Kenya, to moloyo e chenro mag thieth mag AYAKI, malaria, kod kahera ma ne otenore ahinya kuom kony mar jochiwo.

English: Malaria mortality rate rises to pre-pandemic levels, WHO report shows at least 597,000 people succumbed to the disease last year.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya WHO inaonyesha kuwa kiwango cha vifo kutokana na malaria kinaongezeka hadi viwango vya kabla ya janga, kwa mujibu wa ripoti hiyo.
Dholuo: Kwan mar joma tho nikech malaria idho malo nyaka e okang' ma ne entie kapok tuwo mar malaria ogoyo piny, ripot mar WHO nyiso ni ji ma kwan-gi ok tin ne 597,000 ne otho gi tuwono higa mokalo.

English: Kenya to release genetically modified mosquitoes to fight malaria
Kiswahili: Kenya kutoa mbu waliobadilishwa vinasaba ili kupambana na malaria
Dholuo: Kenya biro gonyo ochunglo molos gi kute mag ayaki mondo oked gi malaria

English: Scientists have found that a mosquito species blamed for malaria transmission in eastern and southern Africa has developed resistance to a long-used insecticide in the region.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wamegundua kwamba aina ya mbu inayolaumiwa kwa maambukizi ya malaria mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika imekua na upinzani dhidi ya dawa ya kuua wadudu ambayo imekuwa ikitumika kwa muda mrefu katika eneo hilo.
Dholuo: Josayans osefwenyo ni nitie kit kute moko ma miyo ji yudo malaria e pinje mag Afrika ma ugwe kod ma milambo, to sani gisenyagore gi yedhe mag nego kute ma nosebedo ka itiyogo e alworano kuom higini mang'eny.

English: Malaria mortality has fallen back to levels seen before the Covid-19 crisis, the WHO said Wednesday, but called for faster progress against the disease that killed nearly some 597,000 people last year.
Kiswahili: Vifo vya malaria vimeshuka hadi viwango vilivyoonekana kabla ya janga la Covid-19, WHO ilisema Jumatano, lakini ilitaka maendeleo ya haraka dhidi ya ugonjwa huo ulioua karibu watu 597,000 mwaka jana.
Dholuo: Kwan mar joma tho nikech malaria osedok chien nyaka e okang' ma ne entie kapok masira mar Covid-19 ochakore, mana kaka WHO nowacho chieng' Tich Adek, kata kamano, ne gikwayo mondo otim dongruok mapiyo e kedo gi tuwo ma ne onego chiegni ji 597,000 higa mokalo.

English: 36 cases of Mpox reported so far in Kenya, two persons admitted and one patient receiving -based care.
Kiswahili: Visa 36 vya Mpox vimeripotiwa hadi sasa nchini Kenya, watu wawili waliolazwa na mgonjwa mmoja anayepatiwa huduma ya nyumbani.
Dholuo: E Kenya, ji 36 oseyudo tuwo mar Mpox, ji ariyo ne orwak e osiptal to jatuwo achiel ne yudo thieth e pacho.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases in Busia; Health Ministry warns of a high risk of importing Marburg and Ebola viruses from neighboring Tanzania and Sudan.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox huko Busia; Wizara ya Afya yaonya kuhusu hatari kubwa ya kuagiza virusi vya Marburg na Ebola kutoka nchi jirani za Tanzania na Sudan.
Dholuo: Kenya nyiso ni nitie ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e Busia; Migawo mar Thieth chiwo siem ni nitie masira maduong' mar kelo tuo mar Marburg kod Ebola koa Tanzania kod Sudan.

English: Five new Mpox cases confirmed in 12 counties, including Nakuru and Mombasa, raising the total to 28; Health CS Deborah Barasa reports one death and eight under care.
Kiswahili: Visa vitano vipya vya Mpox vimethibitishwa katika kaunti 12, ikiwa ni pamoja na Nakuru na Mombasa, na kufanya jumla ya visa kufikia 28; Waziri wa Afya Deborah Barasa anaripoti kifo kimoja na wanane wakiwa chini ya uangalizi.
Dholuo: Jotuo abich manyien mag Mpox ne oyangi e gwenge 12, moriwo Nakuru kod Mombasa, ka mano miyo kwan duto mar jogo ma nigi tuwono omedore mochopo 28, Health CS Deborah Barasa wacho ni ng'at achiel ne otho kendo ji aboro ne orit.

English: Kenya's Ministry of Health has urged citizens to strictly adhere to mpox preventive measures as the number of cases continues to rise, with children being particularly vulnerable.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ya Kenya imewasihi raia kuzingatia kwa makini hatua za kinga za mpox huku idadi ya visa ikiendelea kuongezeka, huku watoto wakiwa katika hatari zaidi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Thieth e piny Kenya osekwayo raia mondo oluw ahinya yore mag geng'o tuo mar mpox nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono siko ka medore, to nyithindo e ma nigi tuwono moloyo.

English: Gov't calls for wearing of masks as country battles 6th Covid-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa huku nchi ikipambana na wimbi la 6 la Covid-19
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni ji orwak lep lak sama piny kedo gi tuwo mar 6 mar Covid-19.

English: Mandatory wearing of masks in public and open spaces is now lifted
Kiswahili: Uvaaji wa lazima wa barakoa katika maeneo ya umma na wazi sasa umeondolewa
Dholuo: Tiyo gi abuog rombee e lela kod kuonde ma ji ng'enyie koro ogol oko

English: Your health is our priority! No one should face TB alone. Get tested early and access FREE treatment at your nearest public health facility. Together, we can end TB in Kenya!
Kiswahili: Afya yako ndiyo kipaumbele chetu! Hakuna mtu anayepaswa kukabiliana na TB peke yake. Pima mapema na upate matibabu BURE katika kituo cha afya cha umma kilicho karibu nawe. Kwa pamoja, tunaweza kukomesha TB nchini Kenya!
Dholuo: Wageno ni ngimau biro bedo maber moloyo! Onge ng'ama onego okaw ting' mar kedo gi tuwo mar kahera kende owuon. Tim nonro chon kendo iyud thieth MAOK CHUL e kar thieth mar oganda machiegni kodi. Ka wariwore kanyachiel, wanyalo tieko chuth tuo mar kahera e piny Kenya!

English: By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society. If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma na uelewa zaidi. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya simu isiyolipishwa, 1199.
Dholuo: Ka wang'eyo ni joma nigi tuoche mag paro gin dhano kaka wan, wanyalo miyo oganda obed mang'won kendo mawinjo lit mar jomoko. Ka in kata ng'at ming'eyo dwaro kony mar paro, kik iluor luongowa e namba maonge nengo, 1199

English: Mental Health Check-Up Time!Mental Health Check-Up Time! Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take a moment to check in with yourself today. 1. How are you feeling emotionally? 2. Are you getting enough rest? 3. Are you eating well? 4. Have you been active lately? 5. Do you need to talk to someone? Remember, it's okay to seek help if you need it. Your mental well-being matters!
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama vile afya yako ya kimwili. Chukua muda kujichunguza leo. 1. Unajisikiaje kihisia? 2. Je, unapata mapumziko ya kutosha? 3. Je, unakula vizuri? 4. Je, umekuwa ukifanya mazoezi hivi karibuni? 5. Je, unahitaji kuzungumza na mtu? Kumbuka, ni sawa kutafuta msaada ikiwa unahitaji. Ustawi wako wa akili ni muhimu!
Dholuo: Kinde mar Nono Timbe Dhano! Kinde mar Nono Timbe Dhano Paro ma in-go kuom ngima jaodi en gima duong' mana kaka rito dendi. Kaw kinde mondo ipar matut kuom kaka ngimani chalo sani. 1. In iwinjo nade e chunyi? 2. Be inindo moromo? 3. Be ichamo chiemo moromo? 4. Be isebedo katiyo matek e tij lendo? 5. Be nitie ng'ama diher mondo awuo kode? Ng'e ni, ok rach manyo kony kapo ni in gi chandruok. Paro ma in-go e ma dwarore!

English: Safe walking and cycling contributes to healthier lives preventing Non- Communicable diseases such Cancer, diabetes and hypertension and improves ones mental health
Kiswahili: Kutembea salama na kuendesha baiskeli huchangia maisha yenye afya njema kuzuia magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama vile Saratani, kisukari na shinikizo la damu na kuboresha afya ya akili ya mtu.
Dholuo: Wuotho kendo riembo ndiga e yo maber konyo e miyo ji obed gi ngima maber, geng'o tuoche ma ok landre kaka kansa, tuwo mar sukari kod tuwo mar remo, kendo miyo ng'ato bedo gi paro maber.

English: Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health! 1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night. 2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bed they disrupt your Zzzs! Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
Kiswahili: Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili! 1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku. 2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala - vinavyovuruga hisia zako za Zzz! Zipe kipaumbele pumziko lako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!

English: Sports and exercise offer a multifaceted approach to preventing substance use during school breaks. They provide structure, boost mental health, foster social connections and help students build healthy habits that protect against risky behaviors
Kiswahili: Michezo na mazoezi hutoa mbinu mbalimbali za kuzuia matumizi ya dawa za kulevya wakati wa mapumziko ya shule. Hutoa muundo, huimarisha afya ya akili, hukuza miunganisho ya kijamii na huwasaidia wanafunzi kujenga tabia zenye afya zinazowalinda dhidi ya tabia hatarishi.
Dholuo: 2. Paro ma in-go kuom wachni nikare.

English: Fuel your body, feed your mind! What you eat, how you move, and what you avoid directly shapes your mental health. Choose clean eating, stay active, and say NO to harmful substances. Your future self will thank you!
Kiswahili: Tia nguvu mwili wako, lisha akili yako! Kile unachokula, jinsi unavyotembea, na kile unachoepuka huunda moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili. Chagua kula safi, endelea kufanya mazoezi, na useme HAPANA kwa vitu vyenye madhara. Utu wako wa baadaye utakushukuru!
Dholuo: Bed ni en parruok, parruok mang'eny, parruok, kata mana winjo ka chunyi onyosore ahinya, parruok nyalo ketho pach ng'ato. Wuo gi osiepni migeno, kata ng'at moro manyalo konyi gi paro. Kwayo kony en gima nyiso ni ng'ato nigi teko, to ok ni ng'ato oloyo nyawadgi.

English: Stressed about money? Dont gamble with your mental health! When finances feel overwhelming, its tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance usebut these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits. Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili: Una msongo wa mawazo kuhusu pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili! Wakati fedha zinapozidi, inakuvutia kutafuta "suluhisho la haraka" kama vile kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya - lakini hizi hufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa. Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho bora badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.
Dholuo: In bende in mana dhano. Owinjore wariwgi lwedo. Ok in kendi".

English: Communities can come together to support individuals facing both mental health issues and substance use challenges through several strategies
Kiswahili: Jamii zinaweza kukusanyika pamoja ili kuwasaidia watu wanaokabiliwa na matatizo ya afya ya akili na changamoto za matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kupitia mikakati kadhaa.
Dholuo: Dibed ni chandruogeni en pesa? Kik ibed ng'ama chich gi paro ma ok owinjore!

English: Ensure there are confidential channels for employees to seek mental health support without fear of retaliation or judgment
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuna njia za siri kwa wafanyakazi kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili bila hofu ya kulipiza kisasi au hukumu.
Dholuo: Mon nyalo romo gi pek moko makende e yudo thieth, moriwo ting' mag rito nyithindo, pek mag yuto, kod luoro mar wichkuot, manyalo ketho pachgi.

English: Womens mental health can be influenced by hormonal changes related to the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and menopause. Substance use can disrupt these hormonal balances, potentially intensifying mental health symptoms
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ya wanawake inaweza kuathiriwa na mabadiliko ya homoni yanayohusiana na mzunguko wa hedhi, ujauzito, na kukoma hedhi. Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya yanaweza kuvuruga mizania hii ya homoni, na hivyo kuongeza dalili za afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Dhano manie alwora nyalo riwore kanyachiel mondo gikony joma nigi tuoche mag paro koda joma tiyo gi yedhe mamero kokalo kuom yore mopogore opogore

English: Long-term substance use can impair cognitive functions such as memory and decision-making, which can further complicate mental health issues and affect daily functioning
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kwa muda mrefu yanaweza kuathiri utendaji kazi wa utambuzi kama vile kumbukumbu na kufanya maamuzi, ambayo yanaweza kuzidisha matatizo ya afya ya akili na kuathiri utendaji kazi wa kila siku.
Dholuo: Joma ondiko ji tich nyalo fwenyo ranyisi mag tuoche mag paro ka gineno lokruok ma ji timo e timbegi, kaka bedo maonge e tich pile, bedo gi tich matin, kata weyo tudruok gi jowetegi.

English: Look at your family history of mental illness and addiction, several studies have shown that this disease tends to run in the family, but can be prevented. The more you are aware of your biological, environmental and physical risk factors the more likely you are to overcome them
Kiswahili: Angalia historia ya familia yako ya ugonjwa wa akili na uraibu, tafiti kadhaa zimeonyesha kuwa ugonjwa huu huwa unaenea katika familia, lakini unaweza kuzuiwa. Kadiri unavyofahamu zaidi mambo yako ya hatari ya kibiolojia, kimazingira na kimwili, ndivyo unavyozidi kuwa na uwezekano wa kuyashinda.
Dholuo: Non ane chal mar joodu kodok korka tuoche mag paro koda tiyo gi yedhe mamero, nonro mang'eny osenyiso ni tuwoni en tuwo mayudore e anyuola, kata kamano inyalo geng'e. Kaka imedo ng'eyo gigo manyalo hinyo ngimani, e kaka imedo bedo gi nyalo mar kedo kodgi

English: Expectant mothers are urged to start antenatal care visits during the first trimester of pregnancy to monitor both mother and babys health. Early check-ups help identify risks and ensure safe delivery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanahimizwa kuanza ziara za utunzaji wa ujauzito wakati wa miezi mitatu ya kwanza ya ujauzito ili kufuatilia afya ya mama na mtoto. Uchunguzi wa mapema husaidia kutambua hatari na kuhakikisha kujifungua salama.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mine mapod nie ich mondo ochak dhi e osiptal e dweche adek mokwongo kapok onyuol nyathi mondo ging'e chal mar min nyathi koda mar nyathine. Nono janyuol chon konyo e fwenyo hinyruok manyalo betie kendo miyo onyuol maber.

English: Health centers are offering free iron and folic acid supplements to all pregnant women to prevent anemia and birth defects. Visit your nearest facility today.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya vinatoa virutubisho vya chuma na foliki bila malipo kwa wanawake wote wajawazito ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu na kasoro za kuzaliwa. Tembelea kituo kilicho karibu nawe leo.
Dholuo: Ute thieth chiwo gige thieth mag chuma kod folic acid ne mine duto ma nigi ich mondo okonygi geng'o tuo mar anemia kod nyuol gi tuoche moko. Dhi e osiptal manie machiegni kodi.

English: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
Kiswahili: Uzazi wote unapaswa kufanywa na wakunga wenye ujuzi katika vituo vya afya. Hii inahakikisha uzazi salama na huduma ya haraka iwapo kutatokea matatizo.
Dholuo: Nyithindo duto onego onyuol gi joma olony e weche mag thieth. Timo kamano miyo nyuol bedo maonge hinyruok kendo rito janyuol mapiyo kapo ni nitie chandruok moro.

English: Mothers are advised to exclusively breastfeed their babies for the first six months without giving water or food. Breastmilk provides all the nutrients and protection a baby needs.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanashauriwa kuwanyonyesha watoto wao pekee kwa miezi sita ya kwanza bila kuwapa maji au chakula. Maziwa ya mama hutoa virutubisho na ulinzi wote ambao mtoto anahitaji.
Dholuo: Inyiso mine mondo opidh nyithindgi mana gi chak mar minegi kuom dweche auchiel mokwongo, maok gimiyogi pi kata chiemo. Kodhi mar miyo miyo miyo nyathi chiemo koda ritruok madwarore.

English: Caregivers should follow the national immunization schedule to protect children against deadly diseases such as measles, polio, and tuberculosis.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kufuata ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari kama vile surua, polio, na kifua kikuu.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego oluw chenro moketi mar kano yedhe mag geng'o tuoche kaka, ayaki, polio, kod kahera.

English: Pregnant women should seek immediate care if they experience severe headaches, swelling, blurred vision, or bleeding. These may be signs of serious complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kutafuta huduma ya haraka ikiwa watapata maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, kutoona vizuri, au kutokwa na damu. Hizi zinaweza kuwa ishara za matatizo makubwa.
Dholuo: Mon man gi ich onego omany kony mapiyo kapo ni giwinjo wich malit, giwinjo ka dendgi ng'ich, gineno gik moko e yo ma ok nenre maler, kata ka remo wuok. Mago nyalo bedo ranyisi mag tuoche madongo.

English: Mothers and newborns should attend postnatal check-ups within 48 hours after birth to detect any complications and promote healthy recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama na watoto wachanga wanapaswa kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa baada ya kujifungua ndani ya saa 48 baada ya kujifungua ili kugundua matatizo yoyote na kukuza afya njema.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo kaachiel gi nyithindo ma eka oa nyuol onego odhi one janyuolgi bang' nyuolgi bang' seche 48 mondo gine ni onge midekre manyalo bedoe kendo mondo omi janyuol ong'e ni nyathine dhi maber.

English: Pregnant women are encouraged to sleep under insecticide-treated nets and take preventive medication to avoid malaria, which poses risks to both mother and baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanahimizwa kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu na kutumia dawa za kuzuia malaria ili kuepuka malaria, ambayo inahatarisha maisha ya mama na mtoto.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mon ma yach mondo onind e bwo net ma osetwang' gi yedhe mag nego kute kendo mondo gikaw yedhe mag geng'o malaria, ma en tuwo manyalo hinyo mama koda nyathi.

English: Pregnant women should consume a balanced diet rich in iron, protein, and vitamins to support fetal development and maternal health.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula lishe bora yenye madini ya chuma, protini, na vitamini ili kusaidia ukuaji wa fetasi na afya ya mama.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach onego ocham chiemo moting'o gik mang'eny kaka iron, protein, kod vitamin mondo okony nyathi mapok onyuol kod min mare obed gi ngima maber.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind 1 gi 5 onego ogol kudni e dendgi bang' dweche auchiel ka dweche auchiel, mondo ogeng' tuwo mar kute manyalo kelo kech koda dongo e okang' mamalo.

English: Caregivers are advised to keep the umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply substances like ash or herbs as they may cause infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanashauriwa kuweka kitovu kikiwa safi na kikavu. Usipake vitu kama majivu au mimea kwani vinaweza kusababisha maambukizi.
Dholuo: Ijiwo joma rito jatuo mondo obed maler kendo obed kama otwo. Kik iti gi gik machalo gi buru kata yath moro amora nikech ginyalo kelo tuoche.

English: Communities should educate and support adolescents to avoid early pregnancies through life skills, counseling, and access to reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwaelimisha na kuwasaidia vijana kuepuka mimba za mapema kupitia ujuzi wa maisha, ushauri nasaha, na upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya uzazi.
Dholuo: Pinje onego opuonj kendo okony rowere ma rowere mondo kik gikaw ich e kinde ma pod gitindo kokalo kuom lony e ngima, kony, kod yudo yore mag thieth mag nyuol.

English: Children under five should receive vitamin A drops every six months to boost immunity and reduce child mortality.
Kiswahili: Watoto walio chini ya miaka mitano wanapaswa kupokea matone ya vitamini A kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuongeza kinga na kupunguza vifo vya watoto.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma johigini abich kadok chien onego ocham vitamin A bang' dweche auchiel ka dweche auchiel, mondo okonygi geng'o tuoche kendo geng'o nyithindo kik tho.

English: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kuwashughulikia watoto, baada ya kubadilisha nepi, na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego olwok lwetegi gi sabun kapok gimako nyithindo, bang' loko popegi, kendo kapok gichiemo mondo kik giyud tuoche.

English: Fast breathing and chest indrawing in children may signal pneumonia. Seek medical care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kupumua haraka na kuvuta kifua kwa watoto kunaweza kuashiria nimonia. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja.
Dholuo: Yueyo mar muya e yo mapiyo kod bedo gi rem e kor nyithindo nyalo nyiso ni gin gi tuwo mar nyumonia. Dwar mapiyo thieth.

English: Pregnant women living with HIV should attend clinic early to receive antiretroviral therapy and prevent transmission to the baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanaoishi na VVU wanapaswa kuhudhuria kliniki mapema ili kupata tiba ya kupunguza makali ya virusi vya ukimwi na kuzuia maambukizi kwa mtoto.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach ma nigi AYAKI onego odhi e klinik chon mondo oyud thieth mar anti- retroviral kendo geng'o nyathinino kik yud tuwono.

English: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach e trimester mar ariyo onego oyud yedhe mag geng'o kute mag kute mondo omi gimed chamo chiemo maber kendo geng'o midekre.

English: New mothers are encouraged to discuss family planning options with health providers to allow proper spacing of pregnancies and ensure maternal recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanahimizwa kujadili chaguzi za uzazi wa mpango na watoa huduma za afya ili kuruhusu nafasi nzuri ya ujauzito na kuhakikisha mama anaendelea kupona.
Dholuo: Miyo mapod nyien ijiwo mondo owuo kod joma chiwo thieth e wi yore mag chano mar bedo gi nyithindo mondo omi gibed gi thuolo mowinjore e kind ich kod nyuol, kendo mondo gibed gadier ni minegi biro chango.

English: At six months, introduce soft, nutrient-rich foods while continuing breastfeeding. Avoid sugary snacks and ensure hygiene during feeding.
Kiswahili: Katika miezi sita, mtangulie vyakula laini na vyenye virutubisho vingi huku ukiendelea kunyonyesha. Epuka vitafunio vyenye sukari na hakikisha usafi wakati wa kunyonyesha.
Dholuo: Ka en ja dweche auchiel, chak miye chiemo mayom kendo maber, ka pod idhi nyime pidho nyathino gi min. Kik ucham chiemo moting'o sukari mang'eny kendo rituru ler e kinde ma upidho nyithindu.

English: Pregnant women should receive tetanus toxoid vaccination to protect themselves and their babies from neonatal tetanus.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kupata chanjo ya pepopunda ili kujikinga na watoto wao kutokana na pepopunda ya watoto wachanga.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach onego ocham yadh anti-tetanus toxoid mondo oritgi kaachiel gi nyithindgi kuom tuo mar tetanus.

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.
Dholuo: Mon ma eka obedo mine, ma chunygi onyosore, ma chunygi ool, kata ma chunygi ool, onego omany kony e weche thieth. Chandruok mabedoe bang' nyuol inyalo thiedhi.

English: Mothers who express breast milk should ensure clean containers, proper refrigeration, and correct warming procedures to prevent contamination.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaokamua maziwa ya mama wanapaswa kuhakikisha vyombo vinasafishwa, vinahifadhiwa vizuri kwenye jokofu, na taratibu sahihi za kupasha joto ili kuzuia uchafuzi.
Dholuo: Minegi ma gidhiro chak onego orit mondo gik ma gipidhogo chak obed maler, giketgi e frij maber, kendo giketgi e ot ma ok okethore mondo kik gikethre.

English: A high fever in a child could be a sign of malaria or infection. Visit the nearest clinic without delay to prevent complications.
Kiswahili: Homa kali kwa mtoto inaweza kuwa ishara ya malaria au maambukizi. Tembelea kliniki iliyo karibu bila kuchelewa ili kuzuia matatizo.
Dholuo: Ka nyathi nigi tuo mar midhusi kata malaria, mano nyalo nyiso ni en gi kute moko. Dhi mapiyo e klinik man machiegni kodi mondo kik iyud chandruok.

English: Postpartum women should take deworming medication to improve nutrition and milk quality.
Kiswahili: Wanawake baada ya kujifungua wanapaswa kutumia dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na ubora wa maziwa.
Dholuo: Mon ma osenyuol bang' nyuol onego omadh yedhe mag geng'o kute mag kute mondo omi gimed chamo chiemo maber kendo miyo chak obed mang'ich.

English: Sleeping under insecticide-treated nets protects expectant mothers and their unborn babies from malaria.
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa dawa za kuua wadudu huwalinda akina mama wajawazito na watoto wao ambao hawajazaliwa kutokana na malaria.
Dholuo: Nindo e bwo net mosewir gi kute mag nego kutego rito mine mapod ni e ich koda nyithindgi mapok onyuol kuom malaria.

English: Swollen feet, thin limbs, or constant fatigue in a child may be signs of malnutrition. Seek help immediately.
Kiswahili: Miguu iliyovimba, miguu myembamba, au uchovu wa kila mara kwa mtoto inaweza kuwa dalili za utapiamlo. Tafuta msaada mara moja.
Dholuo: Tiend nyathi ma nigi tuwo mar ndulme, tiendene kod tiendene ma nyosore, kata ma ool pile, nyalo nyiso ni ok ochiem maber. Dwar kony mapiyo.

English: Do not apply substances to the cord. Keep it dry and clean until it falls off naturally.
Kiswahili: Usipake vitu kwenye kamba. Iweke kavu na safi hadi ianguke kiasili.
Dholuo: Kik iti gi gimoro amora e ng'ulo nanga. Ketgi kama otwo kendo gibed maler nyaka chop kama gipodho.

English: Always keep your childs health card and birth certificate safe for school, healthcare, and legal needs.
Kiswahili: Daima weka kadi ya afya ya mtoto wako na cheti cha kuzaliwa salama kwa mahitaji ya shule, huduma ya afya, na kisheria.
Dholuo: Kinde duto kan nyithindo kad mar thieth kod satifiket mar nyuol maber ne skunde, thieth, kod weche mag chike.

English: Teen mothers should be encouraged and supported to continue their education after childbirth.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wanapaswa kutiwa moyo na kuungwa mkono ili kuendelea na masomo yao baada ya kujifungua.
Dholuo: Onego ojiw kendo okony mine ma rowere mondo odhi nyime gi sombgi bang' nyuol.

English: Expectant mothers are strongly advised to avoid all alcohol. Drinking during pregnancy can lead to fetal alcohol syndrome and developmental delays.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanashauriwa sana kuepuka pombe kabisa. Kunywa pombe wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha ugonjwa wa pombe ya fetasi na kuchelewa kwa ukuaji.
Dholuo: Ijiwo ahinya mine ma yach ni kik gimadh kong'o e yo moro amora. Madho kong'o e kinde ma dhako omako ich nyalo miyo nyathi ma eka oa nyuol obed gi chandruok mar madho kong'o mokalo tong' kendo miyo dongo mar nyathino odog chien.

English: Yellowing of the skin and eyes in newborns should be checked by a health worker. Severe jaundice can affect brain development.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na rangi ya njano kwenye ngozi na macho kwa watoto wachanga kunapaswa kuchunguzwa na mfanyakazi wa afya. Homa kali ya manjano inaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa ubongo.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma eka oa nyuol onego one ni dendgi kod wengegi olokore mar rachar. Tuwo mar jaundice nyalo ketho kaka obwongo dongo.

English: Caregivers should change diapers frequently and clean the babys skin gently to avoid rashes and infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kubadilisha nepi mara kwa mara na kusafisha ngozi ya mtoto kwa upole ili kuepuka vipele na maambukizi.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyathi onego olokie lewni kinde ka kinde kendo lwoko dende mos mondo kik obed gi mbala kata yudo tuoche.

English: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula milo midogo mara kadhaa kwa siku ili kudhibiti kichefuchefu na kudumisha viwango vya nishati.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego ocham chiemo matin nyading'eny e odiechieng' mondo omi ginyagre gi wich bar kendo rito teko ma gin-go.

English: Children struggling to speak or recognize sounds may have learning difficulties. Seek assessment from child specialists early.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaojitahidi kuzungumza au kutambua sauti wanaweza kuwa na matatizo ya kujifunza. Tafuta tathmini kutoka kwa wataalamu wa watoto mapema.
Dholuo: Nyithindo matemo ahinya wuoyo kata ng'eyo kit dwol moko nyalo bedo gi pek mar puonjruok. Tem manyo kony kuom lakteche molony e weche mag nyithindo.

English: Babies should never be exposed to cigarette smoke. Secondhand smoke increases the risk of asthma and sudden infant death syndrome.
Kiswahili: Watoto wachanga hawapaswi kamwe kuathiriwa na moshi wa sigara. Moshi wa sigara unaotoka kwa mtu mwingine huongeza hatari ya pumu na ugonjwa wa kifo cha ghafla cha watoto wachanga.
Dholuo: Nyithindo matindo ok onego owang' gi iro mar ndawa. Madho ndawa bende nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud asthma kod sudden infant death syndrome.

English: Handwashing with soap before feeding and after diaper changes prevents infections in children and mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kulisha na baada ya kubadilisha nepi huzuia maambukizi kwa watoto na akina mama.
Dholuo: Luok lwedo gi sabun kapok ochako pidho nyathi koda bang' loko lewni ma nyithindo tiyogo konyo e geng'o tuoche kuom nyithindo koda mine.

English: Keeping newborns in skin-to-skin contact with mothers helps regulate temperature, heartbeat, and supports immune development.
Kiswahili: Kuwaweka watoto wachanga katika mgusano wa ngozi na mama husaidia kudhibiti halijoto, mapigo ya moyo, na kusaidia ukuaji wa kinga mwilini.
Dholuo: Keto nyithindo mapod tindo machiegni gi minegi konyo e miyo dendgi obed gi liet mowinjore, miyo chunygi ok bi goyo matek, kendo konyo e miyo dendgi obed gi nyalo mar kedo gi tuoche.

English: Pregnant women should start antenatal care in the first trimester to detect and manage any health concerns early.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kuanza huduma ya ujauzito katika trimester ya kwanza ili kugundua na kudhibiti matatizo yoyote ya kiafya mapema.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego ochak thieth kapok onyuolgi e trimester mokwongo mar nyuol, mondo omi ofweny kendo thiedh tuoche ma kamago e kinde mowinjore.

English: Working mothers can express and store breast milk to ensure continued breastfeeding support while away.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaofanya kazi wanaweza kukamua na kuhifadhi maziwa ya mama ili kuhakikisha unyonyeshaji unaoendelea wakiwa mbali.
Dholuo: Mine matiyo nyalo olo kendo kano chak mondo omi gibed gi nyalo mar medo pidho nyithindgi ka gin mabor gi dala.

English: Taking time for yourself is not a luxury, it's a necessity. Remember to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua muda kwa ajili yako mwenyewe si anasa, ni lazima. Kumbuka kuweka kipaumbele kwa afya yako ya kiakili, kihisia, na kimwili.
Dholuo: Bedo gi thuolo mar timo gik moko en gima dwarore ahinya. Ng'e ni, rito pachi, chunyi, koda dendi en gima dwarore ahinya.

English: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15-29 year olds? Its time to raise awareness and support mental health.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kujiua ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo miongoni mwa vijana wa miaka 15-29? Ni wakati wa kuongeza uelewa na kusaidia afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni inegruok e gima duong' mar adek makelo tho ne joma hikgi nie kind 15 gi 29? Magi e kinde mag medo ng'eyo e wi tuoche mag paro kendo konyogi.

English: Take care of your mental health by practicing self-care, maintaining healthy relationships, and seeking professional help when needed
Kiswahili: Tunza afya yako ya akili kwa kujitunza, kudumisha mahusiano mazuri, na kutafuta msaada wa kitaalamu inapohitajika
Dholuo: Rit pachi kuom bedo ng'at ma dewo jowetene, bedo gi winjruok maber gi jomoko, kendo manyo kony kuom lakteche

English: May is a reminder to prioritize self-care and nurture your mental health. Practice mindfulness, engage in activities that bring you joy, and seek support when needed
Kiswahili: Mei ni ukumbusho wa kuweka kipaumbele utunzaji wa kibinafsi na kukuza afya yako ya akili. Fanya mazoezi ya kuzingatia, shiriki katika shughuli zinazokuletea furaha, na utafute msaada inapohitajika.
Dholuo: Dwe mar Mei paronwa mondo waket ritruok kod paro e yo maduong' moloyo. Bed ng'at ma keto pache kuom gik ma dwarore, tim gik ma keloni mor, kendo many kony sama mano dwarore

English: Mothers should return for postnatal checkups within 48 hours, 7 days, and 6 weeks after delivery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanapaswa kurudi kwa uchunguzi baada ya kujifungua ndani ya saa 48, siku 7, na wiki 6 baada ya kujifungua.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo onego odog e osiptal bang' seche 48, ndalo 7, kod jumbe 6 bang' nyuol.

English: Daily iron supplements help prevent anemia in pregnancy and ensure healthy fetal development.
Kiswahili: Virutubisho vya chuma vya kila siku husaidia kuzuia upungufu wa damu wakati wa ujauzito na kuhakikisha ukuaji mzuri wa fetasi.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato omedo nyadundo pile ka pile, mano biro geng'o tuo mar anemia e kinde ma dhako nie ich kendo biro miyo nyathine odong maber.

English: Some traditional herbs can be harmful during pregnancy. Always consult a qualified health worker before use.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya mimea ya kitamaduni inaweza kuwa na madhara wakati wa ujauzito. Daima wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya aliyehitimu kabla ya kutumia.
Dholuo: Nitie yedhe moko ma ji tiyogo ahinya e thieth to ginyalo hinyo ng'ato ka en gi ich. Kinde duto, penj laktar molony kapok itiyo kode.

English: Breastfeeding is natural and should be supported in public. Communities should offer safe, clean spaces for mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunyonyesha ni jambo la kawaida na linapaswa kuungwa mkono hadharani. Jamii zinapaswa kutoa nafasi salama na safi kwa akina mama.
Dholuo: Nyithindo yudo thuolo mar miyo jonyuolgi mana chiemo kende, to mano en gima dwarore ahinya. Alwora ma ji odakie onego obed kama ler kendo ma onge hinyruok ne mine.

English: At six months, introduce soft foods while continuing to breastfeed. Ensure food is safe, nutritious, and age-appropriate.
Kiswahili: Katika miezi sita, anza kula vyakula laini huku ukiendelea kunyonyesha. Hakikisha chakula ni salama, chenye lishe, na kinafaa kwa umri.
Dholuo: Ka en ja dweche auchiel, chak miye chiemo mayom ka pod idhi nyime pidho nyathino gi min. Tem neno ni chiemo ma ichiwo nigi chiemb chuny, ok oketh del, kendo owinjore gi hik ng'ato.

English: Teenage mothers are at higher risk of complications. Encourage young girls to stay in school and delay pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wako katika hatari kubwa ya kupata matatizo. Wahimize wasichana wadogo kuendelea na shule na kuchelewesha ujauzito.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma mine ma pod rowere nyalo bedo gi tuoche mang'eny. Jiw nyiri matindo mondo odhi nyime gi skul kendo giduok nyuol chien.

English: Mothers should receive vitamin A after delivery to boost immunity and improve breast milk quality.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanapaswa kupokea vitamini A baada ya kujifungua ili kuongeza kinga na kuboresha ubora wa maziwa ya mama.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo onego oyud vitamin A bang' nyuol mondo omi ogeng' tuoche kendo omed miyo pi ma dhakono dhodho obed maber.

English: Wrap babies in warm clothes and avoid exposing them to cold air, especially in early months.
Kiswahili: Wafunge watoto nguo za joto na epuka kuwaweka kwenye hewa baridi, hasa katika miezi ya mwanzo.
Dholuo: Bed gi lewni maliet mondo irwakgi, kendo kik iketgi kama ng'ich ahinya, to moloyo e dweche mokwongo.

English: Foods like beans, greens, and liver prevent anemia and support child development.
Kiswahili: Vyakula kama vile maharagwe, mboga za majani, na ini huzuia upungufu wa damu na husaidia ukuaji wa mtoto.
Dholuo: Chiemo machalo kaka oganda, alode, koda makate, geng'o rem mar remo kendo konyo dongo mar nyathi.

English: Store sharp, toxic, or breakable items out of childrens reach to prevent injuries.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi vitu vyenye ncha kali, sumu, au vinavyoweza kuvunjika mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha.
Dholuo: Geng' gik ma nyalo ng'ado, ma nigi sum, kata ma nyalo kethore mayot mondo nyithindo kik hinyre.

English: Employers should provide breastfeeding breaks and spaces to support maternal and child health.
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanapaswa kutoa mapumziko ya kunyonyesha na nafasi ili kusaidia afya ya mama na mtoto.
Dholuo: Jotich onego ochiw thuolo mag yueyo kod kuonde ma nyithindo nyalo nindoe mondo okonygi rito ngima mine kod nyithindgi.

English: Community forums help address cultural barriers and promote health-seeking behavior among mothers.
Kiswahili: Mabaraza ya jamii husaidia kushughulikia vikwazo vya kitamaduni na kukuza tabia ya kutafuta afya miongoni mwa akina mama.
Dholuo: Chokruoge ma kamago konyo e tieko ywaruok mantie e kind ogendini, kendo miyo mine bedo gi timbe mabeyo makonyogi rito ngimagi.

English: Always use boiled or treated water when preparing infant food to prevent diarrhea.
Kiswahili: Tumia maji yaliyochemshwa au yaliyotibiwa kila wakati unapoandaa chakula cha watoto wachanga ili kuzuia kuhara.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, ti gi pi moketie chumbi kata pi motimgo yath sama iloso chiemo ne nyithindo matindo mondo ogeng'o tuwo mar nyolruok.

English: Each child must have a vaccination card. Keep it safe and bring it to every health visit.
Kiswahili: Kila mtoto lazima awe na kadi ya chanjo. Itunze salama na uipeleke kwenye kila ziara ya afya.
Dholuo: Nyathi ka nyathi nyaka bed gi kad mar chanjo. Ritgi maber kendo kelgi e kinde duto mag thieth.

English: Tight clothes can interfere with circulation and cause discomfort. Choose loose, breathable attire.
Kiswahili: Nguo zinazobana zinaweza kuingilia mzunguko wa damu na kusababisha usumbufu. Chagua mavazi legevu na yanayoweza kupumuliwa.
Dholuo: Lewni mapek nyalo mono remo ringo maber e del kendo miyo ng'ato owinj marach. Bed gi lewni morwakore maber.

English: Applying herbs or substances to the babys soft spot is dangerous and should be avoided.
Kiswahili: Kupaka mimea au vitu kwenye sehemu laini ya mtoto ni hatari na kunapaswa kuepukwa.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yedhe kata gik mamoko e yo marach nyalo kelo hinyruok ne nyathi, omiyo ok onego otim kamano.

English: Keep hot drinks and cooking pots away from childrens reach to prevent burn injuries.
Kiswahili: Weka vinywaji vya moto na vyungu vya kupikia mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha ya kuungua.
Dholuo: Geng' gik mimadho maliet koda agulni kik chop kama nyithindo nyalo chopoe mondo kik giwang'.

English: Use a calendar or reminder app to keep track of ANC appointments and medications.
Kiswahili: Tumia kalenda au programu ya ukumbusho ili kufuatilia miadi na dawa za ANC.
Dholuo: Ti gi kalenda kata app mar paro mondo ing'e seche mag ANC kod yedhe mitiyogo.

English: Protect your babys hearing by keeping them away from loud environments.
Kiswahili: Linda usikivu wa mtoto wako kwa kumzuia asisikie mazingira yenye kelele.
Dholuo: Rit it nyithindi kuom ritogi kik giwinj koko.

English: Excessive screen use affects attention and sleep in young children. Encourage physical play instead.
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya skrini kupita kiasi huathiri umakini na usingizi kwa watoto wadogo. Himiza kucheza kimwili badala yake.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi kompyuta e yo mokalo tong' nyalo mono nyithindo bedo motang' kendo ketho nindo. Kar mano, jiwgi mondo gitim gik ma kelonegi mor.

English: Secondhand smoke harms both the mother and the unborn baby. Keep s and public spaces smoke-free.
Kiswahili: Moshi wa mtu mwingine hudhuru mama na mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa. Weka nyumba na maeneo ya umma bila moshi.
Dholuo: Madho ndawa hinyo miyo ngima bedo matek ne dhako kod nyathine mapok onyuol. Kik ibed gi tim mar madho ndawa e odi kata kamoro amora.

English: All medications should be kept out of reach to prevent accidental poisoning in children.
Kiswahili: Dawa zote zinapaswa kuwekwa mbali na watoto ili kuzuia sumu ya bahati mbaya.
Dholuo: Yore duto mag thieth onego oket kama nyithindo ok nyal chopoe mondo kik gichiw tuoche ne nyithindo.

English: Expectant mothers should pack a clean birth kit by the 7th month of pregnancy for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanapaswa kufunga vifaa vya kujifungulia vilivyo safi ifikapo mwezi wa 7 wa ujauzito kwa dharura.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego oting' gik moko maler mag nyuol kapok ochopo dwe mar 7 mar nyuol, mondo okonygi e kinde mag masira.

English: Never shake a baby. It can cause brain injury or death. Comfort them gently instead.
Kiswahili: Usimtikise mtoto kamwe. Inaweza kusababisha jeraha la ubongo au kifo. Badala yake mfariji kwa upole.
Dholuo: Kik iling' nyathino. Onyalo kelo hinyruok ne obwongo kata tho. Kar mano, jiwgi gi weche mang'won.

English: Always wash and boil baby bottles and nipples to kill germs before each use
Kiswahili: Osha na chemsha chupa za watoto na chuchu kila wakati ili kuua vijidudu kabla ya kila matumizi.
Dholuo: Pile, lwok kendo ilwok chupa mag nyithindo koda tong' mag nyuol mondo omi ineg kute kapok itiyo kodgi

English: Use proper baby carriers to support babys neck and hips. Always ensure babys face is visible and uncovered.
Kiswahili: Tumia vifaa vya kubeba mtoto vinavyofaa ili kushikilia shingo na nyonga za mtoto. Hakikisha uso wa mtoto unaonekana na haujafunikwa.
Dholuo: Ti gi gik ma ting'o nyithindo mondo okonygi ting'o ng'utgi kod ofunjgi. Kinde duto, ne ni wang' nyathi nenore maler kendo ok oum.

English: Delay bathing a newborn for at least 24 hours to protect the skins natural defenses.
Kiswahili: Chelewesha kumwogesha mtoto mchanga kwa angalau saa 24 ili kulinda kinga asilia za ngozi.
Dholuo: Ket thuolo moromo ne nyathi ma eka oa nyuol mondo oyud pi kuom seche 24, mondo omi orit ringre.

English: Persistent nausea and vomiting during pregnancy can lead to dehydration and weight loss. Seek medical care.
Kiswahili: Kichefuchefu na kutapika mara kwa mara wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha upungufu wa maji mwilini na kupunguza uzito. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu.
Dholuo: Chuny ma ng'ichno koda ng'ur ma siko ka dhi nyime e kinde ma dhako nie ich, nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi tuwo mar dehydration, kendo onyalo lalo kilo. Dhi e osiptal mapiyo.

English: Wash hands with soap and water before handling a baby to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Osha mikono kwa sabuni na maji kabla ya kumshika mtoto ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Dholuo: Luok lweteni gi sabun kod pi kapok iloso nyathi mondo ogeng' tuoche.

English: Excessive bleeding after childbirth is life-threatening. Seek immediate emergency care.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu nyingi baada ya kujifungua kunahatarisha maisha. Tafuta huduma ya dharura mara moja.
Dholuo: Rembruok mokalo tong' bang' nyuol en gima nyalo kelo tho. Dwar mapiyo jogo manyalo hinyi.

English: A community cooking contests elevate indigenous nutritious dishes and household dietary knowledge.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya upishi wa jamii huinua vyakula vyenye lishe vya asili na ujuzi wa lishe ya nyumbani.
Dholuo: Kinda mar loso chiemo e alworawa miyo ji ng'eyo kit chiemo ma ne yudore e alworano, kendo mano miyo joot bedo gi lony e weche mag chiemo.

English: Jerky movements or eye twitching in newborns may indicate seizures. Seek urgent care.
Kiswahili: Miendo mikali au kutetemeka kwa macho kwa watoto wachanga kunaweza kuonyesha kifafa. Tafuta huduma ya haraka.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma eka oa nyuol ka ging'iyore kata ka wengegi chwanyore, nyalo nyiso ni gin gi tuwo mar ndulme. Many kony mapiyo.

English: Households should provide safe, low-level toilets to encourage hygiene in toddlers.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinapaswa kutoa vyoo salama na vya kiwango cha chini ili kuhimiza usafi kwa watoto wachanga.
Dholuo: Joot onego ochiw kuonde yweyo ma nigi pi ma ni piny mondo gijiw ler e kind nyithindo matindo.

English: State Department unveils pilot of e-voucher and digital tools to monitor input delivery, production and dietary outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje yazindua majaribio ya vocha za kielektroniki na zana za kidijitali ili kufuatilia utoaji wa pembejeo, uzalishaji na matokeo ya lishe.
Dholuo: Migawo mar piny owacho olero chenro mar tiyo gi e-voucher kod gige tich mag digital e nono kaka gik mitiyogo e loso chiemo tiyo, kod kaka chiemo ng'eny.

English: Nutrition Portal invites submissions recognising counties reporting CNAP outcomes under the new monitoring framework.
Kiswahili: Lango la Lishe linaalika mawasilisho yanayotambua kaunti zinazoripoti matokeo ya CNAP chini ya mfumo mpya wa ufuatiliaji.
Dholuo: Nutrition Portal gwelo ji mondo ochiw ripot manyiso kaka counties ma chiwo ripot mar CNAP kaluwore gi chenro manyien mar nono chal mar chiemo.

English: Government announces scaling of biofortified crop distribution to schools and households for improved maternal-child nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza kuongeza usambazaji wa mazao biofuti kwa shule na kaya kwa ajili ya kuboresha lishe ya mama na mtoto.
Dholuo: Sirkal olando ni ibiro pog ne skunde kod udi duto gik ma osepidh gi gik mang'eny mag ngima dhano mondo omed miyo mine gi nyithindgi chiemo maber.

English: Coughing for more than two weeks? Pregnant women should get tested for TB early.
Kiswahili: Kukohoa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili? Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kupimwa kifua kikuu mapema.
Dholuo: Be dibed ni gisedak kuom jumbe ariyo? Mon man gi ich onego otim nonro mar TB chon.

English: Strong soaps can irritate babys skin. Use mild, unscented options.
Kiswahili: Sabuni kali zinaweza kuwasha ngozi ya mtoto. Tumia chaguo laini, zisizo na harufu.
Dholuo: Saponi motegno nyalo chwanyo pien nyathi. Ti gi gik mayom maok ng'we ng'ar.

English: Repeated ear infections can cause hearing loss. Visit a health worker promptly.
Kiswahili: Maambukizi ya sikio yanayorudiwa yanaweza kusababisha upotevu wa kusikia. Mtembelee mfanyakazi wa afya haraka.
Dholuo: Tuwo mag it ma nyadinwoya nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi it maok winj maber. Dhi mapiyo ir laktar.

English: If the cord stump bleeds or oozes pus, seek medical attention immediately.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kisiki cha kamba kitatoka damu au kutoa usaha, tafuta matibabu mara moja.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo moro ma ok nyal chango, onego odhi mapiyo e osiptal.

English: If sharing a bed with a baby, ensure the space is firm, flat, and free of pillows or loose bedding.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unashiriki kitanda kimoja na mtoto, hakikisha nafasi hiyo ni imara, tambarare, na haina mito au matandiko yaliyolegea.
Dholuo: Kapo ni inindo e otanda achiel gi nyathi, ne ni otano kendo ok opong' gi pilni kata gi lewni motue.

English: Guide older children to handle babies gently to prevent unintentional harm.
Kiswahili: Waongoze watoto wakubwa kuwashughulikia watoto kwa upole ili kuzuia madhara yasiyokusudiwa.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo madongo kaka ginyalo rito nyithindo matindo mondo kik hinygi.

English: Select toys that are safe and suitable for your childs age to prevent choking and injury.
Kiswahili: Chagua vitu vya kuchezea ambavyo ni salama na vinafaa kwa umri wa mtoto wako ili kuzuia kusongwa na kuumia.
Dholuo: Yier gik tugo maok hiny nyathi kendo mowinjore gi hik nyathino mondo kik onind kata hinyore.

English: Stay calm, call for help, and follow safe delivery steps if birth begins unexpectedly.
Kiswahili: Tulia, piga simu kuomba msaada, na fuata hatua salama za kujifungua ikiwa kujifungua kutaanza bila kutarajia.
Dholuo: Bed gi chuny mokuwe, many kony, kendo luw okenge madwarore sama ichako nyuol apoya.

English: Include iron-rich foods like spinach, liver, and beans in the diet to prevent anemia.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha vyakula vyenye madini mengi kama vile mchicha, ini, na maharagwe katika lishe ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu.
Dholuo: Chiemo chiemo ma nigi gik mang'eny mag nyinyo kaka spinach, kong'o, kod oganda nyalo geng'o tuo mar anemia.

English: Bleeding, severe headaches, blurred vision, or swelling are danger signs seek care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kuona vibaya, au uvimbe ni dalili za hatari - tafuta huduma mara moja.
Dholuo: Rembruok, wich malit, neno ma ok nen maber, kata chwoyo gin ranyisi mag masira.

English: Stick to the national immunization schedule to protect children from deadly diseases.
Kiswahili: Zingatia ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari.
Dholuo: Luw chenro moketi mar kano yedhe mag geng'o tuoche e piny mangima mondo irit nyithindi kuom tuoche manyalo negogi.

English: Postpartum depression is real. Encourage new mothers to seek help and talk openly.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo baada ya kujifungua ni halisi. Wahimize akina mama wapya kutafuta msaada na kuzungumza waziwazi.
Dholuo: Chandruok mabedoe bang' nyuol en gima nitie adier. Jiw mine mapod nyien mondo omany kony kendo giwuo ayanga kuom gima chandogi.

English: Always boil and cool water used for preparing baby formula to avoid infections.
Kiswahili: Chemsha na upoeze maji yanayotumika kutayarisha maziwa ya mtoto ili kuepuka maambukizi.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, biye gi pi ma itiyogo e loso chiemb nyithindo mondo kik iyud tuoche.

English: Wash baby feeding items with soap and clean water to prevent diarrheal diseases.
Kiswahili: Osha vitu vya kunyonyesha mtoto kwa sabuni na maji safi ili kuzuia magonjwa ya kuhara.
Dholuo: Lwok gik mitiyogo e pidho nyithindo gi sabun kod pi maler mondo ogeng' midekre ma nyathino yudo nikech diep.

English: Sunken eyes, dry mouth, and less urine may indicate dehydration. Give fluids and seek care.
Kiswahili: Macho yaliyozama, mdomo mkavu, na mkojo mdogo vinaweza kuonyesha upungufu wa maji mwilini. Mpe maji na utafute huduma.
Dholuo: Wang' ma ok nen maber, dho ma ok ng'ich, kod pi matin nyalo nyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar dehydration. Chiw gik mang'eny e dendi kendo many kony.

English: Giving herbs to infants can delay proper treatment and worsen illness. Seek medical advice.
Kiswahili: Kuwapa watoto wachanga mimea kunaweza kuchelewesha matibabu sahihi na kuzidisha ugonjwa. Tafuta ushauri wa daktari.
Dholuo: Miyo nyithindo yath nyalo deko thiedhogi e yo mowinjore kendo ketho tuwono. Dhi ir laktar mondo okonyi.

English: Keep the umbilical cord stump dry and clean to prevent infection.
Kiswahili: Weka kisiki cha kitovu kikavu na kisafi ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Dholuo: Rituru ofuko mar nyundo obed mayom kendo maler mondo kik omake.

English: Early testing helps protect the unborn baby from HIV transmission.
Kiswahili: Kupima mapema husaidia kumlinda mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa kutokana na maambukizi ya VVU.
Dholuo: Pimruok chon konyo e rito nyathi mapok onyuol kuom yudo tuo mar HIV.

English: Violence harms pregnant women physically and mentally. Support and refer survivors for help.
Kiswahili: Vurugu huwadhuru wanawake wajawazito kimwili na kiakili. Wasaidie na uwape rufaa manusura kwa msaada.
Dholuo: Timbe gero hinyo joma mine ma nigi ich, e ringruok koda e paro. Kony joma otony kendo konygi.

English: Announing launch of framework to guide data collection and reporting of nutrition outcomes.
Kiswahili: Kuzindua mfumo wa kuongoza ukusanyaji na utoaji wa taarifa za matokeo ya lishe.
Dholuo: Lando chakruok mar chenro mar tayo choko weche kod chiwo ripot kuom nyak mag chiemo.

English: Launch of the MaziwaPlus initiative in Nyeri County to reduce mastitis incidence and curb antibiotic overuse in dairy cattle.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa MaziwaPlus katika Kaunti ya Nyeri ili kupunguza matukio ya ugonjwa wa mastitis na kupunguza matumizi ya dawa za kuua vijidudu kupita kiasi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar MaziwaPlus e kaunti mar Nyeri mar duoko piny tuo mar mastitis kod geng'o tiyo gi antibayotik mokalo tong' e dhok mag chak.

English: Official media brief on latest DHS findings showing decline; call to re-invest in maternity supports and lactation facilities.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi kwa vyombo vya habari kuhusu matokeo ya hivi karibuni ya DHS yanayoonyesha kupungua; wito wa kuwekeza tena katika vituo vya usaidizi wa uzazi na unyonyeshaji.
Dholuo: Jofwamb weche mag sirkal chiwo ripot machuok e wi weche manyien ma DHS osefwenyo manyiso ni kwan mar joma nigi midekre mar kansa osedok chien; kwayo mondo ochak oket pesa kendo e yore mag konyo mine e nyuol koda e kuonde ma nyithindo thiewoe.

English: Official launch of program training villagers including women for gardens supplying nutrient-dense produce for households and schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa programu ya mafunzo kwa wanakijiji wakiwemo wanawake kwa ajili ya bustani za nyumbani zinazotoa mazao yenye virutubisho vingi kwa kaya na shule.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar tiego jopiny moriwo nyaka mon e tij pidho puothe mag udi ka gichiwo chiemo ma nigi chiemo mang'eny ne udi koda ne skunde.

English: Call for small food vendors to reformulate products to meet nutrition standards and enter competition for rewards.
Kiswahili: Wito kwa wachuuzi wadogo wa vyakula kurekebisha bidhaa ili zikidhi viwango vya lishe na kuingia katika ushindani wa zawadi.
Dholuo: Luong jo ohala matindo mag chiemo mondo gilok kitgi mar loso chiemo mondo ochop chike mag chiemo kendo gichak piem mondo giyud mich.

English: Public declaration of stress management, substance abuse, workplace safety, and wellness training for employers via FKE curriculum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, usalama mahali pa kazi, na mafunzo ya ustawi kwa waajiri kupitia mtaala wa FKE.
Dholuo: Lando ne ji duto kuom tiegruok e weche mag kedo gi parruok, tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero, ritruok kar tich, kod ngima maber ne joma tiyo kokalo kuom chenro mar somo mar FKE.

English: World cancer day themed 'united by unique'. Experts emphasize on individualized patient-centered care. Govt called upon to ensure easy accessibility to cancer services Rising burden of cancer considered a threat to the economy
Kiswahili: Siku ya saratani duniani yenye mada 'kuunganishwa na kipekee'. Wataalamu wanasisitiza huduma ya kibinafsi inayolenga mgonjwa. Serikali imeomba kuhakikisha upatikanaji rahisi wa huduma za saratani. Mzigo unaoongezeka wa saratani unachukuliwa kuwa tishio kwa uchumi
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar thieth mar kansa e piny mangima ne dhi bedo gi wich mawacho ni, 'Winjruok e kind gik mopogore opogore.' Lakteche jiwo ahinya wach rito jatuwo ka luwore gi chal mare. Ne okwa sirkal mondo omi ji thuolo mar yudo thieth mar kansa e yo mayot Medruok mar tuo mar kansa en gima kelo hinyruok ne yuto mar piny

English: Oncology clinic launched in Samburu County 10 cases of cancer reported monthly in Samburu. Barasa Centre makes cancer treatment accessible. We have been able to treat four patients
Kiswahili: Kliniki ya saratani yazinduliwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu. Visa 10 vya saratani vinaripotiwa kila mwezi huko Samburu. Kituo cha Barasa hufanya matibabu ya saratani yapatikane. Tumeweza kuwatibu wagonjwa wanne.
Dholuo: Klinik mar oncology ne ochak e Samburu County ji 10 ma nigi tuo mar kansa ne oyud dwe ka dwe e Samburu. Barasa Centre miyo thieth mar kansa bedo mayot. Wasetiyo gi yore ang'wen mag thieth

English: Government calling on employers to integrate mental wellness supports into occupational safety standards.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa wito kwa waajiri kuunganisha usaidizi wa afya ya akili katika viwango vya usalama kazini.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne okwayo jotend tich mondo oriw kony mag thieth mar paro gi chike mag rito ngima e tich.

English: Annoucement by Kenya National Commission on Human Rights calling recognizing mental health as a universal human right.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Tume ya Kitaifa ya Haki za Kibinadamu ya Kenya likitaka kutambua afya ya akili kama haki ya binadamu kwa wote.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya National Commission on Human Rights dwaro ni mondo ong'e ni tuoche mag paro en ratiro ma dhano duto nigo.

English: KEMRI unveiling pilot program training religious figures in suicide prevention as mental wellbeing outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua programu ya majaribio ya mafunzo kwa watu mashuhuri wa kidini katika kuzuia kujiua kama uhamasishaji wa ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: KEMRI lando chenro mar tiego jotend din e geng'o nek kaka yor thieth mar paro.

English: Kenyans have been urged to desist from handling or consuming bush meat to avoid possible contraction of Mpox disease.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wamehimizwa kuacha kushughulikia au kula nyama ya porini ili kuepuka uwezekano wa kupata ugonjwa wa Mpox.
Dholuo: Jo-Kenya osekwa mondo owe mako kata chamo ring le mag bungu mondo kik giyud tuo mar Mpox.

English: There is no shame in seeking help for depression. In fact, seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression, please reach out to a mental health professional or a crisis hotline
Kiswahili: Hakuna aibu kutafuta msaada kwa ajili ya mfadhaiko. Kwa kweli, kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anapambana na mfadhaiko, tafadhali wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya ya akili au simu ya dharura ya dharura.
Dholuo: Onge wichkuot moro amora ka ng'ato dwaro kony kuom tuwo mar parruok. Kuom adier, kwayo kony en gima nyiso ni ng'ato otegno, to ok en gima nyiso nyawo. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo nigi tuwo mar parruok, tudri gi laktar molony e weche mag tuoche mag paro kata tudri gi ng'at manyalo konyi

English: Always remember that Mental Health first aid is just as important as physical first aid. St John Ambulance is here for you!
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kila wakati kwamba huduma ya kwanza ya Afya ya Akili ni muhimu kama vile huduma ya kwanza ya kimwili. St John Ambulance iko hapa kwa ajili yako!
Dholuo: Kinde duto ng'e ni chiwo kony madwarore ne tuwo mar paro en gima dwarore ahinya mana kaka chiwo kony madwarore ne tuwo mar del. St. John Ambulance ni ka mondo okonyi!

English: Depression is a common mental disorder and one of the main causes of disability worldwide. WHO estimates that globally 264 million people are affected by depression.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo ni ugonjwa wa kawaida wa akili na mojawapo ya sababu kuu za ulemavu duniani kote. WHO inakadiria kuwa duniani kote watu milioni 264 wameathiriwa na msongo wa mawazo.
Dholuo: Parruok en tuwo ma landore ahinya kendo en achiel kuom gik madongo makelo midekre e piny mangima. WHO wacho ni ji milion 264 nigi tuwo mar parruok.

English: Let's talk mental health! If they stopped talking, please check on them.
Kiswahili: Tuzungumzie afya ya akili! Ikiwa waliacha kuzungumza, tafadhali waangalie.
Dholuo: We wawuo ane kuom tuoche mag paro! Kapo ni ne giweyo wuoyo, ng'i ane chal margi.

English: Cervical cancer is one of the most preventable and treatable cancers when detected early. This month, let's join hands to raise awareness, encourage regular screenings, and support initiatives for prevention and early diagnosis
Kiswahili: Saratani ya shingo ya kizazi ni mojawapo ya saratani zinazoweza kuzuilika na kutibika zaidi inapogunduliwa mapema. Mwezi huu, tuungane pamoja ili kuongeza uelewa, kuhimiza uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara, na kuunga mkono mipango ya kuzuia na utambuzi wa mapema.
Dholuo: Tuwo mar cervical cancer en achiel kuom tuoche mag kansa minyalo geng', kendo minyalo thiedh, kapo ni ofwenygi chon. Dwe ma kawuononi, weuru wariw lwedo e medo ng'eyo, jiwo chenro mar nono jotuwo pile, kendo riwo lwedo chenro mag geng'o tuoche kendo fwenyo chon tuoche

English: Health experts from Kenya and Somalia devise ways to fight polio. Many cases of polio reported in Kenya coming from Somalia
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa afya kutoka Kenya na Somalia hubuni njia za kupambana na polio. Visa vingi vya polio vilivyoripotiwa nchini Kenya vinatoka Somalia
Dholuo: Lakteche molony mawuok Kenya kod Somalia manyo yore mag kedo gi tuo mar polio. Thoth joma nigi tuwo mar polio e piny Kenya owuok Somalia

English: As we stay & celebrate Easter holiday, we are reminded about our mental health. Be keen on what you consume as information during these troubled times, be mindful about your health & that of others. Share love, not panic & fear
Kiswahili: Tunapokaa nyumbani na kusherehekea sikukuu ya Pasaka, tunakumbushwa kuhusu afya yetu ya akili. Kuwa makini na kile unachotumia kama taarifa wakati huu wa matatizo, kuwa makini na afya yako na ya wengine. Shiriki upendo, si hofu na hofu.
Dholuo: Sama wasiko e pacho kendo timo nyasi mar Ista, waparo kaka pachwa nyalo bedo gi tuoche. Bed motang' gi weche mipuonjori e kinde mag chandruokgi, kendo ibed motang' gi midekre ma in-go koda mag jomamoko. Nyis ji hera, to ok luoro

English: Men's mental health awareness is critically important because they face unique challenges and pressures from society. Re shows that men are less likely to ask for help with mental health issues than women. This is often because society expects men not to show vulnerability or emotions. This can lead to serious problems, including a higher rate of suicide among men, who are almost four times more likely to die by suicide than women
Kiswahili: Uelewa wa afya ya akili ya wanaume ni muhimu sana kwa sababu wanakabiliwa na changamoto na shinikizo la kipekee kutoka kwa jamii. Utafiti unaonyesha kuwa wanaume wana uwezekano mdogo wa kuomba msaada kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili kuliko wanawake. Hii mara nyingi ni kwa sababu jamii inatarajia wanaume kutoonyesha udhaifu au hisia. Hii inaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kiwango cha juu cha kujiua miongoni mwa wanaume, ambao wana uwezekano wa karibu mara nne zaidi wa kufa kwa kujiua kuliko wanawake.
Dholuo: Bedo gi chuny mar ng'eyo tuoche mag paro kuom chwo en gima dwarore ahinya nikech chwo romo gi pek moko makende kod tembe mawuok kuom oganda. Nonro nyiso ni joma chwo ok ohero kwayo kony kuom weche mag tuoche mag paro maloyo joma mon. Kinde mang'eny, mano en nikech oganda ji dwaro ni chwo kik nyis ni gin joma yomyom kata maok nyal kony. Mano nyalo kelo chandruoge madongo, moriwo nyaka kwan momedore mar chwo matemo negore, kwanno chiegni nyading'wen maloyo mar mon matemo negore

English: Drug or alcohol addiction can exacerbate feelings of hopelessness, worsen mental health conditions, impair decision-making, and increase the risk of suicidal thoughts. Avoid drugs and substance abuse
Kiswahili: Uraibu wa dawa za kulevya au pombe unaweza kuzidisha hisia za kukata tamaa, kuzidisha hali ya afya ya akili, kudhoofisha uamuzi, na kuongeza hatari ya mawazo ya kujiua. Epuka dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya.
Dholuo: Madho kong'o kata tiyo gi yedhe mamero nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi chuny mool, obed gi parruok mang'eny, obed ng'at maok nyal ng'ado paro e yo makare, kendo onyalo bedo gi paro mar dwaro negore. Tamri tiyo gi yedhe mamero koda kong'o

English: Self-care is important - it directly affects your overall well-being, including physical, mental, and emotional health. Prioritizing self-care helps you manage stress, avoid burnout, and maintain a balanced life. Engaging in exercise, good sleep, healthy eating, and mindfulness boosts resilience and promotes a positive outlook
Kiswahili: Kujitunza ni muhimu - kunaathiri moja kwa moja ustawi wako kwa ujumla, ikiwa ni pamoja na afya ya kimwili, kiakili, na kihisia. Kuweka kipaumbele katika kujitunza kunakusaidia kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo, kuepuka uchovu, na kudumisha maisha yenye usawa. Kufanya mazoezi, kulala vizuri, kula vizuri, na kuzingatia huongeza ustahimilivu na kukuza mtazamo chanya.
Dholuo: Rito dendi en gima dwarore ahinya - nimar mano miyo ibedo gi ngima maber, moriwo koda bedo gi del mangima, paro maber, koda chuny mokuwe. Ka iketo motelo rito dendi, mano biro konyi nyagori gi parruok, geng'o olo, kendo miyo ibed gi ngima maber. Timo gik matego del, nindo moromo, chamo chiemo mowinjore, kendo keto pachwa kuom gima watimo, nyalo konyowa nyagore gi chandruoge kendo miyo wabed gi paro mowinjore

English: Climate change affects mental health. Natural disasters, displacement and chronic environmental stressors leads to increased anxiety, depression, and PTSD. Addressing climate change is key to protecting mental well-being
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa huathiri afya ya akili. Majanga ya asili, kuhama makazi na msongo wa mawazo sugu husababisha kuongezeka kwa wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, na PTSD. Kushughulikia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ni muhimu katika kulinda ustawi wa akili
Dholuo: Lokruok mar kit yamo kelo tuoche mag paro. Masiche ma timore apoya, dar e udi, koda gik mamoko ma kelo parruok e alwora, miyo ji bedo gi parruok mang'eny, parruok mang'eny, koda parruok mabedoe bang' masira. Nyagruok gi lokruok mar kit yamo en gima duong' ahinya e rito ngima mar paro.

Kiswahili: (Nairobi, Kenya, Mei 2024): Nchi za Afrika zimepewa changamoto ya kusukuma kwa ujasiri kupitishwa kwa sayansi ya kisasa katika kilimo na matumizi ya...
Dholuo: (Nairobi, Kenya, Mei 2024): Pinje mag Afrika osebedo ka kedo gi pek mar jiwo ji mondo oti gi sayans ma nyasani e pur gi pith kod tiyo gi......

Kiswahili: ... Upatikanaji wa Soko na Utofauti wa Lishe: Jukumu Linalowezekana la Wanawake katika Kuboresha Lishe ya Kaya nchini Kenya Evelyne Kihiu, Hillary Wakhungu na Juneweenex...

Dholuo: Chiaye ber e medo yuto mar ng'ato. Omiyo ter wach ne lakteche chiaye mondo okony matuo gi modenyo e yoo makare

English: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.
Kiswahili: Tumia tochi badala ya mishumaa ili kuzuia moto wakati wa kuzimwa kwa umeme. Ripoti nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka kwa Kenya Power.
Dholuo: Ti gi torch e mudho kar msuma mondo igeng' mach e seche mag mudho. Kow wach mar mudho ne Kenya Power

English: Avoid driving through flooded roads. Just 30cm of water can sweep away vehicles. Use alternative routes.
Kiswahili: Epuka kuendesha gari kupitia barabara zilizojaa maji. Maji ya sentimita 30 pekee yanaweza kufyonza magari. Tumia njia mbadala.
Dholuo: Kik idonj e nderni ma pi opong'o, nikech pi matin ma romo sentimita 30 nyalo ywayo mtokni.

English: Companies should have continuity plans, backup generators, and employee safety training for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Makampuni yanapaswa kuwa na mipango ya mwendelezo, jenereta mbadala, na mafunzo ya usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa dharura.
Dholuo: Kuonde ohala onego obed gi chenro mag dhi nyime, gi masinde mag loso gik moko, kendo tiego jotich e weche mag ritruok e kinde mag chandruok.

English: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) are vulnerable to diseases. Ensure clean water, sanitation, and medical supplies in camps.
Kiswahili: Watu Waliohamishwa Ndani ya Nchi (IDPs) wako katika hatari ya kupata magonjwa. Hakikisha maji safi, usafi wa mazingira, na vifaa vya matibabu katika kambi.
Dholuo: Joma odak e kuonde jot (IDPs) nyalo yudo tuoche mapiyo. Rituru ler mar pi kod alwora kendo chiwuru yedhe

English: Improper generator use causes carbon monoxide poisoning. Operate generators outdoors and away from windows.
Kiswahili: Matumizi yasiyofaa ya jenereta husababisha sumu ya monoksidi kaboni. Huendesha jenereta nje na mbali na madirisha.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi generator e yo maok owinjore nyalo kaw ngima ng'ato kluwore gi carbon monoxide. Ti gi generator e laro mabor gi dirishni mag ot

English: Children are highly vulnerable. Ensure they know emergency contacts and have identification tags in crowded shelters.
Kiswahili: Watoto wako katika hatari kubwa. Hakikisha wanawajua watu wa dharura na wana vitambulisho katika makazi yaliyojaa watu.
Dholuo: Nyithindo nyalo bedo joma yom yom ahinya, omiyo nyaka ine ni ging'eyo joma ginyalo tudorego e saa masira, kendo ni gin gi kalatese ma nyiso kuma giwuoke

English: After floods, disinfect s to prevent mold and diseases. Wear protective gear during cleanup.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mafuriko, safisha nyumba ili kuzuia ukungu na magonjwa. Vaa vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wa usafi.
Dholuo: Bang' koth, go udi yedhe mageng'o tuoche kiruako jwala e lweti

English: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa majanga ya muda mrefu, hifadhi chakula kwa kukausha, kutia chumvi, au kutumia vyombo visivyopitisha hewa ili kuepuka kuharibika.
Dholuo: Sama masira moro otimore kuom kinde malach, ket chiemo e bwo yiengni ma ok nyal kethore.

English: Snakes seek shelter in s during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.
Kiswahili: Nyoka hutafuta makazi majumbani wakati wa mafuriko. Tumia mienge usiku na epuka kutembea bila viatu.
Dholuo: Sama pi opong'o piny, thuonde manyo kar buok e utegi, giti gi mach gotieno, kendo kik giwuothi gi tiendgi nono.

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Kiswahili: Epuka kujenga upya katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Serikali inatoa ardhi mbadala kwa familia zilizoathiriwa.
Dholuo: Kik uger kuonde ma lowo olwar ahinya, nikech sirkal chiwo lowo ma nyalo konyo joodgi ma masira mar yiengni omako.

English: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya usalama wa moto bila malipo yanapatikana kwa jamii ili kuzuia na kukabiliana na milipuko ya moto.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma onge chudo mar mach yudore mondo omi oganda ogeng'o kendo odwokgi e yo maber.

English: Water conducts electricity. Avoid touching power lines or electrical appliances during floods.
Kiswahili: Maji hupitisha umeme. Epuka kugusa nyaya za umeme au vifaa vya umeme wakati wa mafuriko.
Dholuo: Pi miyo ga sitima muoch, omiyo kik imul sitima kata masinde mamoko mag sitima sama pi opong'o piny.

English: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kutumia mazao yanayostahimili ukame na mbinu za kuhifadhi maji ili kupunguza mishtuko ya hali ya hewa.
Dholuo: jopur onego opidh yiende ma ok oluoro oro kendo giti gi yore mag rito pi mondo kik giwit yuto e saa masira

English: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kujenga makazi ya muda kwa kutumia vifaa vinavyopatikana katika eneo husika kwa ajili ya familia zilizopoteza makazi.
Dholuo: Puonjri gero ute jot ma ji dakie ndalo masir, kitiyo gi gik ma yudore e alwora ma gidakie mondo okonygo joma masira oyudo

English: Stampedes worsen disasters. Follow authorities' instructions and avoid panic during mass evacuations.
Kiswahili: Kukanyagana huzidisha majanga. Fuata maagizo ya mamlaka na epuka hofu wakati wa uhamishaji wa watu wengi.
Dholuo: Luw chike ma sirkal chiko kendo kik ibed maluor sama itimo chenro mar golo ji e kuonde masira

English: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha mitungi ya LPG imehifadhiwa katika maeneo yenye hewa ya kutosha na angalia uvujaji mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Keturu osikni mag LPG e kuonde ma yamo nitie maber kendo ng'iuru machuer.

English: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from s to prevent fires and environmental contamination.
Kiswahili: Kemikali na mafuta yanapaswa kuhifadhiwa mbali na nyumba ili kuzuia moto na uchafuzi wa mazingira.
Dholuo: Mondo omi mach kik chakre kendo keth alwora, gik makelo chuk kod petrol onego okan mabor gi udi.

English: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.
Kiswahili: Maji yaliyotuama huzaa mbu. Tumia vyandarua na uripoti maambukizi ya mbu kwa mamlaka za afya.
Dholuo: Pi ma ok mol miyo suna nywolore, omiyo ti gi net mag nindo kendo inyis jotelo mag thieth ni suna ngeny e aluora ma intie

English: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwekeza katika visima na uvunaji wa maji ya mvua ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji wakati wa ukame.
Dholuo: Ji onego onyiew gige ywayo kod choko pi koth mondo omi ji obed gi pi e ndalo kech gi oro

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa sera wa Kenya unahakikisha usimamizi wa maafa ulioratibiwa. Elewa haki zako na majukumu ya serikali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar timo lokruok e weche mag siasa miyo ji bedo gi chenro maber mar rito masiche.

English: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.
Kiswahili: Vurugu za wapenzi wa karibu mara nyingi huongezeka polepole. Utambuzi wa mapema na mafunzo kwa wataalamu wa mstari wa mbele husaidia kuzuia na rufaa salama.
Dholuo: Kinde mang'eny dhap dhako gi dichuo modak kanyakla medo bedo marach mosmos. Omiyo chop lendo mag dhao e migepe mohangi ne jopiny

English: Prompt reporting of gender-based violence protects survivors and preserves evidence. Specialized Gender Desks handle cases sensitively and survivors have rights to medical care, protection, and legal support.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti haraka kuhusu ukatili wa kijinsia huwalinda waathiriwa na kuhifadhi ushahidi. Madawati Maalum ya Jinsia hushughulikia kesi kwa usikivu na waathiriwa wana haki ya kupata huduma ya matibabu, ulinzi, na usaidizi wa kisheria.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato olando mapiyo weche mag mahundu ekind dichwo gi dhako, mano nyalo miyo orit joma notony. Sirikal miyo joma otony rit e buo chik kod ratiro mar yedhe

English: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya usalama wa kibinafsi huwasaidia watu kujiandaa kwa hali hatari kwa kutambua maeneo salama na mikakati ya ulinzi.
Dholuo: Chenro mag rito ngima konyo ng'ato mondo oikre ne chal matek kuom fwenyo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie kendo tiyo gi yore ma ginyalo ritogo ng'ato.

English: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.
