Dholuo: Jood komiti mar weche sirkal duto 47 ma Kenya noyudo tiegruok e weche mag rito oganda kendo geng'o timbe gero

English: Citywide COP strategy building citizen coalitions for crime prevention in Nairobi City
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa COP kote jijini kujenga miungano ya raia kwa ajili ya kuzuia uhalifu jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Chenro mar COP mar konyo ji duto e kedo gi mahundu e taon mar Nairobi

English: NCRC government report finds mixed public trust in police despite years of community policing
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya serikali ya NCRC yagundua imani mchanganyiko ya umma kwa polisi licha ya miaka mingi ya ulinzi wa jamii
Dholuo: Ripot mar sirkal mar NCRC nyiso ni ji ok oyie gi polis kata obedo ni sirkal osebedo ka timo kamano kuom higni mang'eny

English: Analysis of police social media use and public trust dynamics in Nairobi City County
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa matumizi ya mitandao ya kijamii ya polisi na mienendo ya uaminifu wa umma katika Kaunti ya Jiji la Nairobi
Dholuo: Nonro mar kaka polise tiyo gi weche mag tudruok gi ji kod kaka ji geno weche mag sirkal e taon mar Nairobi

English: NCRC report reveals while community policing increased info sharing public trust remains low in Nairobi County
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya NCRC inaonyesha huku polisi jamii ikiongeza uaminifu wa umma katika ushiriki wa taarifa bado uko chini katika Kaunti ya Nairobi
Dholuo: Ripot mar NCRC nyiso ni kata obedo ni polise mag oganda medo medo chiwo weche, geno mar ji pod dhi piny e County Nairobi

English: NCRC survey shows Kenyans want COP to tackle drug abuse, professionalism and slow investigations
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa NCRC unaonyesha Wakenya wanataka COP kukabiliana na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, taaluma na uchunguzi wa polepole
Dholuo: Nonro mar NCRC nyiso ni Jo-Kenya dwaro ni COP olo timbe mag tiyo gi yedhe mamero, lony e weche mag tich, koda nono weche mos mos

English: UoN report assesses trust dynamics and communication as key to successful COP in Ruai portion of Nairobi
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya UoN inatathmini mienendo ya uaminifu na mawasiliano kama ufunguo wa COP iliyofanikiwa katika sehemu ya Ruai jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Ripot mar UN nono dongruok mar geno kod tudruok kaka gima duong' e miyo COP odhi maber e Ruai ma Nairobi

English: A report documented systemic excessive force during protests and called for prosecutions, crowd control reforms, and stronger conduct enforcement mechanisms.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ilirekodi matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kutoa wito wa mashtaka, mageuzi ya udhibiti wa umati, na mifumo imara ya utekelezaji wa mwenendo.
Dholuo: Ripot moro ne nyiso kaka ne itiyo gi teko mokalo tong' e kinde mar protest kendo ne okwayo mondo oter kes, otim lokruok e wi kaka ne itiyo gi teko mar chiko ji, kendo mondo omi chike mag tayo timbe ji obed motegno.

English: Media highlighted calls for an independent investigation into a custodial death, with families demanding prosecution and better detention oversight.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari viliangazia wito wa uchunguzi huru kuhusu kifo cha mtu aliyekamatwa, huku familia zikidai mashtaka na usimamizi bora wa kizuizini.
Dholuo: Jofwamb weche ne onyiso ni ne dwarore ni otim nonro ma onge ratiro kuom tho ma ne otimore e jela, kendo joodgi ne dwaro ni otergi e bura kendo mondo omi gibed gi chenro maber mar rito joma otwe.

English: An NGO launched a citizen oversight toolkit with training materials and reporting templates to strengthen youth involvement in accountability.
Kiswahili: Shirika lisilo la kiserikali lilizindua zana ya usimamizi wa raia yenye vifaa vya mafunzo na vielelezo vya kuripoti ili kuimarisha ushiriki wa vijana katika uwajibikaji.
Dholuo: Riwruok moro mar oganda maok nie sirkal nochako chenro mar konyo ji mondo obed gi chenro mar tiego ji kendo chiwo ripot e yo maber mondo omed jiwo rowere mondo obed gi thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: IPOA launched a toll-free hotline operating 24/7 for public reporting of misconduct to increase accessibility and transparency.
Kiswahili: IPOA ilizindua simu ya dharura isiyolipishwa inayofanya kazi masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa ajili ya kuripoti kwa umma kuhusu utovu wa nidhamu ili kuongeza ufikiaji na uwazi.
Dholuo: IPOA ne ochako tiyo gi simo maonge chudo ma tiyo odiechieng' kodiechieng' mondo okony ji ng'eyo timbe maricho ma ne otimore mondo omi ji obed thuolo kendo gibed mang'won.

English: Following an IPOA probe, a senior officer and colleague were charged with torture and abuse of office, demonstrating judicial follow-through.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia uchunguzi wa IPOA, afisa mkuu na mwenzake walishtakiwa kwa mateso na matumizi mabaya ya ofisi, wakionyesha ufuatiliaji wa kimahakama.
Dholuo: Bang' nono weche mag IPOA, ne odonjne ofisa moro maduong' kod jaode ni ne gitimo timbe mag sand kod tiyo marach gi migawo ma ne en-go, kendo mano nonyiso ni ne gitimo kamano e yo ma ratiro.

English: IPOA spotlighted a serious misconduct case in Mombasa, calling for transparency and systemic discipline reforms.
Kiswahili: IPOA iliangazia kesi kubwa ya utovu wa nidhamu huko Mombasa, ikitaka uwazi na mageuzi ya nidhamu ya kimfumo.
Dholuo: IPOA ne oketo ranyisi mar ketho chik maduong' e Mombasa, kendo ne okwayo ni otim lokruok e weche ma nyiso ni ji ong'eyo weche duto kendo ni otim lokruok e yo ma tayo chik.

English: An IPOA warning stated that silence within the police force enables impunity and called for cultural reforms and safe reporting.
Kiswahili: Onyo la IPOA lilisema kwamba ukimya ndani ya jeshi la polisi huwezesha kutokujali na lilitaka mageuzi ya kitamaduni na kuripoti kwa usalama.
Dholuo: Siem moro mar IPOA nowacho ni ling'ling' ei polise miyo ji bedo maonge ketho kendo ne okwayo ni otim lokruok e kit ngima ji kendo mondo weche duto ma timore kik lal.

English: A public forum in Kakamega enabled citizens to report misconduct directly to officials, strengthening community oversight.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la umma huko Kakamega liliwawezesha raia kuripoti utovu wa nidhamu moja kwa moja kwa maafisa, na hivyo kuimarisha usimamizi wa jamii.
Dholuo: Chokruok moro mar ji duto ma ne otim Kakamega ne omiyo raia thuolo mar nyiso jotelo wach timbe maricho ma ne gitimo, kendo mano nomiyo ji omedo bedo gi paro maler

English: An audit exposed misuse of public funds in police operations and prompted calls for fiscal transparency and procurement reform.
Kiswahili: Ukaguzi ulifichua matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma katika shughuli za polisi na kusababisha wito wa uwazi wa kifedha na mageuzi ya ununuzi.
Dholuo: nonro mar pesa mitiyogo e migao mag polise osekelo lokruok mabeyo e chano kaka pesa tiyo

English: A live radio program educated listeners on detainee rights, proper custody treatment, and legal recourse for abuse.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha redio cha moja kwa moja kilielimisha wasikilizaji kuhusu haki za wafungwa, utunzaji sahihi wa watoto, na njia ya kisheria ya kuchukua hatua dhidi ya unyanyasaji.
Dholuo: program mar redio osepuonjo jowinjo e wi ratiro ma joma otwe nigo, kaka onego otim ne joma otwe, kod kaka inyalo tiek tim mar chayo ng'ato e yor chik.

English: NPS launched an online portal providing access to oversight reports, misconduct statistics, complaint status, and disciplinary actions.
Kiswahili: NPS ilizindua lango la mtandaoni linalotoa ufikiaji wa ripoti za usimamizi, takwimu za utovu wa nidhamu, hali ya malalamiko, na hatua za kinidhamu.
Dholuo: NPS nochako chenro mar tiyo gi intanet mar yudo ripode mag jarit, weche mag timbe maricho, chal mar gik ma ji wacho, koda weche mag kum.

English: APS introduced a yellow card system allowing citizens to report misconduct anonymously during patrols.
Kiswahili: APS ilianzisha mfumo wa kadi za njano unaowaruhusu raia kuripoti utovu wa nidhamu bila kujulikana wakati wa doria.
Dholuo: APS ne oketo chenro mar yudo kad ma jachuoyo ma ne miyo raia thuolo mar nyiso timbe maricho e yo maok ong'ere sama gitimo tij lworo.

English: Mombasa County launched a text-based reporting line for victims to send secure complaints to oversight officials.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mombasa ilizindua laini ya kuripoti kwa njia ya maandishi kwa waathiriwa kutuma malalamiko salama kwa maafisa wa usimamizi.
Dholuo: Mombasa County nochako chenro mar chiwo ripot e yor ndiko ne joma ne otho mondo oor weche ma ok nyal geng'o kethogi ne joma ne tayo tijno.

English: Authorities warned Western and Nyanza communities of suspected terror recruitment and urged reporting of suspicious behavior.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka zilionya jamii za Magharibi na Nyanza kuhusu tuhuma za kuajiri watu wanaoshukiwa kuwa magaidi na kuhimiza kuripotiwa kwa tabia zinazoshukiwa.
Dholuo: Sirkal nosiemo ji e pinje mag Western kod Nyanza kuom wach chulo ji mondo oti gi gige lweny kendo ne gijiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot kuom timbe maricho.

English: Public informed of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and encouraged to stay vigilant as security heightened.
Kiswahili: Umma umearifiwa kuhusu shambulio la Al-Shabaab huko Garissa na kuhimizwa kuwa macho huku usalama ukiimarishwa.
Dholuo: Ji duto ne olando ni Al-Shabaab ne omonjo Garissa kendo ne ojiwogi ni gisik ka girito ka sirkal medo bedo motegno.

English: Government recognized GBV as a national security threat and called for inter‑agency collaboration.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitambua GBV kama tishio la usalama wa taifa na ikataka ushirikiano kati ya mashirika.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne oyie ni GBV en gima kelo hinyruok ne sirkal kendo ne okwayo ni riwruok mar oganda Jehova oriwre gi riwruok mar oganda Jehova.

English: NPS published a list of most wanted terror suspects and urged anonymous public reporting.
Kiswahili: NPS ilichapisha orodha ya washukiwa wa ugaidi wanaotafutwa sana na kuhimiza watu wasiojulikana kuripoti.
Dholuo: NPS ne ogolo list mar joma ne omany ahinya e weche mag mahundu kendo ne okwayo ni mondo ji ong'e ni ok gitim kamano.

English: US government advised citizens to avoid Eastleigh and Kibera due to security concerns.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Marekani iliwashauri raia kuepuka Eastleigh na Kibera kutokana na wasiwasi wa usalama.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Amerka nojiwo raia mondo kik giriw Eastleigh kod Kibera nikech weche mag sirkal.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victims' dignity.
Kiswahili: Umma ulishauri kutosambaza picha za picha baada ya shambulio la DusitD2 ili kulinda heshima ya waathiriwa.
Dholuo: Ji ne okwayo mondo kik giland piche jomosenindo bang' monj mar DusitD2 mondo omi girit luor mar joma ne otho.

English: National Cybersecurity Strategy published outlining plans to protect digital infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Usalama wa Mtandaoni ulichapisha ukielezea mipango ya kulinda miundombinu ya kidijitali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar National Cybersecurity Strategy ne ogolo chenro mar rito chenro mag digital.

English: Multiple suspects arrested in Lamu during a counter‑terror operation; public urged to report tips.
Kiswahili: Washukiwa kadhaa wakamatwa Lamu wakati wa operesheni ya kukabiliana na ugaidi; umma wahimizwa kuripoti taarifa za watu waliokamatwa.
Dholuo: Ji mang'eny ma ne odonjore gi timbe mahundu ne omak e taon mar Lamu; ne ojiw ji mondo ochiw paro.

English: NPS reminded officers to avoid misuse of force during protests and maintain professionalism.
Kiswahili: NPS iliwakumbusha maafisa kuepuka matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kudumisha weledi.
Dholuo: NPS noparo ne jotend polis ni kik giti gi teko e yo marach e kinde mag mor kendo gitim gik ma nyiso ni gin joma olony.

English: US Embassy warned of potential unrest during primaries and urged citizens to avoid large gatherings.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani ulionya kuhusu machafuko yanayoweza kutokea wakati wa kura za mchujo na kuwasihi raia kuepuka mikusanyiko mikubwa.
Dholuo: Amerka ne osiemo ji kuom ywaruok manyalo bedoe e kinde mag yiero mag siasa kendo ne ojiwo raia mondo kik chokre e chokruoge madongo.

English: Government declared a nationwide high-alert and urged citizens to remain calm, report suspicious activity, and cooperate with security agencies.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitangaza tahadhari kubwa kitaifa na kuwasihi raia kuwa watulivu, kuripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka, na kushirikiana na vyombo vya usalama.
Dholuo: Sirkal nolando ni piny mangima en kama odong' gi siem kendo nojiwo raia mondo obed gi chuny mokuwe, onyis ni gitimo gik ma ok kare, kendo giti kanyachiel gi riwruoge ma rito weche mag sirkal.

English: NPS warned the public about a fake police recruitment advert online and advised job seekers to rely only on official government platforms.
Kiswahili: NPS ilionya umma kuhusu tangazo bandia la kuajiri polisi mtandaoni na kuwashauri wanaotafuta kazi kutegemea majukwaa rasmi ya serikali pekee.
Dholuo: NPS nosiemo ji kuom wach lando miriambo mag polise e intanet kendo ne ojiwo jogo madwaro tich mondo oket genogi kuom chenro mag sirkal kende.

English: Authorities deployed surveillance, roadblocks, and emergency teams to ensure safety ahead of the Safari Rally.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ziliweka ufuatiliaji, vizuizi vya barabarani, na timu za dharura ili kuhakikisha usalama kabla ya Safari Rally.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne oketo chenro mar rito ji, ne ogeng'o ndara, kendo ne oketo grup mag rito ji mondo omi girit ngimagi kapok chokruok mar Safari ochakore.

English: NPS reiterated guidance for officers to use proportional force during protests and to prioritize peaceful engagement.
Kiswahili: NPS ilirudia mwongozo kwa maafisa kutumia nguvu sawia wakati wa maandamano na kuweka kipaumbele katika ushiriki wa amani.
Dholuo: NPS ne onwoyo paro ma ne ochiwo ne jotelo mondo oti gi teko mar kwan e kinde mag mor kendo mondo oket motelo weche mag kuwe.

English: Authorities issued detailed Cyclone Hidaya safety guidance urging coastal residents to secure property and avoid non-essential travel.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka yalitoa mwongozo wa kina wa usalama wa Kimbunga Hidaya kikiwataka wakazi wa pwani kulinda mali na kuepuka usafiri usio wa lazima.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne ogolo weche matut e wi weche mag ritruok mag kodh yamo mag Hurricane Hidaya ka gikwayo jogweng' manie nam mondo orit mwandugi kendo gitang' gi wuoth maok ochuno.

English: NPS discredited multiple fake posters circulating online and urged the public to avoid sharing unverified content.
Kiswahili: NPS ilikanusha mabango mengi bandia yanayosambaa mtandaoni na kuwahimiza umma kuepuka kushiriki maudhui ambayo hayajathibitishwa.
Dholuo: NPS ne oketo nying' joma ne ondiko weche mag miriambo e Intanet kendo ne okwayo ji mondo kik gipog weche ma ne ok ong'ere.

English: PRWG urged police to prevent masked infiltrators during protests, maintain professional crowd control, and ensure accountability for misconduct.
Kiswahili: PRWG iliwasihi polisi kuzuia wavamizi waliovaa barakoa wakati wa maandamano, kudumisha udhibiti wa kitaalamu wa umati, na kuhakikisha uwajibikaji kwa utovu wa nidhamu.
Dholuo: PRWG ne ojiwo polise mondo ogeng' joma donjo e timbe mag wuondo, kendo mondo gichak rito oganda mar ji, kendo mondo gimi ji duto obed gi ketho kuom timbe maricho.

English: Amnesty Kenya reminded officers to respect protest rights, protect medics and journalists, and avoid excessive force.
Kiswahili: Amnesty Kenya iliwakumbusha maafisa kuheshimu haki za maandamano, kuwalinda madaktari na waandishi wa habari, na kuepuka kutumia nguvu kupita kiasi.
Dholuo: Amnesty Kenya noparo ne jotend sirkal ni onego giwinj ratiro mag joma riwo lwedo, girit lakteche kod jotim weche, kendo gitang' gi tiyo gi teko mokalo tong'.

English: IPOA opened a comprehensive investigation into allegations of police misconduct during June protests, including use of live rounds and mass detentions.
Kiswahili: IPOA ilianzisha uchunguzi wa kina kuhusu madai ya utovu wa nidhamu wa polisi wakati wa maandamano ya Juni, ikiwa ni pamoja na matumizi ya risasi za moja kwa moja na kuwekwa kizuizini kwa wingi.
Dholuo: IPOA ne ochako nonro matut kuom weche ma ne wacho ni polis ne ok tim maber e kinde mar gik ma ne otim e dwe mar Jun, moriwo tiyo gi bunde kod mako ji mang'eny.

English: PRWG reaffirmed that peaceful protests must be protected and criticized failures to separate violent actors from lawful demonstrators.
Kiswahili: PRWG ilithibitisha tena kwamba maandamano ya amani lazima yalindwe na kukosolewa kwa kushindwa kuwatenganisha wahusika wa vurugu na waandamanaji halali.
Dholuo: PRWG ne owacho ni ok onego oket ketho kuom joma ne timo timbe gero kendo ne ok ginyal pogo joma ne timo timbe gero gi joma ne timo gik ma chik oyiego.

English: Investigations revealed police attempts to misreport protest fatalities as accidents, raising concerns over deliberate cover-ups.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi umebaini kuwa polisi wanajaribu kuripoti vibaya vifo vya waandamanaji kama ajali, na kuzua wasiwasi kuhusu kuficha kwa makusudi.
Dholuo: Nonro ma ne otim nonyiso ni polise ne temo ketho weche ma ne owacho ni ne gin masiche nikech ne gitimo gik ma ne ok nyis ni ne giparo ni ne gineno ji.

English: Reports detailed police-ordered lockdowns on Saba Saba Day, including blocked routes, live fire, and escalated confrontations.
Kiswahili: Ripoti zinaelezea kwa kina amri ya polisi ya kufungiwa kwa watu siku ya Saba Saba, ikiwa ni pamoja na njia zilizofungwa, mapigano ya moja kwa moja, na mapigano yaliyoongezeka.
Dholuo: Ripot nyiso weche matut kuom twege ma polis nochiko e odiechieng Saba Saba, moriwo yore mag ndara, mach mager, kod lweny ma nomedore.

English: Reuters reported the arrest of activist Mwangi over alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition during protests, widely condemned as political intimidation.
Kiswahili: Reuters iliripoti kukamatwa kwa mwanaharakati Mwangi kwa madai ya kumiliki gesi ya machozi na risasi wakati wa maandamano, ambayo yamelaaniwa sana kama vitisho vya kisiasa.
Dholuo: Reuters ne owacho ni jarit Mwangi ne omak nikech ne okaw gas ma pi wang' piyo kod bunde e kinde mar piem, ma ji mang'eny ne okwedo kaka tim mar miyo ji luoro.

English: AP News reported police use of tear gas on activists protesting a custodial death, reigniting public demands for justice and transparency.
Kiswahili: AP News iliripoti matumizi ya polisi ya gesi ya kutoa machozi kwa wanaharakati wanaopinga kifo cha kufungwa jela, na kufufua madai ya umma ya haki na uwazi.
Dholuo: AP News ne owacho ni polis notiyo gi gas ma pi wang' piyo e kedo ne joma ne kedo ne tho ma ne otim e jela, kendo mano nomiyo ji odwaro ni mondo gibed gi bura makare kendo gibed gi ng'eyo makare.

English: The Guardian reported Constable James Mukhwana as the first officer arraigned over the custodial death case, signaling increased scrutiny of police conduct.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la The Guardian liliripoti kwamba Konstebo James Mukhwana ndiye afisa wa kwanza kushtakiwa kuhusu kesi ya kifo cha kifungo cha gerezani, jambo lililoashiria uchunguzi zaidi wa mwenendo wa polisi.
Dholuo: Gaset mar The Guardian ne onyiso ni polis James Mukhwana e ma ne okwongo tero e kot nikech wach tho ma ne otimore e jela, kendo mano nyiso ni polis medo nono ahinya timbe mag polis.

English: AP News covered Mwangi's release on bail and rights groups' criticism of terrorism charge misuse during protests.
Kiswahili: AP News iliripoti kuhusu kuachiliwa kwa Mwangi kwa dhamana na ukosoaji wa makundi ya haki za binadamu kuhusu matumizi mabaya ya shtaka la ugaidi wakati wa maandamano.
Dholuo: AP News ne olero kaka ne ogonyo Mwangi e jela nikech ne ogolo bail kod kaka riwruoge ma kedo ne ratiro mag ji ne kwedo weche mag tiyo marach gi weche mag mahundu e kinde mag protest.

English: Local media reported calls for prosecution of officers accused of excessive force during Gen Z protests, urging IPOA and ODPP action.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari vya ndani viliripoti wito wa kushtakiwa kwa maafisa walioshutumiwa kwa kutumia nguvu kupita kiasi wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, wakihimiza hatua za IPOA na ODPP.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Jo-Kenya ne oketo chenro mar keto ketho kuom jotelo ma ne odonjne ni ne otiyo gi teko mokalo tong' e kinde mar ng'ur mar Gen Z, kendo ne gikwayo mondo otim gima biro miyo otim kamano.

English: An academic analysis linked protest-related abuses to systemic police impunity rooted in historical failures of accountability.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa kitaaluma ulihusisha unyanyasaji unaohusiana na maandamano na kutokujali kwa polisi kwa utaratibu uliotokana na kushindwa kwa uwajibikaji wa kihistoria.
Dholuo: Nonro moro mar josomo ne oketo tudruok e kind timbe maricho ma ne timore e kind joma ne kedo gi sirkal kod timbe maok kare ma ne timorega e kind polise nikech ne ok ginyal chiwo dwoko.

English: An encyclopedic overview documented causes, fatalities, economic triggers, and arrest numbers from the 2025 protests.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa ensaiklopidia uliandika sababu, vifo, vichocheo vya kiuchumi, na idadi ya kukamatwa kutokana na maandamano ya 2025.
Dholuo: Buk moro mar encyclopedic ne oting'o weche manyiso gimomiyo ji notho, gik ma ne miyo ji tho, koda kwan mag joma ne omak e higa mar 2025.

English: Missing Voices published a registry of killings and disappearances among youth during Gen Z protests, calling for formal investigations.
Kiswahili: Missing Voices ilichapisha sajili ya mauaji na kutoweka kwa vijana wakati wa maandamano ya Gen Z, ikitaka uchunguzi rasmi ufanyike.
Dholuo: Missing Voices ne ogolo buk manyiso kaka ne oneg rowere kod kaka ne githung' e kind rowere e kinde mag ng'ur mar Gen Z, kendo ne okwayo mondo otim nonro.

English: United Nations urged Kenya to respect human rights during protests and called for independent investigations into killings and disappearances.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa uliitaka Kenya kuheshimu haki za binadamu wakati wa maandamano na kutoa wito wa kufanyika kwa uchunguzi huru kuhusu mauaji na kupotea kwa watu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje ne ojiwo Kenya mondo omi ratiro mag dhano luor e kinde mag piem kendo ne okwayo mondo otim nonro maok mar sirkal e wi nek kod lal mar ji.

English: U.S. Embassy warned citizens of risks during ongoing protests, advising avoidance of demonstration areas due to potential violence.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani uliwaonya raia kuhusu hatari wakati wa maandamano yanayoendelea, ukishauri kuepuka maeneo ya maandamano kutokana na uwezekano wa vurugu.
Dholuo: Amerka ne osiemo raia kuom gik manyalo hinyo ji e kinde mag piem, kendo ne okonyogi mondo kik gichak dhi e kuonde ma ji timoe nonro nikech timbe gero.

English: Media oversight body condemned arrests and assaults on journalists covering protests, calling for an independent inquiry into press violations.
Kiswahili: Shirika la usimamizi wa vyombo vya habari lililaani kukamatwa na kushambuliwa kwa waandishi wa habari wanaoripoti maandamano, likitaka uchunguzi huru kuhusu ukiukwaji wa vyombo vya habari.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jarito mar Jotim Dhano ne okwedo twege kod timbe mag gero jotim weche ma ne nyiso ni ne gitimo gik ma ne nyiso ni ne gikwedo riwruok mar oganda Nyasaye, kendo ne okwayo mondo otim nonro ma onge mibadhi kuom weche ma ne giwacho.

English: Katiba Institute reported constitutional rights violations during protests and urged judicial safeguards and rights-based policing.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Katiba iliripoti ukiukwaji wa haki za kikatiba wakati wa maandamano na kuhimiza ulinzi wa mahakama na polisi inayozingatia haki.
Dholuo: Katiba Institute ne owacho ni kare ne nitie ketho mag chike mag piny e kinde mar piem kendo ne okwayo ni sirkal otim chenro mar rito chike mag sirkal kod chike mag sirkal.

English: Law Society demanded accountability for commanders behind protest suppression tactics, calling for prosecutions including chain-of-command responsibility.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wanasheria kilidai uwajibikaji kwa makamanda waliohusika na mbinu za kukandamiza maandamano, wakitaka mashtaka yafunguliwe ikiwemo jukumu la mnyororo wa amri.
Dholuo: Law Society ne dwaro ni jotend lweny obed gi ratiro mar tieko akwede, kendo ne gidwaro ni otergi e bura moriwo nyaka joma nigi ratiro mar chiko lweny.

English: A youth movement organized a peaceful march demanding justice for protest victims and reforms to use-of-force protocols.
Kiswahili: Harakati ya vijana iliandaa maandamano ya amani wakidai haki kwa waathiriwa wa maandamano na mageuzi ya itifaki za matumizi ya nguvu.
Dholuo: Riwruok moro mar rowere nochano mar dhi e wuodhe mar lamo ka gidwaro ni otim ne joma ne oketho chik bura bura bura makare kendo mondo otim lokruok e chike ma ne oketo mar tiyo gi teko.

English: Civil society organized silent vigils in Nairobi to honor protest victims and call for justice across diverse communities.
Kiswahili: Asasi za kiraia ziliandaa mikesha ya kimya kimya jijini Nairobi ili kuwaenzi waathiriwa wa maandamano na kutaka haki itendeke katika jamii mbalimbali.
Dholuo: Jo-dhano ne ochano mondo otim nyasi mar rito ji e Nairobi mondo gipakgo joma ne oketho nikech gik ma ne gitimo kendo ne gikwayo ni mondo ji otimnegi makare e kindgi giwegi.

English: Workshops trained young journalists in ethical verification, safe documentation, and protective practices during protest reporting.
Kiswahili: Warsha ziliwafunza waandishi wa habari wachanga katika uthibitishaji wa maadili, uwekaji wa nyaraka salama, na mbinu za ulinzi wakati wa kuripoti maandamano.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma ne otim ne otiego jonenogo e weche mag chike, weche ma ok onego obed ni okethore, koda yore ma ginyalo ritogo ji sama gikelo ripot mag akwede.

English: Community leaders in Garissa received training on early radicalization indicators and reporting procedures under PCVE programs.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa jamii huko Garissa walipokea mafunzo kuhusu viashiria vya mapema vya uasi na taratibu za kuripoti chini ya programu za PCVE.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag oganda Jo-Katholik ne oyudo tiegruok e wi ranyisi mag radikalization kod yore mag chiwo ripot e bwo program mag PCVE.

English: An MoU was signed to integrate gender equality into national PCVE structures and empower women in terrorism-prevention roles.
Kiswahili: MoU ilisainiwa ili kuunganisha usawa wa kijinsia katika miundo ya kitaifa ya PCVE na kuwawezesha wanawake katika majukumu ya kuzuia ugaidi.
Dholuo: Ne oket sei e winjruok mar timo winjruok e kind chwo gi mon e bwo chenro mag piny mangima mar PCVE kendo miyo mon teko mar loyo timbe mahundu.

English: Government sought public input on leveraging AI and technology to detect and prevent self-radicalization trends.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitafuta maoni ya umma kuhusu kutumia akili bandia na teknolojia ili kugundua na kuzuia mitindo ya kujifanya kuwa na msimamo mkali.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne dwaro ni ji ochiw pachgi kuom tiyo gi teko mar timo nonro kod teknoloji mondo gine kendo geng'e timbe mag wuondo ji.

English: Government sought public input on using artificial intelligence and new technologies to strengthen prevention of violent extremism and address rising online recruitment risks.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilitafuta maoni ya umma kuhusu kutumia akili bandia na teknolojia mpya ili kuimarisha kuzuia itikadi kali na kushughulikia hatari zinazoongezeka za kuajiri watu mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne okwayo ji mondo ochiw paro e wi tiyo gi rieko mar loso gik moko kod teknoloji manyien mondo omi ji omed geng'o timbe mahundu kendo mondo gitiek chandruoge ma yudo ji e intanet.

English: Training provided to mining sector stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to reduce misuse by terror groups and prevent smuggling.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yametolewa kwa wadau wa sekta ya madini kuhusu utunzaji salama wa vilipuzi vya kibiashara ili kupunguza matumizi mabaya ya vikundi vya kigaidi na kuzuia ulanguzi wa magendo.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma ne omi joma nie tich mag manyo mwandu mag lowo e wi tiyo gi gik ma nyalo miyo gik ma dongo obedie e ngima maber, mondo omi grube mag mahundu kik ti kodgi marach kendo mondo kik wuoth ma ok kare.

English: Pilot sub county forum launched to build community trust and improve public reporting as part of the national countering violent extremism strategy.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la majaribio la kaunti ndogo limezinduliwa ili kujenga uaminifu wa jamii na kuboresha utoaji wa taarifa kwa umma kama sehemu ya mkakati wa kitaifa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi wa vurugu.
Dholuo: Oganda ma ne tiyo gi weche mag siasa e pinyno nochako timo chenro mar loso winjruok e kind oganda kendo medo chiwo ripot ne ji e wi timbe gero.

English: Expanded training in Kiambu brought together county officials, youth, media, and civil society to strengthen local prevention networks.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yaliyopanuliwa huko Kiambu yaliwaleta pamoja maafisa wa kaunti, vijana, vyombo vya habari, na asasi za kiraia ili kuimarisha mitandao ya kuzuia maambukizi ya virusi vya corona.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma ne otim Kiambu ne oriwo jotelo mag county, rowere, joote, kod oganda mar oganda mondo omed jiwo chenro mag thieth.

English: Public invited to contribute to development of artificial intelligence tools for detecting self radicalization and improving prevention strategies.
Kiswahili: Umma unaalikwa kuchangia katika uundaji wa zana za akili bandia kwa ajili ya kugundua ubinafsi na kuboresha mikakati ya kuzuia.
Dholuo: Ne ogwel ji mondo okony e loso gik ma konyo e ng'eyo kaka dhano nyalo bedo gi paro makare kod kaka ginyalo konyo e tieko timbe maricho.

English: Five day regional training focused on disengagement, de radicalization, and reintegration for security personnel across East Africa.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya kikanda ya siku tano yalilenga kujitenga, kupunguza itikadi kali, na kuwaunganisha tena na jamii kwa wafanyakazi wa usalama kote Afrika Mashariki.
Dholuo: Tiegruok mar ndalo abich mar alwora ne oket e wi golo ji e tij sirkal, golo ji e timbe mag gero, kod duogo e riwruok mar oganda mar sirkal e pinje mag East Africa.

English: Youth beneficiaries in Lamu received entrepreneurship kits and awareness training on preventing violent extremism as part of reintegration efforts.
Kiswahili: Vijana walionufaika huko Lamu walipokea vifaa vya ujasiriamali na mafunzo ya uhamasishaji kuhusu kuzuia itikadi kali kama sehemu ya juhudi za kuwaunganisha tena.
Dholuo: Rowere ma ne oyudo kony e Lamu noyudo gige tich mar bedo jatelo kendo ne giyudo tiegruok mar geng'o timbe mahundu kaka achiel kuom yore mag duoko ji e riwruok manyien.

English: Media Council of Kenya urged journalists to report violent extremism responsibly with emphasis on fact checking and ethical coverage to avoid amplifying radical narratives.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Habari la Kenya liliwahimiza waandishi wa habari kuripoti itikadi kali za kikatili kwa uwajibikaji, wakisisitiza kuangalia ukweli na uandishi wa maadili ili kuepuka kukuza masimulizi ya kikatili.
Dholuo: Bura mar Joote Kenya ne ojiwo jondik weche mondo onyis timbe gero mag gero e yo mowinjore, ka giketo pek ahinya kuom nono adiera kod nyiso timbe mabeyo mondo kik giwuo kuom weche ma kelo timbe gero.

English: County public forums in Nairobi reviewed the updated National Strategy to Prevent and Counter Violent Extremism focusing on gender, youth, and technology.
Kiswahili: Mabaraza ya umma ya kaunti jijini Nairobi yalipitia Mkakati wa Kitaifa uliosasishwa wa Kuzuia na Kupambana na Ugaidi unaozingatia jinsia, vijana, na teknolojia.
Dholuo: Chokruoge mag ji duto ma ne nitie Nairobi ne onono chenro mar National Strategy to Prevent and Counter Violent Extremism ma ne otim manyien, ma ne oketo pachgi kuom weche mag nindruok, rowere, kod teknoloji.

English: Community policing campaign in Lamu engaged youth, elders, and security agencies to strengthen early warning and reporting systems.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya polisi jamii huko Lamu iliwashirikisha vijana, wazee, na mashirika ya usalama ili kuimarisha mifumo ya tahadhari na utoaji wa taarifa mapema.
Dholuo: Kampen mar rito sirkal mar Lamu ne oriwo rowere, jodongo, kod riwruoge mag sirkal mondo omed jiwo chenro mag chiwo ripot e kinde ma weche biro chakore.

English: Journalists from multiple counties trained on responsible reporting of violent extremism to prevent sensationalism and reduce harm.
Kiswahili: Waandishi wa habari kutoka kaunti nyingi walipata mafunzo kuhusu kuripoti kwa uwajibikaji kuhusu itikadi kali za kikatili ili kuzuia uchochezi na kupunguza madhara.
Dholuo: Jofwamb weche moa e pinje mang'eny ne otieg mondo kik gibed gi timbe mahundu kendo mondo kik giketh gik ma timore.

English: Counties along the Somalia border face heightened terrorism threats and essential travel only is advised.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zilizo kando ya mpaka wa Somalia zinakabiliwa na vitisho vya ugaidi vilivyoongezeka na usafiri muhimu pekee unashauriwa.
Dholuo: Alwora man machiegni gi tong' mar Somalia romo gi pek mag timbe mahundu kendo ji duto ma dhi e pinje mamoko e ma dwarore ni owuoth.

English: Security tightened in Lamu following recent attacks and travelers are urged to remain vigilant and avoid certain road routes.
Kiswahili: Usalama umeimarishwa Lamu kufuatia mashambulizi ya hivi karibuni na wasafiri wanahimizwa kuwa macho na kuepuka njia fulani za barabarani.
Dholuo: Sirkal osemiyo weche mag sirkal omedo bedo matek e taon mar Lamu bang' masiche ma nyocha otimore, kendo ojiw jowuoth mondo obed motang' kendo kik giwuoth e nderni moko.

English: United Kingdom advisory urges alertness in hotels, malls, and transport hubs and encourages use of counter terrorism guidance.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa Uingereza unahimiza tahadhari katika hoteli, maduka makubwa, na vituo vya usafiri na unahimiza matumizi ya mwongozo wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar piny Britain jiwo ahinya ni ji obed motang' e ute mag otel, e chiro, kod kuonde ma ji wuokie e wuoth, kendo ojiwo ni oti gi weche ma tayo ji mondo gikwed timbe mahundu.

English: Advisories recommend avoiding large gatherings and taking caution during religious and cultural events due to elevated risks.
Kiswahili: Ushauri unapendekeza kuepuka mikusanyiko mikubwa na kuchukua tahadhari wakati wa matukio ya kidini na kitamaduni kutokana na hatari kubwa.
Dholuo: Jotim nonro nyiso ni ber mondo kik ichokre e chokruoge madongo kendo iti gi rieko sama itimo chokruoge mag din kod kit ngima ji nikech nitie pek mang'eny.

English: High threat of kidnapping targeting foreigners in northern and coastal areas and travelers are urged to avoid high risk zones.
Kiswahili: Tishio kubwa la utekaji nyara unaolenga wageni katika maeneo ya kaskazini na pwani na wasafiri wanahimizwa kuepuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Dholuo: Ojiwo joma owuok e pinje mamoko mondo kik omigi thuolo mar dhi e pinje mamoko.

English: Terrorist attacks are more likely during major holidays and the public is urged to maintain heightened awareness and avoid crowded spaces.
Kiswahili: Mashambulizi ya kigaidi yana uwezekano mkubwa wa kutokea wakati wa sikukuu kuu na umma unahimizwa kudumisha uelewa mkubwa na kuepuka nafasi zilizojaa watu.
Dholuo: Thoth ji nyalo timo timbe mahundu e kinde mag nyasi madongo kendo ijiwo ji mondo obed motang' gi pek mag ngima kendo kik gibed gi kuonde ma ji ng'enyie.

English: Government outlines offenses classified as terrorism under the Prevention of Terrorism Act and urges public awareness of legal obligations.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaelezea makosa yaliyoainishwa kama ugaidi chini ya Sheria ya Kuzuia Ugaidi na inahimiza uelewa wa umma kuhusu majukumu ya kisheria.
Dholuo: Sirkal lero timbe mahundu ma iwuoyo kuomgi e Chik mar Kwedo Timbe Mahundu kendo ojiwo ji mondo ong'e chike ma chik dwaro ni gitim.

English: National Assembly strengthens laws to detect and prevent terrorism financing and improve transparency across financial systems.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kitaifa linaimarisha sheria za kugundua na kuzuia ufadhili wa ugaidi na kuboresha uwazi katika mifumo yote ya fedha.
Dholuo: Bura mar National Assembly otego chike mondo onyis kendo ogeng'o weche mag pesa ma itiyogo e chulo pesa mag wuondo ji kendo mondo okony e miyo weche mag pesa obed maler.

English: United Nations and Kenyan agencies co hosted workshops to help local officials and communities address incitement and prevent extremism.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa na mashirika ya Kenya yaliandaa warsha ili kuwasaidia maafisa wa eneo hilo na jamii kushughulikia uchochezi na kuzuia itikadi kali.
Dholuo: Riwruok mag Pinje kod Kenya ne ochako timo chokruok mar tich mondo okony jotelo kod oganda ma kuno kedo gi timbe mag gero kod geng'o timbe gero.

English: Reports show continued Al Shabaab activity near the Somalia border and call for sustained vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ripoti zinaonyesha shughuli za Al Shabaab zinaendelea karibu na mpaka wa Somalia na zinahitaji umakini endelevu.
Dholuo: Ripot nyiso ni Al Shabaab dhi nyime gi tich machiegni gi tong' mar Somalia kendo gidwaro ni gibed motang'.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre continues public alerts urging vigilance and reporting of suspicious activity.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kinaendelea kutoa tahadhari kwa umma kikihimiza uangalifu na kuripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: National Counter Terrorism Centre dhi nyime chiwo siem ne ji duto mondo gibed motang' gi jonjore

English: Critics warn that terrorism related charges applied to protestors must balance security with constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Wakosoaji wanaonya kwamba mashtaka yanayohusiana na ugaidi yanayowakabili waandamanaji lazima yasawazishe usalama na haki za kikatiba.
Dholuo: Joma kwedo weche din wacho ni ketho mag mahundu ma ne oter ne joma ne kedo ne sirkal ne nyaka pog winjruok e kind sirkal kod chike mag piny.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre calls for prompt reporting of suspicious activities.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kinatoa wito wa kuripotiwa haraka kwa shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: National Counter Terrorism Centre dwaro ni ji ochiw ripot mapiyo kuom gik ma chando ji.

English: A UN workshop brought together multiple sectors to improve strategies for preventing violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Warsha ya Umoja wa Mataifa ilileta pamoja sekta nyingi ili kuboresha mikakati ya kuzuia itikadi kali za kikatili.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje ma nono weche siasa e piny mangima, ne ochako timo chokruok mondo okony e geng'o gero.

English: A terrorism threat report outlines activity by al Shabaab and IS and stresses public vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya vitisho vya ugaidi inaelezea shughuli zinazofanywa na al Shabaab na IS na inasisitiza umakini wa umma.
Dholuo: Ripot moro mar weche ma nyiso ni ji oheroga tiyo gi weche mag mahundu nyiso kaka al Shabaab kod IS timo gik ma nyiso ni ji pod ni motang'.

English: Summary of tactics used in Westgate, Garissa, and Dusit attacks with government guidance on reporting, preparedness, and emergency response.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa mbinu zilizotumika katika mashambulizi ya Westgate, Garissa, na Dusit pamoja na mwongozo wa serikali kuhusu kuripoti, utayari, na majibu ya dharura.
Dholuo: Weche machuok e wi yore ma ne otigo e lweny mar Westgate, Garissa, kod Dusit, ka sirkal chiko kaka onego otim tij lendo, bedo moikore, kod chiwo kony e kinde mag chandruok.

English: Advisory highlighting increased terrorism threats in the United States and urging vigilance and reporting of suspicious activities.
Kiswahili: Ushauri unaoangazia ongezeko la vitisho vya ugaidi nchini Marekani na kuhimiza uangalifu na kuripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: Puonj ma jiwo kaka timbe mahundu medo bedoe e piny Amerka kendo jiwo ni ji obed motang' kendo ochiw ripot kuom gik ma chando ji.

English: National campaign encouraging the public to report suspicious activity to prevent terrorism related crimes.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kuhamasisha umma kuripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka ili kuzuia uhalifu unaohusiana na ugaidi.
Dholuo: Kampen mar piny mangima mar jiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot kuom timbe ma ok kare ma timore e ngima dhano mondo gikwed timbe mahundu.

English: Message encouraging citizens to recognize and report suspicious behavior noting that vigilance strengthens community security.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe unaowahimiza raia kutambua na kuripoti tabia za kutiliwa shaka ukibainisha kuwa uangalifu huimarisha usalama wa jamii.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo raia mondo ohul timbe ma ok kare, ka owacho ni rito ji miyo sirkal bedo gi rit maber.

English: Advisory urging reporting of suspicious activity in public spaces such as schools, concerts, and sporting events.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa kuhimiza kuripotiwa kwa shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka katika maeneo ya umma kama vile shule, matamasha, na matukio ya michezo.
Dholuo: Puonj ma jiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e wi gik ma chando ji e alwora ma ji nitie kaka skul, thum, koda tuke.

English: EU guidance on gender responsive and violence prevention measures within the counter terrorism strategy.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa EU kuhusu hatua za kuzuia ukatili na kukabiliana na jinsia ndani ya mkakati wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Dholuo: Puonj ma ji chiwo e wi weche mag nindruok kod geng'o timbe gero e bwo chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya's strategy to curb radicalization and prevent violent extremism through community engagement and multi agency responses.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Kenya wa kupunguza itikadi kali na kuzuia itikadi kali kupitia ushiriki wa jamii na majibu ya mashirika mengi.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar geng'o ji mondo kik gibed gi timbe mahundu kendo geng'o timbe mahundu kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda koda riwruok mopogore opogore.

English: Summary of Anti Terrorism Police Unit mandate to prevent detect and investigate terrorism through cooperation and outreach.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa agizo la Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi la kuzuia kugundua na kuchunguza ugaidi kupitia ushirikiano na ufikiaji.
Dholuo: Weche machuok mag migawo mar polise ma kedo gi timbe mahundu mar geng'o timbe mahundu kik timre kendo timo nonro kuomgi kokalo kuom tich ma gitiyogo e konyo ji.

English: Kenya's cybersecurity strategy to protect critical information infrastructure and enhance public online safety.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa usalama wa mtandao wa Kenya kulinda miundombinu muhimu ya taarifa na kuimarisha usalama wa umma mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar rito weche mag intanet mondo orit weche mag weche mag intanet kendo omed miyo ji obed gi ritruok e Intanet.

English: Highlights efforts to raise awareness on online safety and cybersecurity, emphasizing child protection.
Kiswahili: Inaangazia juhudi za kuongeza uelewa kuhusu usalama mtandaoni na usalama wa mtandao, ikisisitiza ulinzi wa watoto.
Dholuo: Ojiwo kinda mitimo mar miyo ji ong'e weche motudore gi ritruok e Intanet kod weche mag intanet, kendo ojiwo ahinya rito nyithindo.

English: Describes Anti Terrorism Police Unit prevention and investigation work using specialized teams.
Kiswahili: Inaelezea kazi ya kuzuia na uchunguzi wa Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kwa kutumia timu maalum.
Dholuo: Olero tije mag polise mag geng'o timbe mahundu kod timo nonro ka gitiyo gi grube molony.

English: Calls for stronger consumer education and digital safety to address cyber threats.
Kiswahili: Inatoa wito wa elimu bora kwa watumiaji na usalama wa kidijitali ili kukabiliana na vitisho vya mtandao.
Dholuo: Ojiwo mondo oti gi yore mag manyo mor kod yueyo e konyo joma dwaro tiyo gi Intanet.

English: Reports on campaigns building trust and intelligence sharing with communities.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kuhusu kampeni zinazojenga uaminifu na ushiriki wa akili na jamii.
Dholuo: Ripot ma nyiso kaka kampen mag gero geno kod pogo weche mag sirkal gi ji konyo.

English: Outlines Anti Terrorism Police Unit operations focused on investigations and public cooperation.
Kiswahili: Inaelezea shughuli za Kitengo cha Polisi cha Kupambana na Ugaidi zinazolenga uchunguzi na ushirikiano wa umma.
Dholuo: Olero tije mag polise ma kedo gi timbe mahundu ma ne itimo e kindgi kod joma ne timo nonro kod joma ne tiyo kanyachiel gi ji.

English: NCTC uses online platforms to increase awareness and reporting.
Kiswahili: NCTC hutumia majukwaa ya mtandaoni ili kuongeza uelewa na utoaji wa taarifa.
Dholuo: NCTC tiyo gi chenro mag intanet mondo okony ji ong'e kendo ochiw ripot.

English: Kenya updated the PBO Act to tighten oversight on terrorism financing. Stay compliant and report suspicious activity.
Kiswahili: Kenya ilisasisha Sheria ya PBO ili kuimarisha usimamizi wa ufadhili wa ugaidi. Endelea kufuata sheria na uripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: Kenya oseloso Chik mar PBO mondo omed rito weche mag pesa ma itiyogo e chulo timbe mahundu.

English: Corruption threatens security and growth. Report unethical conduct to safeguard public resources.
Kiswahili: Rushwa inatishia usalama na ukuaji. Ripoti mwenendo usio wa kimaadili ili kulinda rasilimali za umma.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda Jehova biro miyo ji duto obed gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Report corruption anonymously through hotlines and portals to support fast investigations.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ufisadi bila kujulikana kupitia simu za dharura na milango ili kusaidia uchunguzi wa haraka.
Dholuo: Nyis ji ketho nyinggi e yor miriambo kokalo kuom simo kod websait mondo okony e timo nonro mapiyo.

English: Learn how corruption affects services and take part in community education to prevent it.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi rushwa inavyoathiri huduma na ushiriki katika elimu ya jamii ili kuizuia.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka mibadhi chiko tije mag lendo kendo ikri mondo ikony ji kik obed gi mibadhi.

English: Transparent governance improves safety and service delivery. Stay alert and speak up in your community.
Kiswahili: Utawala wa uwazi huboresha usalama na utoaji wa huduma. Endelea kuwa macho na zungumza katika jamii yako.
Dholuo: Bedo gi chenro maber mar tayo weche miyo weche bedo maber kendo miyo ji bedo gi ritruok.

English: Reporting corruption aids asset recovery and strengthens law enforcement. Use official channels.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti ufisadi husaidia kurejesha mali na kuimarisha utekelezaji wa sheria. Tumia njia rasmi.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato chiwo ripot e wi mibadhi, mano konyo e chulo mwandu kendo jiwo chike.

English: KNCHR calls for stronger measures to protect human rights from corruption impacts.
Kiswahili: KNCHR inatoa wito wa hatua kali zaidi za kulinda haki za binadamu kutokana na athari za ufisadi.
Dholuo: KNCHR dwaro ni otim kinda ahinya mondo orit ratiro mag dhano kik kethre gi mibadhi.

English: African Anti‑Corruption Day 2025 urged united action against abuses of human dignity.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Kupambana na Rushwa ya Afrika 2025 ilihimiza hatua za pamoja dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa utu wa binadamu.
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar kedo gi mibadhi e Afrika 2025 ne ojiwo ni mondo otim kinda e kedo gi timbe maricho mag ketho nying dhano.

English: EACC raised awareness at the 2025 Eldoret Show on reporting corruption.
Kiswahili: EACC ilitoa uelewa katika Onyesho la Eldoret la 2025 kuhusu kuripoti ufisadi.
Dholuo: EACC ne ochiwo paro e wi ripot mar mibadhi e higa mar 2025 Eldoret Show.

English: New rules require officers to declare gifts and avoid conflicts of interest.
Kiswahili: Sheria mpya zinawataka maafisa kutangaza zawadi na kuepuka migongano ya maslahi.
Dholuo: Chike manyien dwaro ni jotelo ochiw mich kendo gitang' gi ywaruok mag dwaro mag jomoko.

English: A procurement ban bill seeks to deter corruption through strict penalties.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa marufuku ya ununuzi unalenga kuzuia ufisadi kupitia adhabu kali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar golo chik marfuk chulo pesa dwaro geng'o mibadhi kokalo kuom kum mager.

English: Rise in robberies and unrest during protests calls for vigilance.
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa wizi na machafuko wakati wa maandamano kunahitaji uangalifu.
Dholuo: Kwan mar joma kwalo gik moko kod joma ok winjre e kindgi e kinde mag protest dwaro ni wabed motang'.

English: New report shows increased blogger harassment; verify safety online.
Kiswahili: Ripoti mpya inaonyesha ongezeko la unyanyasaji wa wanablogu; thibitisha usalama mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Ripot manyien nyiso kaka sand mar josomo omedore; nonuru ni ginyalo bedo gi ritruok e Intanet.

English: Travelers should exercise high caution due to terror and unrest risks.
Kiswahili: Wasafiri wanapaswa kuwa waangalifu sana kutokana na hatari za ugaidi na machafuko.
Dholuo: Joma wuotho onego obed motang' ahinya nikech gik manyalo kelo luoro kod ywaruok.

English: Experts warn of protest‑related unrest; avoid high‑risk areas.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wanaonya kuhusu machafuko yanayohusiana na maandamano; epuka maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Dholuo: Jotim nonro nyiso ni nitie gik manyalo kelo ywaruok e kind ji kod joma ok oyie gi puonjno; kendo gitemo matek mondo kik gibed gi timbe maricho.

English: Protests caused disruptions; stay alert and follow safety guidance.
Kiswahili: Maandamano yalisababisha usumbufu; kaa macho na fuata mwongozo wa usalama.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne otimore ne ji ne ok dhi maber; ne dwarore ni ibed motang' kendo iluw weche ma ne okor.

English: US global caution highlights terrorism threats; stay vigilant.
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya kimataifa ya Marekani inaangazia vitisho vya ugaidi; endelea kuwa macho.
Dholuo: Weche ma Jo-US wacho e wi piny mangima nyiso ni nitie gik ma kelo luoro ji; beduru motang'.

English: KNCHR urges action on human rights abuses and safety risks.
Kiswahili: KNCHR yahimiza hatua kuchukuliwa dhidi ya ukiukwaji wa haki za binadamu na hatari za usalama.
Dholuo: KNCHR jiwo ahinya mondo otim kinda e tieko ketho ratiro mag dhano kod gik manyalo miyo ngima ji obed matek.

English: Terror threats remain high; avoid high‑profile crowded areas.
Kiswahili: Vitisho vya ugaidi vinabaki juu; epuka maeneo yenye msongamano mkubwa.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, nitie gik ma nyalo miyo ji obed gi luoro mang'eny.

English: Enhanced airport and public‑space security aims to protect visitors.
Kiswahili: Usalama ulioimarishwa wa viwanja vya ndege na anga za umma unalenga kuwalinda wageni.
Dholuo: Tego sirkal mar ndege kod sirkal mar alwora dwaro rito jowuoth.

English: July 7 protests expected; avoid major towns and demonstrations.
Kiswahili: Maandamano ya Julai 7 yanatarajiwa; kuepuka miji mikubwa na maandamano.
Dholuo: Ne igeno ni ibiro tim gik ma ne dhi timore e dwe mar Julai 7, kendo ne ok idhi tim gik ma ne dhi timore e taonde madongo.

English: Government issued directives on firearm use, including shoot‑to‑leg order.

Kiswahili: Tume inawasihi wapiga kura, wagombea na mawakala kudumisha utulivu katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura, kuepuka kuvaa au kubeba vifaa vya kampeni na kuepuka kufanya kampeni wakiwa kwenye foleni #UchaguziMdogo wa Oktoba14.
Dholuo: Komisenano jiwo jogo ombulu,joland kombe kod jochung' mondo orit kwe e kuonde duto mag goyo ombulu, kik girwak kata ting'o gige kampen kendo kik girwak gige kampen ka gin e opara mar yiero #Oktoba14th By elections.

English: In addition to the matters already under investigations, EACC urges any person with relevant information to promptly report to us
Kiswahili: Mbali na masuala ambayo tayari yanachunguzwa, EACC inamsihi mtu yeyote mwenye taarifa muhimu aturipoti haraka.
Dholuo: Mopogore gi weche ma nonro gi dhi nyime, EACC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi weche madwarore mondo ochiwnegi ripot mapiyo.

English: The Commission calls upon candidates and members of the public to maintain peace and order during the campaign period.
Kiswahili: Tume inatoa wito kwa wagombea na umma kudumisha amani na utulivu wakati wa kampeni.
Dholuo: Komisenano dwaro ni jochung' kod jogo ombulu obed gi kwe e kinde kampenno.

English: Stay alert, share your info with imposters. Report and block any suspicious accounts.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho, shiriki taarifa zako na wadanganyifu. Ripoti na uzuie akaunti zozote zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: Bed motang', nyisi weche mari ne joma wuondore, kendo igeng' akaunt moramora ma chiji.

English: EACC urges Cooperatives that for them to remain commercially viable and sustainable enterprises for socio-economic development, they must embrace tenets of good governance; realized through selfless delivery, embracing integrity, transparency and accountability
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza Vyama vya Ushirika kwamba ili viendelee kuwa na faida kibiashara na biashara endelevu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi, lazima vikumbatie kanuni za utawala bora; zinazopatikana kupitia utoaji usio na ubinafsi, kukumbatia uadilifu, uwazi na uwajibikaji.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo riwruoge mag ohala ni mondo gidhi nyime bedo gi ohala maber kendo ma dhi nyime e dongruok mar oganda koda mar ohala, nyaka giyie gi chenro mag loch maber; ma nyaka timre kokalo kuom chiwruok mar chiwruok, luwo tim makare, ng'eyo tiend weche, kod ting' mar ting'o ting'

English: KRA urges all licensed manufacturers, importers, distributors, retailers and general public that all bottled water beverages manufactured in or imported into Kenya from 13th November 2019 must be affixed with an Excise Stamp in compliance with the EGMS Regulations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wazalishaji wote walioidhinishwa, waagizaji, wasambazaji, wauzaji rejareja na umma kwa ujumla kwamba vinywaji vyote vya maji ya chupa vinavyotengenezwa au kuingizwa nchini Kenya kuanzia tarehe 13 Novemba 2019 lazima viambatishwe na Stempu ya Ushuru kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za EGMS.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo kambe man gi otiko mar loso gik moko, joma kelo gik moko e pinje mamoko, jochwal mwandu, jolok ohala, kod ji duto mondo ong'e ni chakre dwe mar apar gi achiel tarik apr kod adek higa amr alufu ariyo kod apar kod ochiko, gik moko duto mitiyogo e chamo pi modhi e piny Kenya, kata ma gigolo e pinyno, nyaka ketnegi alama mar osuru kaluwore gi chike mag EGMS.

English: We remain steadfast in ensuring the safety and well-being of Kenyans and urges anyone who spots problematic wildlife to immediately report the sighting through the KWS 24/7 hotline on or WhatsApp number
Kiswahili: Tunabaki imara katika kuhakikisha usalama na ustawi wa Wakenya na tunamsihi yeyote anayeona wanyamapori wenye matatizo kuripoti mara moja tukio hilo kupitia simu ya dharura ya KWS saa 24/7 kwa au nambari ya WhatsApp .
Dholuo: Wadhi nyime timo kinda mar rito ngima kod ngima mar Jo-Kenya kendo wajiwo ng'ato ang'ata moneno le ma nigi chandruok mondo ochiw ripot mapiyo kuom KWS 24 / 7 mondo one mach e simo mar kata namba mar WhatsApp ma en

English: EACC urges members of the public not to at any time succumb to bribe demands from public officials but always report such matters.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wananchi kutokubali madai ya rushwa kutoka kwa maafisa wa umma wakati wowote bali waripoti masuala kama hayo kila wakati.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jopiny mondo kik gidog chien ne weche asoya ma idwaro kod jotelo to gibed ka giwachwlo lipode ma kamago.

English: VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT, TEMPORARY POSITIONS The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) seeks to recruit temporary staff to serve in the following capacities: 1. Voter Registration Clerks: To be deployed across the 57 Huduma Centres countrywide, and 2. By-Election Poll Officials. For more information visit
Kiswahili: TANGAZO LA NAFASI ZA KAZI, NAFASI ZA MUDA Tume Huru ya Uchaguzi na Mipaka (IEBC) inatafuta kuajiri wafanyakazi wa muda kuhudumu katika nafasi zifuatazo: 1. Dholuo: lendo mag thuolo mantie, mag kinde moketi Migawo mag yiero kod tong' mag pinje (IEBC) dwaro tiyo gi jotich ma tiyo kuom thuolo machuok e migepe maluwogi: achiel. Jondiko mag josiasa: ibiro ti kodgi e kuonde piero abich kod abiriyo mag huduma centers e piny mangima, kod ariyo. Jotelo mag yiero mag yiero. kuom mathoth lim

English: Kisero Kennedy, Secretary-General of KeMUSA, calls on Kenyan youth to take up voter registration in masses.
Kiswahili: Kisero Kennedy, Katibu Mkuu wa KeMUSA, anatoa wito kwa vijana wa Kenya kuandikisha wapiga kura kwa wingi.
Dholuo: Kisoro Kennedy, Jandiko Maduong' mar KMUSA, ogwelo rowere mag Kenya mondo oket rejista mar joma biro yiero.

English: Govt warns that citizens should brace themselves for a bumpy ride ahead, as an additional 10 to 15 billion shillings will be required to subsidise fuel in the coming months
Kiswahili: Serikali yaonya kwamba raia wanapaswa kujitayarisha kwa safari ngumu mbele, kwani shilingi bilioni 10 hadi 15 za ziada zitahitajika ili kutoa ruzuku kwa mafuta katika miezi ijayo.
Dholuo: Sirkal chiwo siem ni jopiny onego otim chenro mag wuodhgi chon, nikech ibiro dwarore ni giyud pesa momedore mar bilion apar nyaka apar kod abich e dweche mabiro.

English: Conservationist Jim Nyamu urges residents of Marsabit County to protect elephants.
Kiswahili: Mhifadhi Jim Nyamu anawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuwalinda tembo.
Dholuo: Jim Nyampat, ma en jal ma rito alwora mar piny, kwayo Jo-Marsabit mondo orit lieje

English: Reprieve in Tiaty: Tiaty gets office for registration of births and deaths Office to save residents over 230 km of travel PS Bitok urges residents to make use of office
Kiswahili: Ahueni Tiaty: Tiaty yapata ofisi kwa ajili ya usajili wa vizazi na vifo Ofisi ya kuwaokoa wakazi zaidi ya kilomita 230 za usafiri Katibu Mkuu Bitok awahimiza wakazi kutumia ofisi
Dholuo: Konyruok e Tiaty: Tiaty yudo ofis mar ndiko nyuol kod ofis mar ndiko thoe mondo ores joma odak kuom kilomita mia ariyo kod piero adek mag wuoth mar Jagoro Bitok jiwo jodak mondooti kod apisno.

English: Meru County Commissioner urges residents who need government services to make use of Huduma Centre.
Kiswahili: Kamishna wa Kaunti ya Meru anawasihi wakazi wanaohitaji huduma za serikali kutumia Kituo cha Huduma.
Dholuo: Komisona ma Kaunti ma Meru jiwo ji duto madwaro kony moa kuom sirkal mondo oti gi huduma centers maber.

English: CALL FOR CONSERVATION Embu residents urged to adopt a tree planting culture
Kiswahili: WITO WA UHIFADHI Wakazi wa Embu wahimizwa kufuata utamaduni wa upandaji miti
Dholuo: luong mar rito jodak e kaunti ma Embu onjiw mondo gibed gi kido kod tim mar pidho yien.

English: Conserving degraded lands: Nakuru residents urged to help in protecting lands next rivers.
Kiswahili: Kuhifadhi ardhi zilizoharibika: Wakazi wa Nakuru wahimizwa kusaidia katika kulinda ardhi iliyo karibu na mito.
Dholuo: Rito lowo ma ne okethore: Jo-Nakuru ne ojiw mondo okony e rit lope manie geng aore.

English: MALINDI COHESION CALLS Residents urged to be wary of politicians sowing seeds of discord Local leaders want action taken against politicians propagating hate
Kiswahili: WITO WA UMOJA WA MALINDI WAWAKILISHA Wakazi kuwa waangalifu na wanasiasa wanaopanda mbegu za kutoelewana Viongozi wa eneo hilo wanataka hatua zichukuliwe dhidi ya wanasiasa wanaoeneza chuki
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Malindi jiwo ji mondo otang ' gi josiasa ma chwoyo kodhi mag jotelo mag gweng'no, dwaro okang' okaw ne jotelo majiwo akwede.

English: KEEPING THE DOCTOR AWAY ¦ Free medical camp held in Machakos town Residents urged to go for frequent medical checks
Kiswahili: KUMWEKA DAKTARI MBALI ¦ Kambi ya matibabu ya bure yafanyika mjini Machakos Wakazi wahimizwa kwenda kwa uchunguzi wa kimatibabu mara kwa mara
Dholuo: Bedo mabor gi laktar romo manono oket e taon ma Machakos jodak ojiw mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth kinde ka kinde.

English: Laikipia residents urged to join NHIF to avoid seeking hospital waivers
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Laikipia wahimizwa kujiunga na NHIF ili kuepuka kuomba msamaha wa hospitali
Dholuo: Jo-Laikipia ojiw mondo oriwre gi NHIF mondo giwe manyo thieth manono.

English: Lamu residents urged to protect wildlife for future generations' benefit
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Lamu wahimizwa kulinda wanyamapori kwa manufaa ya vizazi vijavyo
Dholuo: Jodak Lamu okwa mondo orit le mag bungu mondo okony tieng' mabiro.

English: Saving Marsabit Forests: Measures launched to protect forests and water bodies in the county Stakeholders urged to sensitise residents to help combat degradation Residents urged to plant trees to protect water catchment areas
Kiswahili: Kuokoa Misitu ya Marsabit: Hatua zilizozinduliwa kulinda misitu na vyanzo vya maji katika kaunti Wadau wahimizwa kuhamasisha wakazi kusaidia kupambana na uharibifu Wakazi wahimizwa kupanda miti ili kulinda maeneo ya vyanzo vya maji
Dholuo: Konyo bungu mar Masabit: Chenro mag rito bunge kod yiende mag pi e kaunti'no ne ojiw jokanyo ne ojwi mondo owuo kod jodak mondo okony e rito lowo ojiw jodak mondo opidh yiende mondo oywa pi.

English: Commission on administrative justice opens Garissa office; residents urged to report issues that need attention.
Kiswahili: Tume ya haki ya utawala yafungua ofisi ya Garissa; wakazi wahimizwa kuripoti masuala yanayohitaji kushughulikiwa.
Dholuo: Kamisen mar adiera e telo oyawo apis ma Garisa, Jodak ojiw mondo ochiw ripot e wi weche madwarore ahinya.

English: Leaders from Tana River County urged to collaborate to ensure citizens benefit from development projects.
Kiswahili: Viongozi kutoka Kaunti ya Tana River wamehimizwa kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha raia wananufaika na miradi ya maendeleo.
Dholuo: Jotelo ma Kaunti ma Tana River ojiw mondo oti kanyachiel mondo gine ni ji duto yudo ber kuom chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA ENROLLMENT Deputy Gov't Spokesperson Mwanaisha Chidzuga has urged citizens to enroll in SHA, which aims to improve healthcare services and provide protection against high medical costs.
Kiswahili: UANDIKISHAJI WA SHA Naibu Msemaji wa Serikali Mwanaisha Chidzuga amewasihi raia kujiandikisha katika SHA, ambayo inalenga kuboresha huduma za afya na kutoa ulinzi dhidi ya gharama kubwa za matibabu.
Dholuo: Ndikruok e SHA Jalup jaloso elo sirkal Mwanaisha Chidzuga osenyiso ji ni gidonj e SHA, ma dwaro ni ji otim dongruok e weche thieth kendo gimi ji ritruok kuom nengo mag thieth.

English: EACC does not condone any form of corruption among staff. Kindly report the case you refer to through Citizens are urged to beware of fraudsters impersonating EACC staff.
Kiswahili: EACC haikubaliani na aina yoyote ya ufisadi miongoni mwa wafanyakazi. Tafadhali ripoti kesi unayoirejelea kupitia Raia wanahimizwa kuwa waangalifu dhidi ya wadanganyifu wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa EACC.
Dholuo: EACC ok oyie gi mibadhi moro amora e kind jotich. Riwruogno orwako wachno kokalo kuom Ojiw ji mondo otang' gi joma wuondore ni gin jotich e riwruok mar EACC.

English: Mwananchi views: Members of the public advised to read and understand the BBI report
Kiswahili: Maoni ya Mwananchi: Umma washauriwa kusoma na kuelewa ripoti ya BBI
Dholuo: paro mar japiny: Jopiny ojiw mondo osom kendo owinj ripot mar BBI

English: Thank you for your feedback. Please report all cases of corruption and bribery to EACCKenya
Kiswahili: Asante kwa maoni yako. Tafadhali ripoti kesi zote za ufisadi na rushwa kwa EACCKenya
Dholuo: Erokamano kuom dwoko mari. nyis weche duto motudore gi mibadhi kod asoya ne riwruok mar EACC Kenya.

English: You are most welcome to Integrity Centre or any of our regional offices. You can visit to report corruption or share knowledge on how best we can fight corruption.
Kiswahili: Karibu sana katika Kituo cha Uadilifu au ofisi yoyote ya mkoa wetu. Unaweza kutembelea ili kuripoti ufisadi au kushiriki maarifa kuhusu jinsi tunavyoweza kupambana na ufisadi.
Dholuo: Warwaki ahinya e apis mar Intergrity Center kata e ofis moro amora mar gwenge. Inyalo limo ofisno mondo inyis ji wach mibadhi kata imiwa yo kaka wanyalo kedo gi mibadhi.

English: You are welcome to report corruption please call Toll Free line 1551 or email
Kiswahili: Mwaareganigwe mwensi koenana amang'ana igoro y'obokurumi ase enchera yesimu ya bosa 1551 gose otome rirube riembeo
Dholuo: Warwaki mondo ichiw lipot mar mibadhi, tudri gi namba mar 1551 kata mbui mar

English: Good morning. We process number plates within 7 working days. Never deal with brokers. Report cases of corruption to @EACCKenya
Kiswahili: Habari za asubuhi. Tunashughulikia nambari za usajili ndani ya siku 7 za kazi. Kamwe usishughulikie madalali. Ripoti visa vya ufisadi kwa @EACCKenya
Dholuo: Okinyi maber. Watiyo gi ndalo abiriyo mag tich e loso plede. Kik iti kod broka. Chiw Ripot mar mibadhi ne @EACCKenya.

English: Good evening. Please note the Duty field has been updated as PAID and your records were updated. You can now view your vehicle details via the service portal.
Kiswahili: Habari za jioni. Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa sehemu ya Ushuru imesasishwa kama IMALIPO na rekodi zako zimesasishwa. Sasa unaweza kuona maelezo ya gari lako kupitia lango la huduma.
Dholuo: Odhiambo maber. Ng'e ni kuonde mitiyogo e chulo osuru sani oseloki mana kaka ne ichulo, kendo weche misendikogo sani oseloki. Inyalo neno weche mag mtokni kokalo kuom websait mar tij lendo.

English: You don't need to deal with a broker to access any NTSA service. Kindly report corruption and bribery related
Kiswahili: Huna haja ya kushughulika na dalali ili kupata huduma yoyote ya NTSA. Tafadhali ripoti kuhusu ufisadi na rushwa zinazohusiana
Dholuo: Ok ochuno ni nyaka iti kod jachung' mondo iyud chenro mar NTSA. Chiw lipot mar mibadhi kod motenore kod asoya.

English: Kindly proceed to apply for a duplicate logbook from your account. Please reach out if your require any more information.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali endelea kutuma maombi ya kitabu cha kumbukumbu kutoka kwa akaunti yako. Tafadhali wasiliana nasi ikiwa unahitaji maelezo zaidi.
Dholuo: Ka diher ng'eyo weche momedore, inyalo dhi nyime kwayo mondo okonyi yudo kopi ariyo mag bugno mar mtoka.

English: No room for corruption or laziness,  CS Geoffrey Ruku has urged all public servants to uphold professionalism, report to work on time, and treat Kenyans with dignity and respect.
Kiswahili: Hakuna nafasi ya ufisadi au uvivu,  Waziri Geoffrey Ruku amewasihi watumishi wote wa umma kudumisha weledi, kuripoti kazini kwa wakati, na kuwatendea Wakenya kwa utu na heshima.
Dholuo: Onge thuolo mar mibadhi kod yulo. Geoffrey Ruku osejiwo jotich duto mag sirkal mondo oti tijegi, otim tijegi e sa mowinjore, kendo otim ne Jo-Kenya gik moko gi luor kod luor.

English: Call Toll Free line 1551 or email to report cases of corruption.
Kiswahili: Piga simu ya bure 1551 au tuma barua pepe kwa ili kuripoti visa vya ufisadi.
Dholuo: Tudri gi namba mar 1551 maonge chudo kata or e-mail mondo inyis ji weche mag mibadhi.

English: Please feel free to report any cases of forgery or corruption via email or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali jisikie huru kuripoti visa vyovyote vya kughushi au ufisadi kupitia barua pepe au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Inyalo oro ripot moro amora mar gik mochuogi kata mibadhi kitiyo gi kata igo simo e namba mar 1551.

English: Report via email or call 1551 in case you have specific corruption cases which need action.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kupitia barua pepe au piga simu 1551 ikiwa una kesi maalum za ufisadi zinazohitaji hatua.
Dholuo: Chiw lipot kitiyo gi e-mail kata luong namba 1551 kapo ni in gi weche moko ma nyiso ni idwaro kawo okang'.

English: If you have any particular cases of corruption you need to report, please do so via email or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una visa vyovyote maalum vya ufisadi unavyohitaji kuripoti, tafadhali fanya hivyo kupitia barua pepe au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi wach moro ma chandi, inyalo ndiko wachno e adres kata inyalo ywayo tol e namba mar 1551.

English: Meru Huduma Centre launches Customer Service Week: Members of the public have been urged to seek various Government services.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Huduma cha Meru chazindua Wiki ya Huduma kwa Wateja: Umma umehimizwa kutafuta huduma mbalimbali za Serikali.
Dholuo: Kar chiwo chenro mag sirkal mar Huduma Center ma Meru chako Juma mar chiwo chenro ne jonyiewo: Oganda osejiw mondo omany tije mopogore opogore mag sirkal.

English: Need assistance with your taxes? Our services are also available at all Huduma Centres during the extended hours. Drop by at your convenience and let us help you stay compliant.
Kiswahili: Unahitaji usaidizi kuhusu kodi zako? Huduma zetu zinapatikana pia katika Vituo vyote vya Huduma wakati wa saa zilizoongezwa. Tembelea kwa urahisi wako na tukuruhusu kukusaidia kuendelea kufuata sheria.
Dholuo: Be dwaro kony gi pesa michulo mar osuru? chenrowa bende yudore e kuonde duto mag Huduma centers kuom seche mochwalore chop e saa mowinjore kendo wamiyi wach mowinjore.

English: The former senator has called upon the residents to vote for leaders from the sub-county, constituency, and county levels under the DCP party in the 2027 general elections.
Kiswahili: Seneta huyo wa zamani amewataka wakazi hao kuwapigia kura viongozi kutoka ngazi za kaunti ndogo, jimbo, na kaunti chini ya chama cha DCP katika uchaguzi mkuu wa 2027.
Dholuo: Seneta machon-no osenyiso jodak ni mondo giyier jotelo moa e pinje matindo, mag sirkal, koda mag gweng' e bwo DCP e yiero maduong' mar higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo gabiriyo.

English: EACC arrested a Kibabii University student and his accomplice for impersonating EACC officials and demanding bribes from NG-CDF project officers. The suspects, claiming to investigate projects, were caught after soliciting Ksh150,000. EACC urges victims to report incidents.
Kiswahili: EACC ilimkamata mwanafunzi wa Chuo Kikuu cha Kibabii na mwenzake kwa kujifanya maafisa wa EACC na kudai rushwa kutoka kwa maafisa wa mradi wa NG-CDF. Washukiwa hao, wakidai kuchunguza miradi, walikamatwa baada ya kuomba Ksh150,000. EACC inawasihi waathiriwa kuripoti matukio.
Dholuo: EACC ne omako japuonjre moro mar Yunivasiti mar Kibabi kod jal ma ne oriwore kode kuom oro jotelo mag EACC kendo kwayo asoya kuom jotelo mag NG-CDF. Achichgo ma wuondore ni nono chenro ne omak bang' choko siling alufu mia achiel kod prabich. EACC jiwo joma wachgo omako mondo ochiw lipot mag weche matimore:

English: GT News | EACC urges compliance with traffic laws to combat corruption on Kenyan roads. Motorists play a vital role. Let's prioritize road safety! Report corruption to Toll-Free No.1551.
Kiswahili: Habari za GT | EACC yahimiza kufuata sheria za trafiki ili kupambana na ufisadi barabarani Kenya. Madereva wana jukumu muhimu. Tuweke kipaumbele usalama barabarani! Ripoti ufisadi kwa Nambari ya Simu Isiyolipishwa 1551.
Dholuo: Lendo maduong' EACC jiwo ji mondo oluw chike mag ndara mondo giked gi mibadhi e nderni mag Kenya. Dereba nigi migawo maduong'. Weuru waket weche motudore gi ritruok e nderni obed motelo! Chiw lipot mar mibadhi e namba manono mar 1551.

English: EACC urges Kenyans to report all forms of corruption for investigation, saying they treat all reports with utmost confidentiality and subjects them to a meticulous analysis process.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi Wakenya kuripoti aina zote za ufisadi kwa ajili ya uchunguzi, ikisema wanashughulikia ripoti zote kwa usiri mkubwa na kuziweka chini ya mchakato wa uchambuzi wa kina.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo Jo-Kenya mondo ochiw ripot e wi kit mibadhi duto, ka giwacho ni gikano ripot duto e yo mopondo kendo gitimo nonro matut kuomgi.

English: REPORT CORRUPTION @EACCKenya urges Kenyans to report all forms of corruption for investigation. EACC treats all reports with the utmost confidentiality and subjects them to a meticulous analysis process. Below is the reporting process.
Kiswahili: RIPOTI RUSHWA @EACCKenya inawasihi Wakenya kuripoti aina zote za rushwa kwa ajili ya uchunguzi. EACC hushughulikia ripoti zote kwa usiri mkubwa na kuziweka chini ya mchakato wa uchambuzi wa kina. Hapa chini ni mchakato wa kuripoti.
Dholuo: Chiw lipot mar mibadhi @EACC kenya jiwo jopiny Kenya mondo onyis kit mibadhi duto e nonro. EACC rito ripode duto gi weche mopondo kendo timo nonro matut kuomgi. Chenro mar chwalo lipode ni piny.

English: Siaya County graft probe: Oguna urges EACC to probe misuse of funds in the county Oguna: we call on EACC to conclude Ksh. 600M theft probe
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Siaya: Oguna ahimiza EACC kuchunguza matumizi mabaya ya fedha katika kaunti ya Oguna: tunatoa wito kwa EACC kukamilisha uchunguzi wa wizi wa Ksh. 600M
Dholuo: Ng'ado mar Puonjruok e Weche lony manya mag Kaunti mar Siaya: Oguna jiwo EACC mondo ong'e kaka otiyo gi pesa e yo marach e Kaunti Oguna: Wakwayo EACC mondo otiek ng'ado mar siling milion mia auchiel.
