English: Once identified, they are fast-tracked through registration, referred to clinicians in private rooms, and supported with free services where possible.
Kiswahili: Mara tu wanapotambuliwa, huharakishwa kupitia usajili, hupelekwa kwa madaktari katika vyumba vya faragha, na kusaidiwa na huduma za bure inapowezekana.

English: "Gender based violence and femicide are a national problem which the government is committed to addressing through coordinated action.
Kiswahili: "Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na mauaji ya wanawake ni tatizo la kitaifa ambalo serikali imejitolea kulishughulikia kupitia hatua zilizoratibiwa."

English: The Cabinet Secretary and Principal Secretary have officially released the 2025 KCSE Results.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu na Katibu Mkuu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wametoa rasmi Matokeo ya KCSE ya 2025.

English: The transfer window for placement has been extended from two weeks to one month.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha uhamisho cha nafasi kimeongezwa kutoka wiki mbili hadi mwezi mmoja.

English: Taking photographs or recording videos inside the polling booth is strictly prohibited to preserve the secrecy and sanctity of the vote.
Kiswahili: Kupiga picha au kurekodi video ndani ya kibanda cha kupigia kura ni marufuku kabisa ili kuhifadhi usiri na utakatifu wa kura.

English: Capturing an image of a marked ballot for financial gain or to show allegiance is an election offence under Section 7(3)(e) of the Election Offences Act, No. 37 of 2016, punishable by a fine of up to KSh 1 million, imprisonment for up to 3 years, or both.
Kiswahili: Kupiga picha ya kura iliyotiwa alama kwa ajili ya faida ya kifedha au kuonyesha utii ni kosa la uchaguzi chini ya Kifungu cha 7(3)(e) cha Sheria ya Makosa ya Uchaguzi, Nambari 37 ya 2016, kinachoadhibiwa kwa faini ya hadi KSh milioni 1, kifungo cha hadi miaka 3, au vyote viwili.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 1: The voter enters the polling station with their ID or passport.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 1: Mpiga kura anaingia kituo cha kupigia kura akiwa na kitambulisho chake au pasipoti.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 2: The voter's information is verified using the KIEMS kit.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 2: Taarifa za mpiga kura zinathibitishwa kwa kutumia kifaa cha KIEMS.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 3: The voter is issued with one stamped ballot paper.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 3: Mpiga kura hupewa karatasi moja ya kupigia kura iliyotiwa muhuri.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 4: The voter marks the ballot paper secretly.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 4: Mpiga kura huweka alama kwenye karatasi ya kupigia kura kwa siri.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 5: The voter casts their ballot in the ballot box.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 5: Mpiga kura anapiga kura yake kwenye sanduku la kura.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 6: The voter's finger is marked with indelible ink.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 6: Kidole cha mpiga kura kimetiwa alama ya wino usiofutika.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 7: The voter leaves the polling station.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 7: Mpiga kura anaondoka kituoni.

English: The public is encouraged to promote peace before, during, and after elections.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kukuza amani kabla, wakati, na baada ya uchaguzi.

English: The public is encouraged to verify election-related information only through the Commission's official website or verified social media platforms, and to exercise caution about unverified claims.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kuthibitisha taarifa zinazohusiana na uchaguzi kupitia tovuti rasmi ya Tume au majukwaa ya mitandao ya kijamii yaliyothibitishwa pekee, na kuwa waangalifu kuhusu madai ambayo hayajathibitishwa.

English: The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) invited the public to submit memoranda on draft Election Campaign Financing Regulations and proposed contribution, spending, and expenditure limits ahead of the 2027 General Election, as required under Article 88(4)(i) of the Constitution and the Election Campaign Financing Act.
Kiswahili: Tume Huru ya Uchaguzi na Mipaka (IEBC) iliwaalika umma kuwasilisha memoranda kuhusu rasimu ya Kanuni za Ufadhili wa Kampeni za Uchaguzi na mapendekezo ya michango, matumizi, na mipaka ya matumizi kabla ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027, kama inavyohitajika chini ya Kifungu cha 88(4)(i) cha Katiba na Sheria ya Ufadhili wa Kampeni za Uchaguzi.

English: The election of the President of the Republic of Kenya for the next General Election is scheduled for Tuesday, 10th August 2027.
Kiswahili: Uchaguzi wa Rais wa Jamhuri ya Kenya kwa Uchaguzi Mkuu ujao umepangwa kufanyika Jumanne, tarehe 10 Agosti 2027.

English: Nomination of political party and independent candidates for the General Election takes place between Saturday, 29th May 2027 and Friday, 11th June 2027, with nomination papers delivered to the IEBC Chairperson during specified morning and afternoon hours.
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa wagombea wa vyama vya siasa na wagombea huru kwa Uchaguzi Mkuu utafanyika kati ya Jumamosi, tarehe 29 Mei 2027 na Ijumaa, tarehe 11 Juni 2027, huku karatasi za uteuzi zikiwasilishwa kwa Mwenyekiti wa IEBC wakati wa saa maalum za asubuhi na alasiri.

English: The campaign period for the 10th August 2027 General Election commences on Saturday, 29th May 2027 and ceases on Saturday, 8th August 2027, 48 hours before Election Day.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha kampeni cha Uchaguzi Mkuu wa tarehe 10 Agosti 2027 kinaanza Jumamosi, tarehe 29 Mei 2027 na kuisha Jumamosi, tarehe 8 Agosti 2027, saa 48 kabla ya Siku ya Uchaguzi.

English: The public is urged to disregard, dissociate from, and refrain from amplifying unverified claims by political actors alleging they will influence an election through extra-legal mechanisms, as such claims risk misleading the public and eroding confidence in the electoral system.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kupuuza, kujitenga na, na kujiepusha na kuongeza madai yasiyothibitishwa na watendaji wa kisiasa wakidai kwamba watashawishi uchaguzi kupitia mifumo isiyo ya kisheria, kwani madai kama hayo yanahatarisha kupotosha umma na kuharibu imani katika mfumo wa uchaguzi.

English: Voter education partnerships with grassroots groups such as small business and boda boda associations can help disseminate voter education, expand voter registration outreach, and promote peaceful participation in elections.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa elimu ya wapiga kura na makundi ya kijamii kama vile vyama vya biashara ndogo na bodaboda unaweza kusaidia kusambaza elimu ya wapiga kura, kupanua ufikiaji wa usajili wa wapiga kura, na kukuza ushiriki wa amani katika uchaguzi.

English: IEBC plans to expand diaspora voter registration beyond current embassy locations to 17 additional countries.
Kiswahili: IEBC inapanga kupanua usajili wa wapiga kura kutoka diaspora zaidi ya maeneo ya sasa ya ubalozi hadi nchi 17 zaidi.

English: Credible elections require coordinated action, strong voter education, and sustained public trust-building to counter digital threats such as misinformation, disinformation, and AI-driven manipulation.
Kiswahili: Uchaguzi wa kuaminika unahitaji hatua zilizoratibiwa, elimu thabiti ya wapiga kura, na ujenzi endelevu wa uaminifu wa umma ili kukabiliana na vitisho vya kidijitali kama vile taarifa potofu, taarifa potofu, na udanganyifu unaoendeshwa na akili bandia.

English: IEBC's reforms to promote equitable electoral participation include gender inclusion measures, disability accessibility improvements, and targeted strategies for special interest groups.
Kiswahili: Mageuzi ya IEBC ya kukuza ushiriki sawa katika uchaguzi yanajumuisha hatua za ujumuishaji wa kijinsia, maboresho ya ufikiaji wa ulemavu, na mikakati inayolenga makundi maalum.

English: Each political party or candidate is entitled to only one agent per polling station and one chief agent per tallying centre; there is no legal provision for "super agents" or other unauthorized persons in polling or tallying centres.
Kiswahili: Kila chama cha siasa au mgombea ana haki ya kuwa na wakala mmoja tu kwa kila kituo cha kupigia kura na wakala mkuu mmoja kwa kila kituo cha kupigia kura; hakuna kifungu cha kisheria kwa "maajenti wakuu" au watu wengine wasioidhinishwa katika vituo vya kupigia kura au kuhesabu kura.

English: Only voters, polling clerks, presiding officers, security personnel, accredited observers, accredited media, and party or candidate agents are authorized to be present at a polling station.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura, makarani wa kupigia kura, maafisa wasimamizi, wafanyakazi wa usalama, waangalizi walioidhinishwa, vyombo vya habari vilivyoidhinishwa, na mawakala wa chama au wagombea pekee ndio walioidhinishwa kuwepo katika kituo cha kupigia kura.

English: Polling stations open at 6:00 a.m. and close at 5:00 p.m.; any time lost during polling is recovered at closing, and voters already in the queue by closing time are allowed to vote.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupigia kura hufunguliwa saa 12:00 asubuhi na kufungwa saa 11:00 jioni; wakati wowote uliopotea wakati wa kupiga kura hurejeshwa wakati wa kufunga, na wapiga kura ambao tayari wako kwenye foleni wakati wa kufunga wanaruhusiwa kupiga kura.

English: At the tallying centre, Returning Officers receive results from all Presiding Officers, verify and collate them, and declare the winner in the presence of agents and accredited stakeholders.
Kiswahili: Katika kituo cha kuhesabu kura, Maafisa Wasimamizi hupokea matokeo kutoka kwa Maafisa Wakuu wote, huyathibitisha na kuyakusanya, na kutangaza mshindi mbele ya mawakala na wadau walioidhinishwa.

English: Voter registration does not take place in electoral areas with scheduled by-elections or pending election petitions.
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura haufanyiki katika maeneo ya uchaguzi yenye uchaguzi mdogo uliopangwa au maombi ya uchaguzi yanayosubiriwa.

English: Article 38 of the Constitution guarantees every citizen the right to join a political party, vote in free and fair elections, and vie for public office — rights given practical effect only through registration as a voter.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 38 cha Katiba kinamhakikishia kila raia haki ya kujiunga na chama cha siasa, kupiga kura katika uchaguzi huru na wa haki, na kugombea nafasi ya umma — haki zinazotolewa kwa vitendo kupitia usajili kama mpiga kura pekee.

English: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kuna uwezekano mkubwa kwamba magaidi watajaribu kufanya mashambulizi nchini Kenya.

English: Demonstration Alert: Kenya, Protests Resume on June 26
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Kenya, Maandamano Yaanza tena Juni 26

English: Demonstration Alert: Kenya, Violent Protests Nationwide June 25
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Kenya, Maandamano ya Vurugu Nchini Kote Juni 25

English: Demonstration Alert: Kenya, Protests Expected Nationwide on June 25
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Kenya, Maandamano Yanatarajiwa Kitaifa Kote mnamo Juni 25

English: Security Alert: Nairobi (Kenya), Violent Demonstrations in Central Business District
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Usalama: Nairobi (Kenya), Maandamano ya Vurugu Katika Wilaya ya Biashara ya Kati

English: Security Alert: Nairobi (Kenya), Armed Protesters Blocking the Northern Bypass
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Usalama: Nairobi (Kenya), Waandamanaji Wenye Silaha Wakizuia Njia ya Kaskazini

English: Security Alert: Kenya, Increase in al-Shabaab Activity Along Somali border and Coastal Areas
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Usalama: Kenya, Ongezeko la Shughuli za al-Shabaab Kwenye Mpaka wa Somalia na Maeneo ya Pwani

English: Travel Advisory: Kenya - Level 2 (Exercise Increased Caution)
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa Usafiri: Kenya - Kiwango cha 2 (Ongeza Tahadhari kwa Mazoezi)

English: Demonstration Alert: Kenya, January 6
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Kenya, Januari 6

English: Demonstration Alert: Potential Protests Across Kenya, December 30
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Maandamano Yanayowezekana Kote Kenya, Desemba 30

English: Alert: Reminder to Exercise Increased Caution in Kenya
Kiswahili: Tahadhari: Ukumbusho wa Kuwa na Tahadhari Zaidi nchini Kenya

English: Demonstration Alert: Multiple Cities in Kenya, (August 8)
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Miji Mingi nchini Kenya, (Agosti 8)

English: Demonstration Alert: Kenya
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano: Kenya

English: Demonstration Alert and Cancelation of Routine Consular Services: Nairobi (Kenya), July 2
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Maandamano na Kufutwa kwa Huduma za Kawaida za Ubalozi: Nairobi (Kenya), Julai 2

English: Move to safer grounds if you notice rising water
Kiswahili: Nenda kwenye maeneo salama zaidi ukiona maji yakipanda

English: Weather forecast indicate that you may experience heavy rains in your area.
Kiswahili: Utabiri wa hali ya hewa unaonyesha kuwa unaweza kupata mvua kubwa katika eneo lako.

English: Farmers are being informed that Bt maize resistant to stem borers and fall armyworm has been approved for planting to help boost yields and cut pesticide costs.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaarifiwa kwamba mahindi ya Bt yanayostahimili vipekecha shina na viwavijeshi vya kuanguka yameidhinishwa kwa ajili ya kupanda ili kusaidia kuongeza mavuno na kupunguza gharama za dawa za kuulia wadudu.

English: Avocado growers are reminded that harvesting immature fruit is prohibited, and violators risk losing their export licences under tightened quality controls.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa parachichi wanakumbushwa kwamba kuvuna matunda yasiyoiva ni marufuku, na wanaokiuka sheria wana hatari ya kupoteza leseni zao za kuuza nje chini ya udhibiti mkali wa ubora.

English: Wajir County has launched a 10-day vaccination campaign targeting 250,000 animals against Foot and Mouth Disease, Peste des Petits Ruminants, and Contagious Caprine Pleuropneumonia.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir imezindua kampeni ya chanjo ya siku 10 inayolenga wanyama 250,000 dhidi ya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo, Wanyama wa Kulungu wa Peste des Petits, na Caprine Pleuropneumonia ya Kuambukiza.

English: Under the e-voucher livestock vaccination programme, cattle owners can access the FMD vaccine for a subsidised fee of Sh50 per animal, while the PPR vaccine for sheep and goats costs Sh3 per animal.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango wa chanjo ya mifugo kwa vocha ya kielektroniki, wamiliki wa ng'ombe wanaweza kupata chanjo ya FMD kwa ada ya ruzuku ya Sh50 kwa kila mnyama, huku chanjo ya PPR kwa kondoo na mbuzi ikigharimu Sh3 kwa kila mnyama.

English: The national government is rolling out an immunisation campaign targeting 22 million cattle against Foot and Mouth Disease and 50 million sheep and goats against Peste des Petits Ruminants nationwide.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kitaifa inaanzisha kampeni ya chanjo inayolenga ng'ombe milioni 22 dhidi ya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo na kondoo na mbuzi milioni 50 dhidi ya Wanyama wa Kulungu wa Peste des Petits kote nchini.

English: The National Drought Management Authority has flagged suspected Foot and Mouth Disease cases in Baringo, Laikipia, Makueni, Meru, Narok, Wajir and West Pokot counties, urging farmers to cooperate with ongoing vaccination drives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame imeripoti visa vinavyoshukiwa vya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo katika kaunti za Baringo, Laikipia, Makueni, Meru, Narok, Wajir na Pokot Magharibi, ikiwahimiza wakulima kushirikiana na kampeni zinazoendelea za chanjo.

English: Pastoralist communities are being urged to move herds toward areas with better pasture and water access as several ASAL counties remain in the drought alert and alarm phases.
Kiswahili: Jamii za wafugaji zinahimizwa kuhamisha mifugo kuelekea maeneo yenye malisho bora na upatikanaji wa maji kwani kaunti kadhaa za ASAL zinabaki katika awamu za tahadhari ya ukame na tahadhari.

English: A cross-border vaccination exercise between Kenya and Ethiopia aims to reach 2.7 million livestock by the end of August 2026 to control transboundary animal diseases in shared grazing areas.
Kiswahili: Zoezi la chanjo ya mpakani kati ya Kenya na Ethiopia linalenga kufikia mifugo milioni 2.7 ifikapo mwisho wa Agosti 2026 ili kudhibiti magonjwa ya wanyama yanayovuka mipaka katika maeneo ya malisho ya pamoja.

English: Coffee cooperatives exporting to the European Union are reminded that new deforestation due-diligence rules require GPS mapping of farm plots before shipment.
Kiswahili: Vyama vya ushirika vya kahawa vinavyosafirisha nje kwenda Umoja wa Ulaya vinakumbushwa kwamba sheria mpya za utunzaji wa ukataji miti zinahitaji ramani ya GPS ya viwanja vya shamba kabla ya kusafirishwa.

English: Farmers are notified that over 20 Kenyan agricultural products, including avocado, macadamia, coffee and tea, now qualify for duty-free access to Chinese markets starting May 2026.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaarifiwa kwamba zaidi ya bidhaa 20 za kilimo za Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na parachichi, makadamia, kahawa na chai, sasa zinastahili kupata huduma bila ushuru katika masoko ya China kuanzia Mei 2026.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a 'Sustainable Avocado' initiative encouraging farmers to adopt drip irrigation and rainwater harvesting to reduce the crop's environmental footprint.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo imezindua mpango wa 'Parachichi Endelevu' unaowahimiza wakulima kutumia umwagiliaji wa matone na uvunaji wa maji ya mvua ili kupunguza athari za kimazingira kwa zao hilo.

English: KALRO re ers are urging wider adoption of drought-tolerant crop varieties and improved soil and water conservation methods to help farmers cope with increasingly frequent droughts and floods.
Kiswahili: Watafiti wa KALRO wanahimiza kupitishwa kwa aina mbalimbali za mazao yanayostahimili ukame na mbinu bora za kuhifadhi udongo na maji ili kuwasaidia wakulima kukabiliana na ukame na mafuriko yanayoongezeka mara kwa mara.

English: Farmer advocacy groups warn that relying on a single high-value crop such as avocado can be risky, and encourage maintaining diverse cropping systems for resilience.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya utetezi wa wakulima vinaonya kwamba kutegemea zao moja la thamani kubwa kama vile parachichi kunaweza kuwa hatari, na kuhimiza kudumisha mifumo mbalimbali ya upandaji miti kwa ajili ya ustahimilivu.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Observatory Platform now delivers ward-level weather forecasts and agro-advisories to farmers, reaching around 250,000 farmers a month across five counties.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Observatory ya Kilimo la Kenya sasa hutoa utabiri wa hali ya hewa katika ngazi ya kata na ushauri wa kilimo kwa wakulima, na kuwafikia wakulima wapatao 250,000 kwa mwezi katika kaunti tano.

English: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries advises farmers in Marsabit County to plant drought-tolerant bananas varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupanda aina za ndizi zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: County Government Extension Services advises farmers in West Pokot County to plant drought-tolerant sunflower varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Huduma za Ugani za Serikali ya Kaunti zinawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kupanda aina za alizeti zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds onions farmers in Kericho County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa vitunguu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: National Drought Management Authority reminds sunflower farmers in Nyeri County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame inawakumbusha wakulima wa alizeti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Farmers in West Pokot County are urged to scout their sorghum fields weekly for signs of fruit flies infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya mtama kila wiki ili kuona dalili za kushambuliwa na nzi wa matunda.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds millet farmers in Trans Nzoia County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Directorate of Veterinary Services advises farmers in Narok County to plant drought-tolerant rice varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Huduma za Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kupanda aina za mpunga zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: State Department for Cooperatives advises farmers in Nakuru County to plant drought-tolerant tea varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupanda aina za chai zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: FAO Kenya reminds cassava farmers in Kajiado County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Agricultural Sector Transformation Programme advises farmers in Garissa County to plant drought-tolerant wheat varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Mabadiliko ya Sekta ya Kilimo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupanda aina za ngano zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Farmers in Wajir County are urged to scout their rice fields weekly for signs of aflatoxin-producing fungi infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya mpunga kila wiki ili kuona dalili za uvamizi wa fangasi unaosababisha sumu ya aflatoxin.

English: National Cereals and Produce Board reminds beans farmers in Samburu County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao inawakumbusha wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: State Department for Cooperatives warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kajiado County against harvesting immature produce, which affects both quality and market access.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado dhidi ya kuvuna mazao yasiyoiva, ambayo huathiri ubora na upatikanaji wa soko.

English: State Department for Cooperatives advises farmers in Isiolo County to plant drought-tolerant tea varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupanda aina za chai zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds avocado farmers in Homa Bay County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: State Department for Cooperatives warns coffee farmers in Wajir County against harvesting immature produce, which affects both quality and market access.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya kuvuna mazao yasiyoiva, ambayo huathiri ubora na upatikanaji wa soko.

English: Farmers in Kiambu County are urged to scout their kale (sukuma wiki) fields weekly for signs of fruit flies infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya kale (sukuma wiki) kila wiki kwa dalili za uvamizi wa nzi wa matunda.

English: KALRO reminds sweet potatoes farmers in Embu County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Embu kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Kenya Meteorological Department reminds groundnuts farmers in Tharaka Nithi County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima wa karanga katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds maize farmers in Bungoma County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Taita Taveta County to plant drought-tolerant cassava varieties ahead of the coming rains.

English: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa
Dholuo: Sirkal chako pogo net mag kwiri. Sirkal dwaro ni opog ne ji net milion 15.3 mosetigo

English: Health officials deploy drones to combat malaria in Busia County
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya watuma ndege zisizo na rubani kupambana na malaria katika Kaunti ya Busia
Dholuo: Jotelo mag thieth tiyo gi drones e kedo gi malaria e Kaunti mar Busia

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.
Dholuo: Kenya en achiel kuom pinje 12 mag Afrika ma biro yudo doje milion 18 mag yadh malaria e higa mar 2025, WHO wacho ni ibiro keto mokwongo pinje ma dwaro yadhno ahinya.

English: The Ministry of Health aims to scale the uptake of the malaria vaccine among children aged between 6 months to 14 years.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inalenga kuongeza idadi ya watoto wanaotumia chanjo ya malaria miongoni mwa watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 6 hadi miaka 14.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth dwaro ni mondo ji omed yudo chanjo mar malaria e kind nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind dweche 6 nyaka 14.

English: MoH dispatches 10 Cuban experts to Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay and Migori counties in the fight against malaria with biological methods.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatuma wataalamu 10 wa Cuba katika kaunti za Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay na Migori katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria kwa njia za kibiolojia.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Thieth oro josomo 10 mag Cuba e gwenge mag Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay kod Migori e kedo gi malaria ka gitiyo gi yore mag thieth.

English: When we open up and talk about what is affecting our mental health, those issues become bearable. They become less distressing, less overwhelming and less worrying. Reach out to us on 1199 and we will be there for you.
Kiswahili: Tunapofungua na kuzungumzia kinachoathiri afya yetu ya akili, masuala hayo yanakuwa rahisi kuyavumilia. Yanakuwa hayana usumbufu mwingi, hayalemei sana na hayana wasiwasi mwingi. Wasiliana nasi kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.
Dholuo: Sama wawuoyo ayanga kuom gima chando pachwa, wanyalo nyagore gi chandruogego e yo maber. Chandruogego bedo matin, ok gibed madongo ahinya, kendo ok gibed gi parruok mang'eny. Tudri kodwa e 1199 mondo wayud konyruok.

English: Connect with others and be part of positive relationships.Building positive associations with people is good for your mental well-being
Kiswahili: Ungana na wengine na uwe sehemu ya mahusiano chanya. Kujenga mahusiano chanya na watu ni jambo zuri kwa ustawi wako wa akili.
Dholuo: Bed gi winjruok maber gi jomoko. Bedo gi osiepe mabeyo nyalo konyi mondo ibed gi paro mowinjore

English: Its not unmanly to struggle.Check on the men in your life.
Kiswahili: Si jambo la kiume kujitahidi. Waangalie wanaume katika maisha yako.
Dholuo: Ok en gima nyiso achaya ka ng'ato kedo. Non ane chwo ma in - go.

English: Indicators of stress:easily irritable,anxious,panic attacks,sleeping problems,social withdrawal,irritability
Kiswahili: Viashiria vya msongo wa mawazo: kukasirika kwa urahisi, wasiwasi, mashambulizi ya hofu, matatizo ya usingizi, kujitenga na watu, kuwashwa
Dholuo: Gik manyiso ni ng'ato nigi parruok: ich wang' mayot, parruok, luoro, chandruok e nindo, bedo kar kende, bedo gi mirima

English: Techniques like deep breathing,walking or time outdoors are universal tools for managing daily stressors.
Kiswahili: Mbinu kama vile kupumua kwa kina, kutembea au kutumia muda nje ni zana zinazotumika kwa wote katika kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo wa kila siku.
Dholuo: Yore kaka yueyo matut, wuotho, kata bedo oko, gin yore ma ji duto tiyogo e loyo parruok ma pile.

English: Mental health conditions like depression can lead to physical symptoms such as fatigue and illness, highlighting the strong mind-body connection
Kiswahili: Hali za afya ya akili kama vile mfadhaiko zinaweza kusababisha dalili za kimwili kama vile uchovu na ugonjwa, na hivyo kuonyesha uhusiano mkubwa kati ya akili na mwili.
Dholuo: Tuwo mag paro kaka parruok nyalo kelo tuoche mag del kaka olo kod tuoche, ka mano nyiso tudruok motegno mantie e kind paro kod del

English: This World Mental Health Day, lets prioritize mental well-being at work! A supportive environment is key to a healthy workplace. Check in on your colleagues today!
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Afya ya Akili Duniani, hebu tuweke kipaumbele ustawi wa akili kazini! Mazingira yanayounga mkono ni muhimu kwa afya mahali pa kazi. Wasiliana na wenzako leo!
Dholuo: E Odiechieng' mar Paro e Piny Mangima, weuru waket paro mar bedo gi ngima maber mar paro e kar tich obed motelo! Bedo gi alwora maber mar tich en gima dwarore ahinya mondo omi ji obed gi ngima maber kar tich. Tim nonro kuom jotich weteni kawuono!

English: Mental well-being is essential for a productive and healthy workplace. Prioritize mental health just as you would physical health.
Kiswahili: Ustawi wa akili ni muhimu kwa mahali pa kazi penye tija na afya. Panga afya ya akili kama vile unavyoweza kuipa kipaumbele afya ya mwili.
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro maber en gima dwarore ahinya mondo ng'ato obed gi ngima maber e kar tich. Par ni bedo gi paro mowinjore en gima duong' ahinya mana kaka rito dendi.

English: Talking about mental health breaks the stigma and helps others open up. Lets create a supportive environment for all.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumzia afya ya akili huvunja unyanyapaa na kuwasaidia wengine kufunguka. Tujenge mazingira ya usaidizi kwa wote.
Dholuo: Wuoyo e wi tuoche mag paro ketho wichkuot kendo konyo jomoko mondo owach gima nie chunygi. Weuru mondo walos kamoro maber ma ji duto nyalo dakie.

English: Government distributes mosquito nets in malaria fight. Kilifi County is one of the beneficiaries. Nets program was flagged over procurement irregularities. MOH wants to distribute 15M nets in 22 counties
Kiswahili: Serikali yasambaza vyandarua katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria. Kaunti ya Kilifi ni mojawapo ya wanufaika. Programu ya vyandarua iliangaziwa kwa ukiukwaji wa sheria za ununuzi. Wizara ya Afya inataka kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15 katika kaunti 22
Dholuo: Sirkal pogo net mag kwiri e kedo gi malaria. Kaunti mar Kilifi en achiel kuom joma yudo kony. Chenro mar Nets ne oket e bwo chik nikech gik ma ok kare ma ne timore e chenro mag ng'iewo. MOH dwaro pogo net 15M e counties 22

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.
Dholuo: Kenya nyiso ni nitie ji 12 kendo ma nigi COVID-19 mamiyo kwan duto mar jogo omedore nyaka 246. Jatend migao mar thieth miluongo ni Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni abich kuomgi gin jotich ma otel.

English: Over the last 24 hours we have tested over 300 Kenyans, out of those 22 have tested positive for covid-19 (13-males, 9-females). 21 out of the 22 cases are people who are currently in quarantine
Kiswahili: Katika saa 24 zilizopita tumewapima Wakenya zaidi ya 300, kati ya hao 22 wamepimwa na kukutwa na virusi vya covid-19 (wanaume 13, wanawake 9). Visa 21 kati ya 22 ni watu ambao kwa sasa wako karantini.
Dholuo: Kuom seche 24 mosekalo, wasenono jo Kenya mokalo 300, kuom jogo 22 oseyudo ni nigi tuo mar covid-19 (13- chwo, 9 mon). 21 kuom ji 22 ma nigi tuono gin joma sani ni e kar kendgi.

English: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kidini chini ya Baraza la Makanisa Duniani wanahimiza serikali na nchi wafadhili kuongeza usaidizi wa Mfuko wa Dunia, ili kusaidia majibu endelevu kwa VVU, kifua kikuu, na malaria.
Dholuo: Jotend din manie bwo riwruok mar World Council of Churches jiwo sirkande koda pinje machiwo kony mondo omed kony ma riwruok mar Global Fund chiwo, mondo okony e kedo gi AYAKI, kahera, kod malaria.

English: There is no local transmission of malaria in Nairobi. If you have been a full time resident of Nairobi and you get sick with fever the probability that it is malaria is close to zero.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maambukizi ya malaria jijini Nairobi. Kama umekuwa mkazi wa Nairobi kwa muda wote na unaugua homa, uwezekano kwamba ni malaria ni karibu sifuri.
Dholuo: Onge tuo mar malaria ma landore e Nairobi. Kapo ni isebedo ka idak Nairobi kuom kinde malach to tuwo mar malaria omaki, nyalo bedo ni en malaria.

English: Rising temperatures elevate the risk to Nairobi's malaria-free status
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa joto huongeza hatari ya kutokuwepo kwa malaria jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Medruok mar liet miyo Nairobi bedo kama tuwo mar malaria ok yudie

English: Mission for Essential Drugs and Supplies suspends orders for USAID-funded essential drugs, move likely to affect the distribution of HIV and malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Shirika la Misheni ya Dawa na Ugavi Muhimu lasimamisha oda za dawa muhimu zinazofadhiliwa na USAID, hatua ambayo inaweza kuathiri usambazaji wa dawa za VVU na malaria
Dholuo: Migawo mar Yath kod Gik Madwarore e Piny Oweyo oko kwayo mag yadh madwarore ma USAID ema chiwo, okang' manyalo kelo pek e pogo yadh AYAKI kod malaria

English: Devastating flooding in South Sudan is affecting around 1.4 million people, with more than 379,000 displaced, according to a United Nations update that warned about an upsurge in malaria.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko makubwa nchini Sudan Kusini yanaathiri takriban watu milioni 1.4, huku zaidi ya watu 379,000 wakimbizi, kulingana na taarifa mpya ya Umoja wa Mataifa iliyoonya kuhusu ongezeko la malaria.
Dholuo: Ataro mar pi e piny South Sudan, osemiyo ji madirom milion 1.4 oyudo masira, kendo ji mokalo 379,000 oseweyo miechgi, kaluwore gi nonro manyien mar Riwruok mar Pinje ma ne ochiwo siem ni malaria biro medore.

English: The Ministry of Health has reassured the public that there will be no shortage of essential drugs, including those for malaria, HIV/AIDS and TB for at least the next one year.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hakutakuwa na uhaba wa dawa muhimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na zile za malaria, VVU/UKIMWI na Kifua Kikuu kwa angalau mwaka mmoja ujao.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osenyiso ji ni ok bi bedo gi nok mar yedhe madwarore ahinya, moriwo koda mago mag malaria, HIV/AIDS, kod TB, kuom higini madirom achiel mabiro.

English: To lower cases of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, and enhance the vaccines and immunisation programme in the country, I have proposed Sh28.7bn for the Global Fund and Sh4.6bn for vaccines and immunisation programmes.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza visa vya VVU/UKIMWI, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria, na kuboresha mpango wa chanjo na chanjo nchini, nimependekeza Sh28.7 bilioni kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Dunia na Sh4.6 bilioni kwa ajili ya chanjo na programu za chanjo.
Dholuo: Mondo odwok piny tuoche mag AYAKI/AIDS, Tuberculosis kod malaria, kendo medo chenro mag chanjo kod thieth e piny, asechiwo Sh28.7 billion ne Global Fund kod Sh4.6 billion ne chanjo kod chenro mag thieth.

English: You are six times more likely to get malaria if you visit Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet and Nandi counties, according to the latest data from the Ministry of Health.
Kiswahili: Una uwezekano mara sita zaidi wa kupata malaria ukitembelea kaunti za Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet na Nandi, kulingana na data ya hivi karibuni kutoka Wizara ya Afya.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi weche ma nyocha owuok e Migawo mar Weche Thieth, inyalo yudo malaria nyadi auchiel ka idhi e gwenge mag Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet kod Nandi.

English: Malaria's gendered burden: Recent floods heighten risk for women, girls
Kiswahili: Mzigo wa Malaria kwa jinsia: Mafuriko ya hivi karibuni yaongeza hatari kwa wanawake na wasichana
Dholuo: Pek mar malaria kaluwore gi chwo gi mon: Ataro ma nyocha otimore medo hinyruok ne mon kod nyiri

English: Communities in Baringo fight back against malaria with local solutions and mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Jamii huko Baringo zinapambana na malaria kwa kutumia suluhisho za kienyeji na vyandarua
Dholuo: Joma odak e gwenge mag Baringo kedo gi malaria ka gitiyo gi yore mag geng'o kute mag ayaki

English: A malaria vaccine tested in Kenya gains WHO prequalification, costing as low as Sh300, becoming the world's second vaccine on the global prequalified list.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa nchini Kenya yapata sifa ya awali ya WHO, ikigharimu hadi Sh300, na kuwa chanjo ya pili duniani kwenye orodha ya chanjo zilizoidhinishwa awali duniani.
Dholuo: Yath mar malaria ma ne otem e piny Kenya ne oyudo mar WHO, ma nengone ne ni piny mar Sh300, kendo mano ne omiyo obedo yath mar ariyo e piny mangima e list mar yadhno ma ne otem.

English: Global Fund, through the Kenya Medical Supplies Agency, is distributing mosquito nets in malaria-endemic regions across the country
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kimataifa, kupitia Shirika la Ugavi wa Dawa la Kenya, unasambaza vyandarua vya mbu katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na malaria kote nchini.
Dholuo: Global Fund, kokalo kuom Kenya Medical Supplies Agency, pogo net mag geng'o kute e gwenge ma malaria opong'o e pinyno

English: 10.9m treated mosquito nets to be distributed across 22 counties in fight against Malaria
Kiswahili: Vyandarua milioni 10.9 vilivyotibiwa vitasambazwa katika kaunti 22 ili kupambana na Malaria
Dholuo: Net mag kweth mag kute ma osetigo ma romo milion 10.9 ibiro pog e gwenge 22 e kedo gi malaria

English: Kenya signs six Global Fund grants amounting to Sh59.7 billion to support HIV, TB and malaria interventions; funding to strengthen health and community systems over three years.
Kiswahili: Kenya yasaini ruzuku sita za Mfuko wa Kimataifa zenye thamani ya Sh59.7 bilioni kusaidia uingiliaji kati wa VVU, Kifua Kikuu na malaria; ufadhili wa kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na jamii kwa miaka mitatu.
Dholuo: Kenya oketo sei e chiwo mar pesa mar Global Fund maromo Sh59.7 billion mar siro yore mag thieth mag HIV, TB kod malaria; chiwo pesa mar tego yore mag thieth kod mag oganda kuom higni adek.

English: World Malaria Day: Kenya Joins the World in Commemorating Malaria Day.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Malaria Duniani: Kenya Yaungana na Dunia Kuadhimisha Siku ya Malaria.
Dholuo: Odiechieng Maleria e Piny: Kenya Riwore gi Piny e Paro Odiechieng Maleria.

English: There is a silver lining in the fight against malaria after Kenya was listed alongside 12 other African countries set to receive 18 million doses of the first-ever malaria vaccine in the next two years
Kiswahili: Kuna mwelekeo mzuri katika vita dhidi ya malaria baada ya Kenya kuorodheshwa pamoja na nchi zingine 12 za Afrika zinazotarajiwa kupokea dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya kwanza kabisa ya malaria katika miaka miwili ijayo.
Dholuo: Nitie wach maber e kedo gi malaria bang' Kenya bedo achiel kuom pinje 12 mag Afrika ma biro yudo doje milion 18 mag yadh malaria mokwongo e higini ariyo mabiro.

English: Counties in the northern part of Kenya are recording a high prevalence of malaria, a trend that is worrying scientists, especially with the invasion of a new species of mosquito in the country.
Kiswahili: Kaunti katika sehemu ya kaskazini mwa Kenya zinarekodi kiwango kikubwa cha malaria, hali ambayo inawatia wasiwasi wanasayansi, hasa kutokana na uvamizi wa aina mpya ya mbu nchini.
Dholuo: E gwenge moko man yo nyandwat mar Kenya, kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore ahinya, to mano en gima miyo josayans bedo gi parruok ahinya, to moloyo nikech kweth moro manyien mar kute osechopo e pinyno.

English: The Ministry of Health is planning to conduct a massive malaria vaccination drive after the WHO warned of a surge in mosquito-borne diseases due to global warming
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inapanga kufanya kampeni kubwa ya chanjo ya malaria baada ya WHO kuonya kuhusu ongezeko la magonjwa yanayoenezwa na mbu kutokana na ongezeko la joto duniani.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth chano mar timo kampen maduong ' mar chanjo malaria bang ' ka riwruok mar WHO nosiemo ni tuoche mikelo gi kute biro medore nikech liet mar piny.

English: Fight against malaria faces fresh threat from new deadly mosquito species
Kiswahili: Mapambano dhidi ya malaria yanakabiliwa na tishio jipya kutoka kwa aina mpya za mbu hatari
Dholuo: E kedo gi malaria, nitie kit kute moko manyien makelo hinyruok

English: The Kenya Medical Re Institute (Kemri) has dispatched a team of experts to Marsabit to collect samples for tests after nine people died.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya (Kemri) imetuma timu ya wataalamu kwenda Marsabit kukusanya sampuli kwa ajili ya vipimo baada ya watu tisa kufariki.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Re Institute (Kemri) oseoro jotim nonro e Marsabit mondo ochok ranyisi mag tuoche mondo onon bang' ka ji ochiko osetho.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.
Dholuo: Kenya nyiso medruok mar joma nigi tuwo mar Mpox, ma sani gin 137 ka kaunti mag Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru ema nigi kwan mamalo moloyo mar joma nigi tuono.

English: WHO extends Mpox alert, says virus remains public health emergency of international concern, 37,000 cases recorded with 125 deaths since 2024.
Kiswahili: WHO yaongeza tahadhari ya Mpox, yasema virusi hivyo vinasalia kuwa dharura ya afya ya umma inayotia wasiwasi kimataifa, visa 37,000 vimerekodiwa na vifo 125 tangu 2024.
Dholuo: WHO medo kwan mar Mpox alert, owacho ni tuono pod en masira mar thieth mar oganda ma kelo parruok e piny mangima, jii 37,000 ma nigi tuono osendik kod ji 125 ma osetho chakre 2024.

English: Every day, we are vulnerable to a new outbreak, disease, pandemic or virus. Recent ones include the Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika and the nightmarish experience we faced during the Covid-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, tuko katika hatari ya kupata mlipuko mpya, ugonjwa, janga au virusi. Vipya ni pamoja na virusi vya Marburg, Mpox, Ebola, Zika na tukio baya tulilokabiliana nalo wakati wa janga la Covid-19.
Dholuo: Odiechieng' kodiechieng', waromo gi tuoche, tuoche ma landore, kata kute mag ayaki. Moko kuom gik ma nyocha otimore oriwo Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika kod masira malich ma ne wayudo e kinde mar Covid-19.

English: Kenya confirms two new Mpox cases in Kericho and Taita Taveta counties, raising total to 33; Health Ministry urges schools to enhance safety measures to curb spread.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox katika kaunti za Kericho na Taita Taveta, na kuongeza jumla ya visa hivyo kufikia 33; Wizara ya Afya yahimiza shule kuimarisha hatua za usalama ili kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi hivyo.
Dholuo: Kenya nyiso ni nitie ji ariyo manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e gwenge mag Kericho kod Taita Taveta, ka mano miyo kwan mar jogo duto omedore nyaka 33; Migawo mar Thieth jiwo skunde mondo omed tiyo gi yore mag ritruok mondo ogeng' landruokno.

English: A healthy mind drives workplace success. Prioritizing mental health boosts morale, reduces stress, and improves productivity
Kiswahili: Akili yenye afya huchochea mafanikio mahali pa kazi. Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili huongeza ari, hupunguza msongo wa mawazo, na huboresha tija
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro makare miyo ng'ato dhi maber e tich. Keto paro mag tuoche mag paro obed motelo miyo ng'ato bedo gi chuny mokuwe, parruok bedo matin, kendo tich bedo maber

English: Taking care of your mental health is as important as your physical health. A healthy mind leads to a happier, healthier life.
Kiswahili: Kutunza afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama vile afya yako ya kimwili. Akili yenye afya inaongoza kwenye maisha yenye furaha na afya njema.
Dholuo: Rito pachi en gima dwarore ahinya mana kaka rito dendi. Paro makare miyo ng'ato bedo gi ngima maber.

English: What do you do to prioritize mental health? Talking about it is a great first step.
Kiswahili: Unafanya nini ili kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili? Kuzungumzia kuhusu hilo ni hatua nzuri ya kwanza.
Dholuo: Ang'o minyalo timo mondo omi ibed gi paro mowinjore kuom tuoche mag paro? Wuoyo kuom wechego e okang' mokwongo en gima ber.

English: All public gatherings meetings, games, events, church crusades have been suspended. Churches can have services as long as they have sanitizer. Schools to remain open but inter school games are cancelled
Kiswahili: Mikutano yote ya hadhara, michezo, matukio, mikutano ya kanisa imesimamishwa. Makanisa yanaweza kuwa na ibada mradi tu yana vitakasa mikono. Shule zitaendelea kufunguliwa lakini michezo kati ya shule imefutwa
Dholuo: Chokruoge mag ji duto, tuke, gik matimore, koda wuodh kanisa, osegol oko. Kanise nyalo bedo gi chokruok mag lamo, to mana ka gin gi sanitizer. Skunde dhi siko ka oyawore to tuke mag skul ok dhi dhi nyime

English: Educate yourself on mental health issues, so that you can be an ambassador of change, speaking against mental health stigma. Stigma & discrimination are major barriers to accessing mental health services. Choose to live an empowered life, fight the stigma.
Kiswahili: Jielimishe kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili, ili uweze kuwa balozi wa mabadiliko, ukipinga unyanyapaa wa afya ya akili. Unyanyapaa na ubaguzi ni vikwazo vikubwa vya kupata huduma za afya ya akili. Chagua kuishi maisha yenye uwezo, pambana na unyanyapaa.
Dholuo: Puonjri weche mag tuoche mag paro, mondo ibed jaland lokruok, kiwuoyo e wi tuoche mag paro. Buono ji kod achaya gin gik madongo ma geng'o ji yudo kony mag thieth mar paro. Yier dak e ngima ma nigi teko, kedo gi wich kuot.

English: Take a journal and note down how your days are and how you're feeling. Examine your thoughts written over time and soon they become clearer and hidden thoughts and feelings come to the surface to bring a more complete light to the situation.
Kiswahili: Chukua shajara na uandike jinsi siku zako zilivyo na jinsi unavyohisi. Chunguza mawazo yako yaliyoandikwa baada ya muda na hivi karibuni yanakuwa wazi zaidi na mawazo na hisia zilizofichwa huja juu ili kuleta mwanga kamili zaidi kwa hali hiyo.
Dholuo: Bed gi buk moro ma isomo gik ma timore e ngimani kod kaka iwinjo. Non ane paro ma in-go bang' kinde, kendo mapiyo nono gibiro nenore maler, kendo paro kod paro mopondo biro nenore, mondo okonyi ng'eyo weche e yo maber moloyo.

English: There is no health without mental health
Kiswahili: Hakuna afya bila afya ya akili
Dholuo: Ngima ok nyal bedo maber ka onge tuoche mag paro

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If youre really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Vuta pumzi ndefu na upumzike. Sikiliza mwili wako. Ikiwa umechoka sana, jipe ​​muda wa kulala. Bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili huharibika na umakini wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.
Dholuo: Kaw muya matin kae to ibed mokuwe. Chik iti ne gima iwacho. Kapo ni in gi chuny monyosore gadier, kaw thuolo mondo inind matin. Ka ok wanindo moromo, pachwa ok ti maber, kendo ok wanyal keto pachwa e gima watimo. Seche moko piny nyalo rito.

English: Responding to mental health issues for people with disabilities is critical.Do you know someone who would need someone to talk to?SMS support to 20767 to get access to a counsellor.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili kwa watu wenye ulemavu ni muhimu. Je, unamjua mtu ambaye atahitaji mtu wa kuzungumza naye? Tuma ujumbe mfupi wa usaidizi kwa 20767 ili kupata mshauri nasaha.
Dholuo: Dwoko kuom weche mag tuoche mag paro ne joma nigi midekre en gima dwarore ahinya. Be ing'eyo ng'at manyalo dwaro ng'at ma ginyalo wuoyogo? Or ne joma konyo kitiyo gi SMS e namba 20767 mondo iyud kony mar laktar.

English: Healthy minds create healthy workplaces. Lets foster environments that prioritize mental health and support employees well-being
Kiswahili: Akili zenye afya huunda sehemu za kazi zenye afya. Tukuze mazingira yanayopa kipaumbele afya ya akili na kusaidia ustawi wa wafanyakazi.
Dholuo: Paro makare miyo ji bedo gi ngima maber kuonde ma gitiyoe. Weuru mondo warit kuonde ma miyo ji paro mar rito ngimagi obed maber, kendo konyo jotich mondo obed gi ngima maber.

English: Alcohol addiction is a severe issue affecting many Kenyans, and the prevalence of illicit brews in the Mt. Kenya region exacerbates this problem. Local health facilities need to be well-equipped to handle mental health issues, which can drive people into alcohol addiction
Kiswahili: Uraibu wa pombe ni tatizo kubwa linalowaathiri Wakenya wengi, na kuenea kwa pombe haramu katika eneo la Mlima Kenya kunazidisha tatizo hili. Vituo vya afya vya eneo hilo vinahitaji kuwa na vifaa vya kutosha kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili, ambayo yanaweza kuwasukuma watu katika uraibu wa pombe.
Dholuo: Madho kong'o ahinya en gima chando Jo Kenya mang'eny, kendo madho kong'o e yo ma ok owinjore e gweng' mar Mt. Alwora mar Kenya medo mana bedo marach moloyo. Chenro mag thieth madwarore ni otim kuonde ma ji nyalo yudoe ritruok kuom tuoche mag paro, manyalo miyo ji obed wasumb kong'o

English: Women face unique challenges in addiction treatment such as trauma, mental health, stigma & caregiving roles. Gender responsive care are is not optional, it is essential
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kipekee katika matibabu ya uraibu kama vile majeraha, afya ya akili, unyanyapaa na majukumu ya ulezi. Huduma inayozingatia jinsia si ya hiari, ni muhimu
Dholuo: Mon romo gi pek moko makende e thieth mag yedhe mamero kaka tuoche mag adundo, tuoche mag paro, wichkuot kod ting' mar rito nyithindo. Chenro mar rito nyithindo e yo mowinjore ok en gima ng'ato oyiero kende, en gima dwarore ahinya

English: Schools can be safe havens for mental health education
Kiswahili: Shule zinaweza kuwa mahali salama pa elimu ya afya ya akili
Dholuo: Skunde nyalo bedo kar buok mar tiego nyithindo e weche mag tuoche mag paro

English: Set boundaries and fuel your mind with positive vibes
Kiswahili: Weka mipaka na uiongezee akili yako hisia chanya
Dholuo: Ket tong' kendo par gik mabeyo ma nyalo konyi

English: This Mens Mental Health Awareness Month, lets break the silence. Society often tells men to "be strong," but real strength lies in acknowledging your struggles and reaching out. 1. Speaking up isnt weaknessits courage. 2. Your feelings are valid. 3.You dont have to face it alone. Whether its stress, anxiety, depression, or just feeling overwhelmed your mental health matters. Talk to a friend, a counselor, or a support group. Asking for help is a sign of strength, not failure. You are human. You deserve support. You are not alone.
Kiswahili: Mwezi huu wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili ya Wanaume, hebu tuvunje ukimya. Mara nyingi jamii huwaambia wanaume "kuwa imara," lakini nguvu halisi iko katika kutambua mapambano yako na kufikia lengo. 1. Kuzungumza si udhaifu - ni ujasiri. 2. Hisia zako ni halali. 3. Huna haja ya kukabiliana nayo peke yako. Iwe ni msongo wa mawazo, wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, au kuhisi tu kuzidiwa - afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Zungumza na rafiki, mshauri, au kikundi cha usaidizi. Kuomba msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si kushindwa. Wewe ni binadamu. Unastahili usaidizi. Hauko peke yako.
Dholuo: E Dwe mar Paro e Wi Tuoche mag Chuny, weuru wawuo kuom wachni. Kinde mang'eny, oganda ji wacho ne chwo ni, beduru motegno, "" to teko madier otenore kuom ng'eyo chandruok ma un-go, kendo temo matek mondo ubed gi nyalo mar nyagruok gi pekgo.

English: Just like your annual doctors visit, your mind deserves a check-up too
Kiswahili: Kama vile ziara yako ya kila mwaka ya daktari, akili yako pia inastahili kuchunguzwa
Dholuo: 3. Ok ochuno ni inonri iwuon.

English: Feeling low? Reaching for alcohol wont lift you up  its a depressant that can make things worse. Choose real healing: talk to a counselor, join a support group, or reach out for help.
Kiswahili: Kuhisi umekata tamaa? Kunywa pombe hakutakuinua - ni dawa ya kufadhaisha ambayo inaweza kufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Chagua uponyaji halisi: zungumza na mshauri, jiunge na kikundi cha usaidizi, au wasiliana nasi kwa msaada.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
Kiswahili: Fikiria tiba au ushauri nasaha. Mtaalamu wa afya ya akili anaweza kutoa mikakati ya kukabiliana na unyanyapaa na kukusaidia kukuza taswira chanya ya wewe mwenyewe
Dholuo: YOUTH IN CRISIS: WHY PREVENTION CANT WAIT [Rowere Manie Chandruok: Gimomiyo Geng'o Tuoche Ok Nyal Rito] Rowerewa ihinyo monjo. Tuwo mar paro. Tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero. Lwenje ma ling'ling' ma ne dhi nyime e kind josiasa kod joma ne ok ong'eyo wach moro. Kata kamano, wan gi geno. Geng'o tuoche ok en mana gima ng'ato nyalo timo kende, en mana yo achiel kende mar tieko chandruogego. Ka watimo gik moko chon, mano miyo wabedo gi ngima maber e kinde mabiro. 1. Tieg ji. 2. Konyo.

English: Societal pressures and gender-based discrimination can contribute to stress and mental health challenges.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la kijamii na ubaguzi wa kijinsia vinaweza kuchangia msongo wa mawazo na changamoto za afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Tugo koda timo tuke miyo ji thuolo mar tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore e geng'o tiyo gi yedhe mamero e kinde yueyo mar skul. Gikonyo e loso chenro, jiwo paro maber, jiwo tudruok e kind ji, kendo konyo jopuonjre bedo gi timbe mabeyo makonyogi kwedo timbe manyalo kelo hinyruok

English: Understanding mental health issues can empower you to challenge misconceptions. Share accurate information with friends and family to promote awareness and reduce stigma
Kiswahili: Kuelewa masuala ya afya ya akili kunaweza kukuwezesha kupinga dhana potofu. Shiriki taarifa sahihi na marafiki na familia ili kukuza uelewa na kupunguza unyanyapaa.
Dholuo: Iwinjo ka chunyi onyosore? Madho kong'o ok bi miyi chuny mor. Onyalo mana medo ketho winjruok manie kindu. Yier kit thieth maber: wuo gi ng'at manyalo konyi, riwri gi joma nyalo konyi, kata many kony.

English: Engage in activities that promote mental health awareness and advocacy. This can help create a sense of belonging and purpose.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika shughuli zinazokuza ufahamu na utetezi wa afya ya akili. Hii inaweza kusaidia kujenga hisia ya kuwa wa kipekee na kusudi.
Dholuo: Miyo ringreni obed gi teko, pachi bende obed gi teko! Gik ma ichamo, kaka itimo, koda gigo ma ok itimo chiko pach ng'ato. Yier chiemo maler, bed ng'at matiyo matek, kendo kik imak kong'o kata gik mamoko manyalo hinyi. In iwuon e ma ibiro bedo mamor!

English: Employers can identify signs of mental health issues in the workplace by observing changes in behavior, such as increased absenteeism, decreased productivity, or withdrawal from colleagues
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanaweza kutambua dalili za matatizo ya afya ya akili mahali pa kazi kwa kuona mabadiliko katika tabia, kama vile kuongezeka kwa kutokuwepo kazini, kupungua kwa tija, au kujiondoa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wenzao.
Dholuo: Sama wan gi pek mag yuto, yot luwo yore mag loyo pekgo mapiyo kaka tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi, kata tiyo gi yedhe mamero, to magi medo mana ketho weche. Kar mano, bed gi paro mowinjore kuom kaka inyalo tiyo gi pesa, kendo tem ng'eyo kaka inyalo tiyo gi pesa e yo maber.

English: Make sure employees are aware of resources available to them, such as Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), mental health hotlines, or counseling services
Kiswahili: Hakikisha wafanyakazi wanafahamu rasilimali zinazopatikana kwao, kama vile Programu za Usaidizi kwa Wafanyakazi (EAPs), simu za dharura za afya ya akili, au huduma za ushauri nasaha.
Dholuo: Par ane kony ma inyalo yudo kuom lakteche. Lakteche nyalo konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo nyagori gi paro ma ok owinjore ma ji nigo kuomi kendo ginyalo konyi bedo gi paro mowinjore kuomi

English: As Kenya records rising malaria cases due to climate variability, the just ended World Malaria Day serves as a critical reminder of the need to transform public health initiatives to meet these evolving challenges
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikirekodi ongezeko la visa vya malaria kutokana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, Siku ya Malaria Duniani iliyomalizika hivi punde inatumika kama ukumbusho muhimu wa hitaji la kubadilisha mipango ya afya ya umma ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi zinazoendelea.
Dholuo: Pek ma oganda kelo koda achaya ma chwo gi mon nigo, nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny e ngimane kendo miyo obed gi tuoche mag paro.

English: Kenya-tested malaria vaccine gets WHO approval
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa Kenya yaidhinishwa na WHO
Dholuo: Ng'eyo tiend midekre mag paro nyalo miyo ibed gi teko mar kwedo paro maok kare. Wuo gi osiepeni koda joodu kuom weche makare mondo okonygi ng'eyo kendo dwoko chien achaye ma ji nigo

English: WHO approves second malaria jab for children, to cost as low as Sh300
Kiswahili: WHO yaidhinisha chanjo ya pili ya malaria kwa watoto, kuwa na gharama ya chini ya Sh300
Dholuo: Bed modich e timo gik ma jiwo ji mondo ong'e tuoche mag obwongo. Timo kamano nyalo miyo ng'ato one ni orwake kendo ni ngimane nigi tiende.

English: Goal-setting is subjective. It is important to create goals that make sense for you during your recovery journey. If you need assistance in creating realistic and achievable goals, reach out to your mentor, peer, or another mental health professional for guidance and tips
Kiswahili: Kuweka malengo ni jambo la kibinafsi. Ni muhimu kuunda malengo yanayokufaa wakati wa safari yako ya kupona. Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi katika kuunda malengo halisi na yanayoweza kufikiwa, wasiliana na mshauri wako, mwenzako, au mtaalamu mwingine wa afya ya akili kwa mwongozo na vidokezo.
Dholuo: Keto chenro mar timo gimoro en gima ng'ato timo owuon. En gima dwarore ahinya mondo iket chenro minyalo chopo e kinde ma idwaro duogo. Kapo ni idwaro mondo okonyi bedo gi chenro ma inyalo chopo, inyalo wuoyo gi ng'at ma nyalo konyi, kata ng'at machielo molony e weche thieth mondo okonyi

English: Develop routines for nutrition, exercise, and sleep. This promotes physical and mental health, contributing to a balanced lifestyle.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza utaratibu wa lishe, mazoezi, na usingizi. Hii inakuza afya ya kimwili na kiakili, na kuchangia mtindo wa maisha wenye usawa.
Dholuo: Bed gi chenro mar chiemo, rieyo dendi, kod nindo. Timo kamano miyo wabedo gi ngima maber mar del koda paro, kendo miyo wadak e ngima maok kal tong'.

English: All pregnant women are encouraged to create a birth preparedness plan including identifying a health facility, arranging transport, and saving funds.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote wajawazito wanahimizwa kuunda mpango wa maandalizi ya kujifungua ikiwa ni pamoja na kutambua kituo cha afya, kupanga usafiri, na kuweka akiba ya fedha.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mon duto ma nigi ich mondo olos chenro mar ikruok ne nyuol moriwo nyaka manyo kuonde thieth, loso yore mag wuoth, kod kano pesa.

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care  skin-to-skin contact  is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto waliozaliwa na uzito mdogo, Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo - mguso wa ngozi kwa ngozi - unapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha unyonyeshaji, na kuongeza maisha.
Dholuo: Kuom nyithindo ma nyuol ka nigi del mapek, ich-ng'ol mar Kangaroo Mother Care ijiwo mondo orit liet mar dendgi, miyo gidhedhre maber, kendo miyo gitony.

English: Men are encouraged to accompany their partners to antenatal clinics and support them during pregnancy and after childbirth. Male involvement improves outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wanahimizwa kuandamana na wenzi wao kwenye kliniki za ujauzito na kuwasaidia wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua. Ushiriki wa wanaume huboresha matokeo.
Dholuo: Ijiwo chwo mondo odhi gi mondegi e osiptande mag nyuol kendo konyogi e kinde ma gin gi ich koda bang' nyuol. Bedo gi chwo mang'eny konyo ahinya.

English: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya desturi za kitamaduni wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua zinaweza kuhatarisha maisha. Jamii zinahimizwa kufuata desturi za kiafya zinazotegemea ushahidi.
Dholuo: Timbe moko mag anyuola e kinde mag nyuol nyalo kelo hinyruok. Ijiwo ji mondo oluw yore mag thieth motenore kuom nonro mosetim.

English: Delivering at without skilled help puts both mother and baby at risk. Always deliver at a health facility with trained personnel.
Kiswahili: Kujifungua nyumbani bila msaada wa kitaalamu kunamweka mama na mtoto katika hatari. Daima jifungulie katika kituo cha afya chenye wafanyakazi waliofunzwa.
Dholuo: Nywolo nyathi e pacho ma onge ng'at molony e weche mag thieth keto ngima mar min nyathi koda mar nyathine kama rach. Kinde duto ter nyithindi e osiptal ma nigi joma olony.

English: Adolescent mothers need extra emotional, nutritional, and medical support. Communities are urged to reduce stigma and promote inclusive care.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wanahitaji msaada wa ziada wa kihisia, lishe, na matibabu. Jamii zinahimizwa kupunguza unyanyapaa na kukuza utunzaji jumuishi.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma nigi mine ma rowere dwarore oyud kony momedore kuom weche mag chuny, mag chiemo, koda mag thieth. Kanyakla ijiwo mondo odwok chien wich kuot kendo ojiw mondo orit ji duto.

English: Regular weight checks at clinics help detect growth issues early. Caregivers are encouraged to attend monthly child welfare clinics.
Kiswahili: Kupima uzito mara kwa mara katika kliniki husaidia kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema. Walezi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za ustawi wa watoto kila mwezi.
Dholuo: Nono pek mar del pile e klinik konyo e fwenyo chon pek mag dongo. Ijiwo joma rito nyithindo mondo odhi e klinik mag nyithindo dwe ka dwe.

English: A toll-free maternal health helpline is available for advice and emergency referrals. Dial 1195 anytime.
Kiswahili: Simu ya usaidizi wa afya ya mama bila malipo inapatikana kwa ushauri na rufaa za dharura. Piga 1195 wakati wowote.
Dholuo: Nitiere namba maonge chudo mar simo mar weche thieth ne mine mondo okonygi gi paro kod weche mag thieth madwarore mapiyo. Go namba 1195 sa asaya midwaro.

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.
Dholuo: Ijiwo joot mondo ong'e motelo yore ma ginyalo tiyogo e kinde ma masira moro oyudogi, kapo ni masira ma kamano otimore apoya. Deko me donyo i ot yat twero kelo peko mapol.

English: Community maternal support groups provide peer education, emotional support, and help connect women to health services during pregnancy and postpartum.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya usaidizi wa akina mama katika jamii hutoa elimu ya rika, usaidizi wa kihisia, na husaidia kuwaunganisha wanawake na huduma za afya wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua.
Dholuo: Grube mag konyo mine e gweng' chiwo tiegruok ne jowetegi, kony e paro, kendo konyo joma mine yudo kony mag thieth e kinde ma gin gi ich koda bang' nyuol.

English: Skin-to-skin care helps stabilize small or preterm babies and promotes weight gain and bonding.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji wa ngozi kwa ngozi husaidia kuimarisha watoto wadogo au waliozaliwa kabla ya wakati na kukuza ongezeko la uzito na mshikamano.
Dholuo: Rwako nyathi e dendi miyo nyathino bedo motegno kendo miyo omedo bedo gi del mapek kendo bedo gi winjruok maber gi jonyuolne.

English: Babies under six months get all the hydration they need from breast milk. Giving water increases infection risk.
Kiswahili: Watoto walio chini ya miezi sita hupata maji yote wanayohitaji kutoka kwa maziwa ya mama. Kumpa mtoto maji huongeza hatari ya kuambukizwa.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mapok ochopo dweche auchiel yudo pi modwaro e chak. Miyo ji pi medo hinyo ng'ato.

English: Severe headaches, swelling, or bleeding during pregnancy require immediate medical attention.
Kiswahili: Maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, au kutokwa na damu wakati wa ujauzito kunahitaji matibabu ya haraka.
Dholuo: Pich wich mager, chwoyo, kata chwero remo e kinde ma dhako nie ich, dwaro ni oyud thieth mapiyo.

English: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kupata huzuni au wasiwasi. Ushauri nasaha na vikundi vya usaidizi vinaweza kusaidia.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo nyalo bedo gi kuyo kata bedo gi parruok. Grube mag kony nyalo konyo.

English: If your child is not sitting, crawling, or speaking by the expected age, visit a pediatric clinic for evaluation
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto wako hajakaa, hajatambaa, au hajazungumza kwa umri unaotarajiwa, tembelea kliniki ya watoto kwa ajili ya tathmini.
Dholuo: Kapo ni nyathini ok winj ka onyalo bet piny, ok owuo, kata ok onyal ringo, dhi e klinik mar lakteche mag nyithindo mondo onone

English: Taking over-the-counter or herbal medicines without a prescription during pregnancy can be dangerous.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua dawa za mitishamba au zilizoagizwa bila agizo la daktari wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kuwa hatari.
Dholuo: Nyalo bedo gima rach ka dhako ma omako ich okawo yedhe moko ma ok ondikne laktar.

English: Hormonal changes during pregnancy can affect oral health. Visit a dentist for check-ups and maintain oral hygiene.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya homoni wakati wa ujauzito yanaweza kuathiri afya ya kinywa. Mtembelee daktari wa meno kwa uchunguzi na udumishe usafi wa kinywa.
Dholuo: Lokruok mag hormone e kinde ma dhako nie ich nyalo ketho dend dhoge. Dhi ir laktar mondo onon dendi, kendo rit ler mar dhogi.

English: Health facilities offer family planning counseling to couples and individuals to support informed decisions about spacing and limiting births.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya hutoa ushauri nasaha wa uzazi wa mpango kwa wanandoa na watu binafsi ili kusaidia maamuzi sahihi kuhusu nafasi na kupunguza uzazi.
Dholuo: Ofise mag thieth chiwo paro ne joma okendore koda ng'ato ka ng'ato kuom wach chano nyuol, mondo okonygi ng'ado paro e yo maber kuom wach keto tong' e kind nyuol koda nyuol.

English: Using simple hand signs helps babies express needs early, reducing frustration for both caregiver and child.
Kiswahili: Kutumia ishara rahisi za mikono huwasaidia watoto kueleza mahitaji yao mapema, na hivyo kupunguza kuchanganyikiwa kwa mlezi na mtoto.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi ranyisi mag lwedo konyo nyithindo fwenyo gik ma gidwaro chon, kendo mano miyo janyuol gi nyathi ok bed gi parruok mang'eny.

English: Fathers are encouraged to be active in bathing, changing, and comforting their newborns to promote bonding and family well-being.
Kiswahili: Akina baba wanahimizwa kuwa hai katika kuwaogesha, kuwabadilisha, na kuwafariji watoto wao wachanga ili kukuza uhusiano na ustawi wa familia.
Dholuo: Ijiwo wuone mondo gibed gi kinda mar lwoko, loko lewni, kendo hoyo nyithindgi ma eka oa nyuol, mondo omi gimed bedo gi winjruok maber e kindgi kendo miyo ngima mar joot obed maber.

English: Mothers are urged to visit immunization booths during market days for convenient access to childhood vaccines.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanahimizwa kutembelea vibanda vya chanjo wakati wa siku za soko ili kupata chanjo za watoto kwa urahisi.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mine mondo odhi e kuonde ma itimoe thieth mag geng'o tuoche e kinde mag chiro mondo giyud thieth mag geng'o tuoche mag nyithindo.

English: New mothers can begin light exercises after consulting their doctor to improve recovery and mental health.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kuanza mazoezi mepesi baada ya kushauriana na daktari wao ili kuboresha kupona na afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo nyalo chako timo tiegruok moko matindo tindo bang' wuoyo gi laktar mondo omi gichiwre kendo bedo gi paro maber.

English: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
Kiswahili: Kutoa dawa za minyoo kwa watoto kila baada ya miezi sita huboresha ukuaji wao, viwango vya nishati, na utendaji wao shuleni.
Dholuo: Pwodho nyithindo dweche auchiel ka dweche auchiel miyo gidongo maber, gibedo gi teko, kendo gibedo gi nyak e skul.

English: Help children understand the arrival of a new sibling to reduce jealousy and promote bonding.
Kiswahili: Wasaidie watoto kuelewa ujio wa ndugu mpya ili kupunguza wivu na kukuza uhusiano wa karibu.
Dholuo: Kony nyithindi mondo ong'e gimomiyo ng'ato nigi nyaminwa kata owadwa manyien mondo kik nyiego makgi, kendo mondo gibed osiepe.

English: Mobile health clinics bring vital prenatal and postnatal services closer to remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kliniki za afya zinazohamishika huleta huduma muhimu za ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua karibu na jamii za mbali.
Dholuo: Klinik mag thieth mawuotho kelo thieth madwarore ahinya mag thieth kapok onyuolo nyathi koda bang' nyuol, e gwenge maboyo.

English: Babies born before 37 weeks require warmth, feeding support, and regular health checkups for proper development.
Kiswahili: Watoto waliozaliwa kabla ya wiki 37 wanahitaji kupashwa joto, usaidizi wa kulisha, na uchunguzi wa afya mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya ukuaji sahihi.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mayudo nyuol kapok jumbe 37 orumo, dwarore ni oritgi maber, opidhgi, kendo onon-gi kinde ka kinde.

English: Men,its okay to talk about your mental health.Speaking up is a sign of strength.
Kiswahili: Wanaume, ni sawa kuzungumzia afya yako ya akili. Kuzungumza ni ishara ya nguvu.
Dholuo: Un chwo, ok rach wuoyo kuom kaka uneno weche mag tuoche mag paro. Wacho gima ineno ni ber nyiso ni in gi teko.

English: This Fathers Day, lets shine a light on mens mental health. To all the dads out there, your well-being matters. Take time to prioritize your mental health and reach out for support when needed.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Baba, hebu tuangazie afya ya akili ya wanaume. Kwa akina baba wote, ustawi wako ni muhimu. Chukua muda wa kuweka kipaumbele afya yako ya akili na uwasiliane na usaidizi unapohitajika.
Dholuo: E odiechieng'ni mar Wuone, weuru mondo wapuonjre kuom tuoche mag paro ma chwo nigo. Ne wuone duto, ngimau en gimaduong '. Kaw kinde mondo iket pachi kuom tuoche mag paro, kendo many kony sama mano dwarore.

English: It's Okay to Talk. June is Men's Mental Health Month. Men, it's okay to talk about your mental health. Sharing your feelings can be the first step toward healing
Kiswahili: Ni Sawa Kuzungumza. Juni ni Mwezi wa Afya ya Akili kwa Wanaume. Wanaume, ni sawa kuzungumzia afya yako ya akili. Kushiriki hisia zako kunaweza kuwa hatua ya kwanza kuelekea uponyaji.
Dholuo: Wuoyo Wuoyo Ber. Dwe mar auchiel en Dwe mar Paro mar Chwo. Un chwo, onge rach wuoyo kuom kaka uneno weche mag tuoche mag paro. Wuoyo kuom kaka iwinjo e chunyi nyalo bedo okang' mokwongo mar loso winjruok manie kindu

English: You are not alone. Reach out to loved ones or mental health professionals for support.
Kiswahili: Hauko peke yako. Wasiliana na wapendwa au wataalamu wa afya ya akili kwa usaidizi.
Dholuo: Ok in kendi. Many kony kuom wedeni kata kuom lakteche molony e weche thieth mag paro.

English: List of common mental disorders: anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, schizophrenia
Kiswahili: Orodha ya matatizo ya akili ya kawaida: wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, ugonjwa wa bipolar, PTSD, skizofrenia
Dholuo: List mar tuoche mapile mag paro: parruok, depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, schizophrenia

English: In our pursuit of a healthier society, let's not forget that there is no health without mental health! As we prioritize physical well-being, it is equally important to prioritize our mental and emotional well-being.
Kiswahili: Katika kutafuta jamii yenye afya njema, tusisahau kwamba hakuna afya bila afya ya akili! Tunapoweka kipaumbele ustawi wa kimwili, ni muhimu pia kuweka kipaumbele ustawi wetu wa kiakili na kihisia.
Dholuo: Sama watemo matek mondo wabed gi ngima maber mar del, kik wiwa wil ni ngima ok nyal bedo maber ka onge tuoche mag paro! Mana kaka waketo ting'wa mag ringruok ema obed motelo, e kaka dwarore bende ni waket pachwa koda chunywa obed motelo.

English: Mental health is the state of wellbeing in which the individual realises their own abilities,can cope with normal sttresses of life,can work pproductively or fruitfully,and is able to make contribution to their community
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ni hali ya ustawi ambapo mtu hutambua uwezo wake mwenyewe, anaweza kukabiliana na matatizo ya kawaida ya maisha, anaweza kufanya kazi kwa tija au kwa matunda, na anaweza kutoa mchango kwa jamii yake.
Dholuo: Ngima mar paro en ngima maber ma ng'ato yudoe ka ong'eyo nyalo ma en-go, onyalo nyagore gi pek mapile e ngima, onyalo tiyo tich maber, kendo onyalo konyo e ngima mar oganda.

English: Regularly talking and singing to your baby strengthens their brain development and early language skills.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumza na kumwimbia mtoto wako mara kwa mara huimarisha ukuaji wa ubongo wake na ujuzi wake wa lugha ya awali.
Dholuo: Wuoyo kod wer kanyachiel gi nyathini kinde ka kinde, tego obwongone koda nyalo ma en-go mar ng'eyo dhok.

English: Sugary juices and sodas are harmful to babies and increase the risk of obesity and tooth decay.
Kiswahili: Juisi na soda zenye sukari ni hatari kwa watoto wachanga na huongeza hatari ya unene kupita kiasi na kuoza kwa meno.
Dholuo: Juices kod soda ma nigi sukari hinyo nyithindo kendo miyo gibedo gi tuwo mar ng'ich ahinya kod tuoche mag lak.

English: Fathers are encouraged to accompany partners to ANC and child wellness clinics.
Kiswahili: Akina baba wanahimizwa kuandamana na washirika wao kwenye kliniki za ANC na ustawi wa watoto.
Dholuo: Ijiwo wuone mondo odhi gi jowetegi e ANC kod kuonde thieth mag nyithindo.

English: Continue breastfeeding during the night to meet babys nutrition needs and maintain milk supply.
Kiswahili: Endelea kunyonyesha usiku ili kukidhi mahitaji ya lishe ya mtoto na kudumisha utoaji wa maziwa.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime pidho nyathini gotieno mondo omiyi chiemo moromo kendo mondo omiye chak moromo.

English: Children thrive when caregivers offer consistent affection, attention, and routines.
Kiswahili: Watoto hustawi wakati walezi wanapowapa upendo, uangalifu, na utaratibu unaoendelea.
Dholuo: Nyithindo timo maber ka jonyuolgi oherogi, odewogi, kendo oketonegi chenro ma biro konyogi kinde duto.

English: High blood pressure in pregnancy can lead to preeclampsia. Regular check-ups are essential for early detection.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la damu kubwa wakati wa ujauzito linaweza kusababisha preeclampsia. Uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara ni muhimu kwa ugunduzi wa mapema.
Dholuo: Duoko mar remo malo e kinde ma dhako ni gi ich nyalo kelo preeclampsia. Nono jatuwo kinde ka kinde en gima dwarore ahinya mondo omi ofweny tuwono chon.

English: Reading to children daily boosts language development, imagination, and bonding.
Kiswahili: Kusomea watoto kila siku huongeza ukuaji wa lugha, mawazo, na uhusiano.
Dholuo: Somo ne nyithindo pile miyo dhok ma giwacho dongo, pachgi tiyo maber, kendo miyo gibedo gi winjruok maber gi jomoko.

English: Start with mashed fruits and vegetables. Introduce one new food at a time to watch for allergies.
Kiswahili: Anza na matunda na mboga zilizosagwa. Anzisha chakula kipya kimoja baada ya kingine ili uangalie mizio.
Dholuo: Chak gi chamo alot mar olembe gi alot mamoko. Chiem achiel bang' machielo mondo kik ichak chamo chiemo ma nyalo miyo ng'ato odok chien.

English: Take your child for regular weight and height checks to detect growth issues early.
Kiswahili: Mpeleke mtoto wako kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa uzito na urefu mara kwa mara ili kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema.
Dholuo: Kaw nyathini mondo inon pek kod borne kinde ka kinde, mondo ifweny chon kapo ni nitie gimoro ma ok dhi maber e dongo.

English: Fast breathing, chest indrawing, or cough may signal pneumonia. Take the child to a clinic.
Kiswahili: Kupumua haraka, kuvuta kifua, au kukohoa kunaweza kuashiria nimonia. Mpeleke mtoto kliniki.
Dholuo: Chuny ma ng'ato gamo piyo, bedo gi rem e kor ng'ato, kata yuto, nyalo nyiso ni en gi tuwo mar adundo. Kaw nyathino kendo idhi kode e osiptal.

English: Breast milk contains nutrients vital for a babys brain development.
Kiswahili: Maziwa ya mama yana virutubisho muhimu kwa ukuaji wa ubongo wa mtoto.
Dholuo: Kodhi mar miyo nigi gik makonyo nyathi mondo obwongone obed motegno.

English: A GAIN-led campaign in Mombasa that improves access to affordable fruits and vegetables in urban market zones.
Kiswahili: Kampeni inayoongozwa na GAIN huko Mombasa ambayo inaboresha upatikanaji wa matunda na mboga za bei nafuu katika maeneo ya soko la mijini.
Dholuo: Kampen mar GAIN e Mombasa ma konyo ji yudo olembe kod alot ma nengogi yot e kuonde ma ji timoe ohala e taonde.

English: IGAD commits to improving food and nutrition security in Africa. Data shows 21% of people across IGAD member states are food insecure
Kiswahili: IGAD imejitolea kuboresha usalama wa chakula na lishe barani Afrika. Takwimu zinaonyesha 21% ya watu katika nchi wanachama wa IGAD hawana uhakika wa chakula
Dholuo: Riwruok mar IGAD osingo mar miyo chiemo kod chiemo obed maber e Afrika. Nonro nyiso ni pasent 21 mar ji e pinje mag IGAD ok yud chiemo moromo

English: Waiting a minute before clamping the cord improves babys iron levels and immunity.
Kiswahili: Kusubiri dakika moja kabla ya kubana kitovu huboresha viwango vya chuma na kinga ya mtoto.
Dholuo: Rito kata mana dakika achiel kapok ichako tweyo nyolono, miyo nyathino bedo gi teko mar geng'o tuoche.

English: Learn correct positioning and latching techniques from health workers during pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Jifunze mbinu sahihi za kuweka na kushikilia kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa afya wakati wa ujauzito.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka onego iket ng'ato e yo makare kod kaka inyalo tweye e kinde ma en gi ich kuom lakteche.
