English: Children exposed to smoke are more likely to develop asthma and respiratory infections.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaovuta moshi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata pumu na maambukizi ya njia ya upumuaji.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma madho ndawa hinyo bedo gi tuoche mag yueyo kaka ayaki.

English: State Dept. affirming expansion of labs to enforce fortification and nutrient profiling in major food markets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo ikithibitisha upanuzi wa maabara ili kutekeleza uimarishaji na uainishaji wa virutubisho katika masoko makubwa ya chakula.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Piny owacho mar Amerka ne oyie ni omed kuonde mag timo nonro mondo omi omed tiyo gi teko mar medo chiemo e chiemo kod nonro mar gik mamiyo chiemo bedo gi ngima maber.

English: State Dept. commitingto subsidizing solar-powered storage for perishable nutrient-rich crops.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo imejitolea kutoa ruzuku kwa hifadhi inayotumia nishati ya jua kwa mazao yanayoharibika na yenye virutubisho vingi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Piny owacho ne osingore mar chiwo kony ne kembe ma tiyo gi teko mar chieng' e kano cham ma nyalo kethore piyo kendo ma nigi chiemo mang'eny.

English: WHO African office releases commendatory brief supporting Kenya's nutrition labeling reforms.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya WHO barani Afrika yatoa muhtasari wa pongezi unaounga mkono mageuzi ya uainishaji wa lishe nchini Kenya.
Dholuo: Ofis mar WHO e Afrika golo barua mar pwoch mar siro lokruok ma Kenya osetimo e weche mag chiemo.

English: Health Ministry launching SMS alert to inform citizens when foods exceed sugar/salt/fat thresholds.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua tahadhari ya SMS ili kuwafahamisha raia wakati vyakula vinazidi viwango vya sukari/chumvi/mafuta.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth chako chiwo siem e yor SMS mondo onyis raia sama chiemo okalo tong' mar sukari, chumbi, kata mo.

English: State Dept. promoting millet and sorghum blends as pilot menu in adaptation to climate-resilient diets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo inakuza mchanganyiko wa mtama na mtama kama menyu ya majaribio katika kukabiliana na lishe zinazostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Dholuo: State Dept. jiwo millet kod sorghum miwako kaka chiemo mar jorit e timo lokruok e kit chiemo ma nyagruok gi lokruok mar piny.

English: County launches mass supplementation reaching over 12,000 children aged 6–59 months with Vitamin A and deworming to enhance immunity and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Kaunti yazindua virutubisho vingi vinavyowafikia zaidi ya watoto 12,000 wenye umri wa miezi 6-59 kwa kutumia Vitamini A na dawa za minyoo ili kuongeza kinga na lishe.
Dholuo: Kaunti ochako chiwo chiemo ne nyithindo mokalo 12,000 ma hikgi nie kind dweche 6 gi 59 gi Vitamin A kod deworming mondo omed geng'o tuoche kendo omedgi chiemo.

English: Nairobi County to provide daily lunches to 400,000 primary school pupils via new kitchens to eliminate hunger and support local farmers.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nairobi kutoa chakula cha mchana cha kila siku kwa wanafunzi 400,000 wa shule za msingi kupitia jikoni mpya ili kuondoa njaa na kuwasaidia wakulima wa eneo hilo.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nairobi biro chiwo chiemo mar odiechieng' ne jopuonjre 400,000 mag praimari kokalo kuom kitegi manyien mondo otiek kech kendo konyo jopur.

English: Pregnant women need calcium for strong bones and teeth for both themselves and the baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanahitaji kalsiamu kwa mifupa na meno yenye nguvu - kwa wao wenyewe na mtoto.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach dwarore ni oyud calcium mondo omi chokegi koda lekegi obed motegno.

English: Place babies on their tummies while awake and supervised to build neck and motor strength.
Kiswahili: Waweke watoto kwenye matumbo yao wakiwa macho na uwaangalie ili kujenga nguvu ya shingo na mwendo.
Dholuo: Ket nyithindo e kitanda ka gineno kendo inon-gi mondo omi gibed gi teko mar tiyo gi ng'utgi kod fuondgi.

English: Cracked bottles can harbor germs. Replace damaged feeding equipment promptly.
Kiswahili: Chupa zilizopasuka zinaweza kuhifadhi vijidudu. Badilisha vifaa vya kulishia vilivyoharibika haraka.
Dholuo: Yath motop nyalo ting'o kute moko. Lok gik ma okethore mapiyo.

English: Sleeping under treated nets reduces malaria risk for pregnant women and unborn babies.
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa hupunguza hatari ya malaria kwa wanawake wajawazito na watoto ambao hawajazaliwa.
Dholuo: Nindo e bwo obumbego nyalo dwoko piny tuo mar malaria kuom mine ma yach kod nyithindo mapok onyuol.

English: Before 6 months, breast milk provides all the fluids a baby needs.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya miezi 6, maziwa ya mama hutoa maji yote ambayo mtoto anahitaji.
Dholuo: Kapok ochopo dweche auchiel, chak mar min miyo nyathi duto pi modwaro.

English: Play is vital for a childs emotional, physical, and cognitive development.
Kiswahili: Kucheza ni muhimu kwa ukuaji wa kihisia, kimwili, na kiakili wa mtoto.
Dholuo: Tugo konyo nyathi ahinya e dongo e paro, e del, koda e bedo gi nyalo mar paro.

English: A mothers diet during pregnancy influences her childs long-term health. Eat diverse, nutritious foods.
Kiswahili: Lishe ya mama wakati wa ujauzito huathiri afya ya muda mrefu ya mtoto wake. Kula vyakula mbalimbali na vyenye lishe.
Dholuo: Chiemo ma miyo chamo e kinde ma en gi ich, nyalo miyo nyathine obed gi ngima maber e kinde mabiro. Chiemuru chiemo moting'o gik mopogore opogore kendo mabeyo.

English: Even for a moment, leaving a baby on a bed or table unattended can lead to falls and injuries.
Kiswahili: Hata kwa muda mfupi, kumwacha mtoto kitandani au mezani bila mtu anayemtunza kunaweza kusababisha kuanguka na majeraha.
Dholuo: Kata mana weyo nyathi matin e otanda kata e mesa ka onge ng'ama rite, nyalo miyo odonj e masira kendo ohinyre.

English: Give children aged 6 months to 5 years vitamin A supplements every 6 months to strengthen immunity.
Kiswahili: Wape watoto wenye umri wa miezi 6 hadi miaka 5 virutubisho vya vitamini A kila baada ya miezi 6 ili kuimarisha kinga.
Dholuo: Chiw ne nyithindo ma johigini 6 dwe ka dwe kata ma johigini 5 vitamin A mondo omed geng'o tuoche.

English: Some over-the-counter drugs can harm your unborn baby. Always consult a health worker.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya dawa zinazouzwa bila agizo la daktari zinaweza kumdhuru mtoto wako ambaye hajazaliwa. Daima wasiliana na mfanyakazi wa afya.
Dholuo: Nitie yedhe moko ma ng'ato nyalo nyiewo ma hinyo nyathine mapok onyuol. Kinde duto dhi ir laktar.

English: Feed your baby when they show hunger signs, not on a strict schedule. Watch for cues.
Kiswahili: Lisha mtoto wako anapoonyesha dalili za njaa, si kwa ratiba kali. Kuwa mwangalifu kwa vidokezo.
Dholuo: Mi nyathini chiemo sama odwaro chiemo to ok kaluwore gi chenro moketi. Bed motang' gi gik manyalo nyisi ni onego itim kamano.

English: Partner involvement during antenatal and postnatal care improves family health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa mshirika wakati wa utunzaji wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua huboresha matokeo ya afya ya familia.
Dholuo: Bedo gi dichwo kata dhako e kinde mag thieth kapok onyuolo nyathi kod bang' nyuol miyo ngima joot bedo maber.

English: Teach girls about periods, hygiene, and body changes before puberty starts.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe wasichana kuhusu hedhi, usafi, na mabadiliko ya mwili kabla ya kubalehe kuanza.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo ma nyiri wach rito ler mar del, koda lokruok matimore e dendgi kapok gibedo rowere mandhowe.

English: Support from fathers, grandparents, and siblings strengthens outcomes for mother and baby.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi kutoka kwa baba, babu na bibi, na ndugu huimarisha matokeo kwa mama na mtoto.
Dholuo: Kony ma jonyuol, kwere, koda owete koda nyimine chiwo, tego winjruok e kind miyo gi nyathi.

English: Government annmounncing a National Nutrition Symposium to share strategies on universal health care (UHC) and community nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza Kongamano la Kitaifa la Lishe ili kushiriki mikakati kuhusu huduma ya afya kwa wote (UHC) na lishe ya jamii.
Dholuo: Sirkal lando National Nutrition Symposium mar chiwo paro e wi yore mag thieth ne ji duto (UHC) kod chiemo ne oganda.

English: Announinng meeting where the country formally signs UNSDCF Nutrition Joint Programme to support multisector work.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa kutangaza ambapo nchi inasaini rasmi Programu ya Pamoja ya Lishe ya UNSDCF ili kusaidia kazi za sekta mbalimbali.
Dholuo: Chokruok mar lando kama pinyno biro riwo lwedo chenro mar UNSDCF mar chiemo mondo okony tije mopogore opogore.

English: Ministry updating training module to strengthen response to malnutrition at community level.
Kiswahili: Wizara inasasisha moduli ya mafunzo ili kuimarisha mwitikio wa utapiamlo katika ngazi ya jamii.
Dholuo: Migawo manyien mar tiegruok dhi nyime mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi midekre mar chiemo e okang' mar oganda.

English: Cross-sector validation meeting held to align county and national nutrition strategies under KNAP.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa uthibitishaji wa sekta mtambuka ulifanyika ili kuoanisha mikakati ya lishe ya kaunti na kitaifa chini ya KNAP.
Dholuo: Chokruok mar pimo weche e kind migepe ne otim mondo ochan chenro mag county kod mag piny e bwo KNAP.

English: Nationwide campaign to deliver Vitamin A to children under 5 and coordinate with routine immunization services.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kutoa VitaminiA kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 na kuratibu huduma za kawaida za chanjo.
Dholuo: Kampen mar piny mangima mar chiwo Vitamin A ne nyithindo ma hikgi okalo 5 kendo riwo lwedo chenro mag thieth.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango wa kitaifa wa uingiliaji kati wa lishe katika ngazi za kaunti na kitaifa.
Dholuo: Lando wach chenro mar piny mangima mar yore mag chiemo e okang' mar counties kod piny mangima.

English: Ministry inviting community service organizations via SUNCSA to plan public nutrition messaging and sanitation strategy (Epuka Uchafu).
Kiswahili: Wizara inaalika mashirika ya huduma kwa jamii kupitia SUNCSA kupanga mkakati wa ujumbe wa lishe kwa umma na usafi wa mazingira (Epuka Uchafu).
Dholuo: Migawo mar gwelo riwruoge matiyo ne oganda kokalo kuom SUNCSA mondo gichan chenro mar chiwo weche mag chiemo ne oganda kod yore mag rito ler (Epuka Uchafu).

English: Ministry highlighting role of community health workers in delivering nutrition services as part of Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikiangazia jukumu la wafanyakazi wa afya ya jamii katika kutoa huduma za lishe kama sehemu ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Migawo Mochung'ne Weche mag Thieth jiwo tich ma jotich mag thieth e alworano timo e chiwo weche mag thieth kaka achiel kuom yore mag thieth madwarore ne ji duto.

English: National ACSM strategy introduced to promote nutrition messaging and public awareness across sectors.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa kitaifa wa ACSM ulianzishwa ili kukuza ujumbe wa lishe na uelewa wa umma katika sekta mbalimbali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar ACSM mar piny owacho ne ochaki mondo ojiw weche mag chiemo kod ng'eyo mar oganda e yore mopogore opogore.

English: Announing a nutrition education & weekly iron–folic acid supplementation delivered to adolescents across Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza elimu ya lishe na nyongeza ya kila wiki ya asidi ya chuma-foliki inayotolewa kwa vijana kote Busia, Kitui na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Lando wach tiegruok e weche mag chiemo kod medo yedhe mag iron ⁇ folic acid juma ka juma ne rowere e gwenge mag Busia, Kitui kod Nakuru.

English: Java to offer nutrition to national teams. Men and women teams in camp for Africa Games
Kiswahili: Java kutoa lishe kwa timu za taifa. Timu za wanaume na wanawake kambini kwa ajili ya Michezo ya Afrika
Dholuo: Java mondo ochiw chiemo ne jotugo mag pinyno. Jotim tuke mag chwo gi mon e kambi mar tuke mag Afrika

English: Blue band kicks off the campaign in Nairobi. Campaign aims at promoting good nutrition
Kiswahili: Bendi ya Bluu yaanza kampeni jijini Nairobi. Kampeni inalenga kukuza lishe bora
Dholuo: Blue band chako kampen e Nairobi. Kampenno dwaro jiwo wach chiemo maber

English: Kenya's Push To Promote Traditional Food Is Good For Nutrition And Cultural Heritage
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la Kenya la Kukuza Chakula cha Jadi ni Nzuri kwa Lishe na Urithi wa Utamaduni
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar jiwo chiemo ma ne chon itiyogo konyo e miyo ji chiemo maber kod rito mwandu mag oganda

English: Launch of a pilot to provide free milk twice weekly to primary school children in Migori and Nakuru counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa majaribio ya kutoa maziwa ya bure mara mbili kwa wiki kwa watoto wa shule za msingi katika kaunti za Migori na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar chiwo chak maonge chudo nyadiriyo juma ka juma ne nyithindo ma dhi e skunde mag praimari e counties mag Migori kod Nakuru.

English: Introduction of MoreMilk 2, aimed at improving milk safety and incomes via standards, training, and market access in central/western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa MoreMilk2, unaolenga kuboresha usalama wa maziwa na mapato kupitia viwango, mafunzo, na ufikiaji wa soko katikati/magharibi mwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi MoreMilk 2, ma dwaro ni omed geng'o tuoche mag chak kod kelo yuto kokalo kuom chike, tiegruok, kod yudo thuolo mar dhi e chiro e Kenya.

English: National target set to raise annual milk yield from 5.2B to 10B liters, boosting smallholder farmer incomes.
Kiswahili: Lengo la kitaifa limewekwa kuongeza mavuno ya maziwa ya kila mwaka kutoka lita bilioni 5.2 hadi bilioni 10, na hivyo kuongeza kipato cha wakulima wadogo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar piny owacho mar medo nyak mar chak higa ka higa koa e lita bilion 5.2 nyaka bilion 10, kendo medo pesa ma jopur matindo yudo.

English: Public launch event held to introduce the MoreMilk 2 initiative intended to enhance milk handling and market access in key milk-producing counties.
Kiswahili: Hafla ya uzinduzi wa hadhara ilifanyika ili kutambulisha mpango wa MoreMilk2 unaolenga kuboresha utunzaji wa maziwa na upatikanaji wa soko katika kaunti muhimu zinazozalisha maziwa.
Dholuo: Chokruok ma ne itimo e lela mar chako chenro mar MoreMilk 2 ma ne dhi konyo ji ng'iewo chak e gwenge ma nigi chak mang'eny.

English: Public statement endorsing millet, sorghum and legumes for sustainability and dietary resilience.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma inayounga mkono mtama, mtama na kunde kwa ajili ya uendelevu na ustahimilivu wa lishe.
Dholuo: Wach ma ji duto ong'eyo ma jiwo ni mondo chiemo ma ji chamo obed ma siko kendo okethre, dwarore ni ji duto ocham millet, sorghum, kod alode.

English: Release of national media campaign explaining new front-of-pack labelling to consumers.
Kiswahili: Kutolewa kwa kampeni ya kitaifa ya vyombo vya habari inayoelezea lebo mpya za mbele kwa watumiaji.
Dholuo: Goyo kampen mar lando weche e okang' malach e piny mangima ka ilero ne joma tiyo gi gik moko weche manyien e nyim gik moko.

English: Campaign encouraging edible oil producers to reduce sodium content through voluntary pledge scheme.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kuwahimiza wazalishaji wa mafuta ya kula kupunguza kiwango cha sodiamu kupitia mpango wa ahadi ya hiari.
Dholuo: Kampen ma jiwo joma loso mo mar chiemo mondo odwok chien sodium ma gin - go kokalo kuom chenro mar chiwruok ma onge achune.

English: Announcement of influencer-led digital media campaign promoting self-care, destigmatization, and helpline awareness in mental wellness week.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kampeni ya vyombo vya habari vya kidijitali inayoongozwa na watu wenye ushawishi inayokuza utunzaji binafsi, udhalilishaji, na ufahamu wa simu ya usaidizi katika wiki ya ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: Lando mar kampen mar digital media mitayo gi joma nigi teko mar jiwo ritruok ma ng'ato owuon timo, tieko wichkuot, kendo konyo ji ng'eyo kaka ginyalo rito ngimagi e kinde mar juma mar paro.

English: Launch of hydroponic garden pilot to supply fresh vegetables in school cafeterias in dry areas.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa majaribio ya bustani ya hydroponic ili kusambaza mboga mbichi katika mikahawa ya shule katika maeneo makavu.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar tiyo gi puothe mag hydroponic e chiwo alot manyien e kafeteria mag skunde e gwenge motwo.

English: Population Services Kenya launches Iron-Folate supplement and nutrition education sessions for adolescents in Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.
Kiswahili: Huduma za Idadi ya Watu Kenya zazindua vikao vya elimu ya virutubisho vya Iron-Folate na lishe kwa vijana huko Busia, Kitui na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Population Services Kenya ochako chenro mar Iron-Folate supplement kod tiegruok e weche mag chiemo ne rowere e Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.

English: Official launch of $5 billion FNRP to support food security across 24 ASAL counties, targeting 5M vulnerable Kenyans.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa FNRP ya dola bilioni 5 ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula katika kaunti 24 za ASAL, ukilenga Wakenya milioni 5 walio katika mazingira magumu.
Dholuo: Chiwo mar pesa mar bilion 5 mar FNRP mar siro chiemo e gwenge 24 mag ASAL, ka ichano ne jo Kenya 5M ma ok nyal kony.

English: Celebrations as Kenya surpasses the WHO target with exclusive breastfeeding rates rising above 50%; commitment extended to sustain improvements.
Kiswahili: Sherehe huku Kenya ikizidi lengo la WHO huku viwango vya unyonyeshaji pekee vikiongezeka zaidi ya 50%; ahadi imeongezwa ili kudumisha maboresho.
Dholuo: Nyasi kaka Kenya okalo tarig mar WHO ka kwan mar nyithindo ma nyiri ma nyiri kende ema pidho nyithindgi gi minegi omedore mokalo 50%; chiwruok omed mondo okony dongruok.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County officially rolls out CNAP targeting a reduction of child stunting from 30% to 22%.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet yazindua rasmi mpango wa CNAP unaolenga kupunguza udumavu wa watoto kutoka 30% hadi 22%.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Elgeyo Marakwet oseloso chenro mar CNAP ma dwaro ni odwok chien kwan mar nyithindo ma ok dhi maber kowuok 30% nyaka 22%.

English: Launch of four-year dairy quality improvement initiative in central and western Kenya targeting smallholder producers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa miaka minne wa kuboresha ubora wa maziwa katikati na magharibi mwa Kenya unaolenga wazalishaji wadogo.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar higni ang'wen mar medo lony e yore mag loso chak e Kenya ma yo milambo kod ma dier pinyno, ma oket ne jopur matindo.

English: Official launch of a campaign integrating sanitation and nutrition messaging, coordinated via civil society coalitions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa kampeni inayojumuisha usafi wa mazingira na ujumbe wa lishe, iliyoratibiwa kupitia miungano ya asasi za kiraia.
Dholuo: Chiwruok mar kampen mar chiwo weche mag ler kod chiemo, ma itimo kokalo kuom riwruoge mag oganda.

English: Launch of national Advocacy, Communication & Social Mobilization plan for better public understanding of nutrition.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa kitaifa wa Utetezi, Mawasiliano na Uhamasishaji wa Kijamii kwa ajili ya uelewa bora wa umma kuhusu lishe.
Dholuo: Chako chenro mar lando weche mag chiemo e okang' ma malo e piny mangima.

English: Ministry of Health hosts forum with media partners to promote breastfeeding benefits for working parents.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya huandaa jukwaa na washirika wa vyombo vya habari ili kutangaza faida za kunyonyesha kwa wazazi wanaofanya kazi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth ochano romo gi jofwamb weche mondo gijiw ber mar nyodo ne jonyuol matiyo.

English: Official roll-out of grant scheme to support vegetable gardens and school nutrition across Nairobi's public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa ruzuku ili kusaidia bustani za mboga na lishe shuleni katika shule za msingi za umma jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar chiwo kony mar konyo puothe mag alot kod chiemo e skunde e skunde duto mag Nairobi.

English: Ministry releasing comprehensive strategy following success of KNAP 2018–2022, targeting multisectoral interventions to further reduce malnutrition rates.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitoa mkakati kamili kufuatia mafanikio ya KNAP 2018–2022, ikilenga uingiliaji kati wa sekta mbalimbali ili kupunguza zaidi viwango vya utapiamlo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche mag chiemo ne ogolo chenro moro maduong' bang' KNAP 2018 ⁇ 2022, ma ne oriwo yore mopogore opogore mag konyo ji mondo kik gichak chamo chiemo moromo.

English: Formal launch of digital advocacy initiative mobilizing influencers and civil society to promote nutrient profiling, FOP labelling, and policy change.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa utetezi wa kidijitali unaowahamasisha watu wenye ushawishi na asasi za kiraia ili kukuza uainishaji wa virutubisho, uwekaji lebo wa FOP, na mabadiliko ya sera.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar digital advocacy mar choko jogo ma nigi teko kod oganda mar oganda mondo gijiw weche mag chiemo, keto alama mag FOP, kod loko chike.

English: Announcing the launch of Kenya Market Assessment highlighting need for warning labels under new nutrient profiling model.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa Tathmini ya Soko la Kenya ikiangazia hitaji la lebo za tahadhari chini ya mfumo mpya wa uainishaji wa virutubisho.
Dholuo: Lando wach chako nono mar Kenya Market Assessment ka ginyiso ni dwarore ni ondik weche mag siem kaluwore gi chenro manyien mar nono gik ma miyo chiemo bedo maber.

English: Public launch of irrigated crop and fodder production in Naoros, where malnutrition cases among under-fives declined by 41% thanks to integrated agricultural-nutrition interventions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya umwagiliaji na malisho ya mifugo huko Naoros, ambapo visa vya utapiamlo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano vilipungua kwa 41% kutokana na hatua jumuishi za kilimo na lishe.
Dholuo: Ne ochak tich mar pidho puothe kod pidho jamni e piny Naoros, kama kwan mar nyithindo ma nigi midekre mar yuto ne odok chien gi pasent 41 nikech chenro mag pur gi chiemo.

English: Public launch of rice products fortified with iron, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine and zinc, aligned with government fortification standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa bidhaa za mchele zilizoongezewa madini ya chuma, asidi ya foliki, vitamini B, iodini na zinki, unaoendana na viwango vya serikali vya urutubishaji.
Dholuo: Chiwruok ne ji duto mar chiemo mowuok e cham mowir gi chuma, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine kod zinc, kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: Official launch of biofertilizer to increase micronutrient content in crops grown in six counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar tiyo gi biofertilizer mondo omed gik makonyo e loso chiemo e pinje auchiel.

English: Launch of smartphone app to track daily steps, hydration, dietary intake, and stress levels with community leaderboards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu ya simu mahiri ili kufuatilia hatua za kila siku, unyevu, ulaji wa chakula, na viwango vya msongo wa mawazo kwa kutumia ubao wa viongozi wa jamii.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar app mar smartphone mar nono okenge ma ng'ato kawo pile, pi, chiemo ma ng'ato chamo, kod pek ma ng'ato nigo kaluwore gi joma nie kanyakla.

English: Launch of a customizable wellness approach combining psychoeducation, screenings, group sessions, and organizational policy consulting for employee wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mbinu ya ustawi inayoweza kubadilishwa inayochanganya elimu ya kisaikolojia, uchunguzi, vikao vya kikundi, na ushauri wa sera za shirika kwa ajili ya ustawi wa wafanyakazi.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar ngima maber ma ng'ato owuon nyalo luwo ka oriwo tiegruok mar paro, nonro mag tuoche, romo mag grube, kod paro e wi chike mag riwruok mag jotich.

English: Announcement that public service will now provide tele and in-person counselling services through Huduma Centres and hotline 1919.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba huduma ya umma sasa itatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha kwa njia ya simu na ana kwa ana kupitia Vituo vya Huduma na simu ya dharura 1919.
Dholuo: Lando ni sirkal koro biro chiwo tele kod weche mag ng'ato ka ng'ato kokalo kuom Huduma Centres kod hotline 1919.

English: Public invitation and details for October 2025 national conference themed "Securing the Future" on holistic mental health.
Kiswahili: Mwaliko wa umma na maelezo ya mkutano wa kitaifa wa Oktoba 2025 wenye mada "Kulinda Mustakabali" kuhusu afya ya akili kamili.
Dholuo: Luong mar ji duto kod weche ma nyiso kaka ibiro tim chokruok mar piny mangima e dwe mar Oktoba 2025 ma wiye wacho ni "Bedo gi Geno Maber ne Kinde Mabiro" ma wuoyo e wi tuoche mag paro.

English: Gertrudes Cancer Walk: Walk held to raise funds for children with Cancer. Thousands turned up for the walk in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Matembezi ya Saratani ya Gertrudes: Matembezi yafanyika ili kuchangisha fedha kwa ajili ya watoto wenye Saratani. Maelfu walijitokeza kwa ajili ya matembezi hayo jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Wuoth mar Gertrudes Cancer Walk: Wuoth ma itimo mondo ochok pesa ne nyithindo ma nigi tuo mar Cancer. Ji gana gi gana nobiro e wuodhno Nairobi

English: Gov't increases SHA benefits for Cancer patients, adds real-time claims tracking
Kiswahili: Serikali haiongezi faida za SHA kwa wagonjwa wa Saratani, inaongeza ufuatiliaji wa madai ya wakati halisi
Dholuo: Sirkal medo kony mag SHA ne joma nigi tuo mar kansa, medo luwo kwayo e sa mowinjore

English: Public communication campaign across radio and TV networks during national mental health month.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya mawasiliano ya umma katika mitandao ya redio na televisheni wakati wa mwezi wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Kampen mar tudruok gi oganda e redio kod TV e dwe mar thieth mar paro.

English: Health Ministry mandating provision of fruit-based snacks instead of sugary options in public primary schools by 2026.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ikiagiza utoaji wa vitafunio vyenye matunda badala ya vyakula vyenye sukari katika shule za msingi za umma ifikapo mwaka 2026.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth dwaro ni mondo ochiw chiemo mayudore e olembe kar chiemo moting'o sukari e skunde mag sirkal e higa mar 2026.

English: New policy by the government mandating flexible scheduling, stress management training, and wellness breaks in government offices.
Kiswahili: Sera mpya ya serikali inayoagiza ratiba inayobadilika, mafunzo ya usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, na mapumziko ya ustawi katika ofisi za serikali.
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar sirkal madwaro ni ng'ato obed gi thuolo mar timo tije mopogore opogore, tiegruok e weche mag kedo gi parruok, kod yueyo mar ritruok e ofise mag sirkal.

English: Government promoting daily exercise challenge across all counties, emphasizing movement for health.
Kiswahili: Serikali inakuza changamoto ya mazoezi ya kila siku katika kaunti zote, ikisisitiza harakati za afya.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo chenro mar timo tiegruok mag rieyo del pile e kaunti duto, ka gijiwo mondo ji obed gi ngima maber.

English: National Coordinating Committee affirming Kenya's pledges on food system reform, nutrition financing, and wellness pathways.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uratibu ikithibitisha ahadi za Kenya kuhusu mageuzi ya mfumo wa chakula, ufadhili wa lishe, na njia za ustawi.
Dholuo: Komiti mar National Coordinating Committee mar Kenya ma jiwo singo mag Kenya e wach loso chenro mag chiemo, yuto mag chiemo, kod yore mag ngima maber.

English: Launch of digitized supply chain tool connecting farmers, schools and vendors to improve nutrition transparency in school feeding.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa zana ya ugavi ya kidijitali inayowaunganisha wakulima, shule na wachuuzi ili kuboresha uwazi wa lishe katika kulisha shuleni.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar chiwo chiemo e yo ma digitized ma riwo jopur, skunde kod jouso mondo omed miyo chiemo obed malong'o e chiemo michiwo e skunde.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar Jifunze Lishe SMS mar oro paro mag chiemo kod ngima maber juma ka juma ne ji 2M.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases from Nairobi, Nakuru and Mombasa counties, this brings the total to 17, Health CS Barasa says.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox kutoka kaunti za Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, hii inafikisha jumla ya visa 17, Waziri wa Afya Barasa anasema.
Dholuo: Kenya onyiso ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox koa Nairobi, Nakuru kod Mombasa, ma kelo kwan duto mar ji 17, Health CS Barasa wacho.

English: The Ministry of Health has assured the public that the Mpox situation in the country is not comparable to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hali ya Mpox nchini hailinganishwi na janga la COVID-19.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osenyiso oganda ni chal mar Mpox e piny ok nyal pim gi mar tuo mar COVID-19.

English: As concerns rise over Mpox outbreak, the Ministry of Health has pledged to procure two million vaccines before the end of the year.
Kiswahili: Huku wasiwasi ukiongezeka kuhusu mlipuko wa Mpox, Wizara ya Afya imeahidi kupata chanjo milioni mbili kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka.
Dholuo: Kaka parruok medore nikech tuo mar Mpox, Migawo mar Thieth osesingore ni obiro ng'iewo chanjo milion ariyo kapok higa orumo.

English: Ministry of Health launches HIV\AIDS marathon to be held on December 1, as it targets to eradicate the disease by 2030
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua mbio za marathon za VVU/UKIMWI zitakazofanyika Desemba 1, huku ikilenga kutokomeza ugonjwa huo ifikapo mwaka 2030
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth chako piem mar HIV/AIDS mabiro timore Desemba 1, nikech en chenro mar tieko tuo mar HIV/AIDS e higa mar 2030

English: Empowering farmers living with HIV/AIDS a crucial step towards sustainable agriculture, community well-being
Kiswahili: Kuwawezesha wakulima wanaoishi na VVU/UKIMWI ni hatua muhimu kuelekea kilimo endelevu, ustawi wa jamii
Dholuo: Miyo jopur ma nigi AYAKI/AIDS teko en okang' maduong' e yor pur masiko, ngima maber mar oganda

English: The COVID-19 pandemic may be causing extra stress for many people. Learn the common signs of a mental health crisis and ways you can help.
Kiswahili: Janga la COVID-19 linaweza kusababisha msongo wa mawazo zaidi kwa watu wengi. Jifunze dalili za kawaida za mgogoro wa afya ya akili na njia unazoweza kusaidia.
Dholuo: Tuo mar COVID-19 nyalo kelo parruok momedore ne ji mang'eny. Puonjri gik ma nyalo nyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuoche mag paro kod kaka inyalo konyogi.

English: 1 in 3 Kenyans will experience a mental health proplem at somepoint. Recognize and understand the symptoms.
Kiswahili: Mkenya 1 kati ya 3 atapitia tatizo la afya ya akili wakati fulani. Tambua na uelewe dalili.
Dholuo: 1 kuom ji 3 e piny Kenya biro bedo gi chandruok mar paro e kinde moro. Ng'e gik ma chandogi kendo ing'e kaka ginyalo konyi.

English: MTRH conducts its first Stereotactic Radiosurgery on brain cancer patient
Kiswahili: MTRH yafanya upasuaji wake wa kwanza wa mionzi wa stereotactic kwa mgonjwa wa saratani ya ubongo
Dholuo: MTRH otimo yeng'o mar radiochirurgi mokwongo mar stereotactic kuom jatuwo ma nigi kansa mar obwongo

English: Air pollution fuels lung cancer among non-smokers
Kiswahili: Uchafuzi wa hewa huchochea saratani ya mapafu miongoni mwa wasiovuta sigara
Dholuo: Dhano ma ok madh ndawa bedo gi kansa mar obo nikech muya mochido

English: Polio, BCG vaccines to arrive in June after Gov't releases Ksh.900M
Kiswahili: Chanjo za Polio na BCG zitafika Juni baada ya Serikali kutoa Ksh.900M
Dholuo: Tuwo mar polio, BCG biro chopo e dwe mar auchiel bang' sirkal golo Ksh.900M

English: MoH assures parents of vaccine safety after two children died from polio shot
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahakikishia wazazi usalama wa chanjo baada ya watoto wawili kufariki kutokana na chanjo ya polio
Dholuo: Migawo mar Yath jiwo jonyuol kuom ritruok mar chanjo bang ' nyithindo ariyo tho nikech tuo mar polio

English: Ministry of Health confirms polio vaccines are safe after investigation into recent child deaths
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yathibitisha chanjo za polio ni salama baada ya uchunguzi wa vifo vya watoto hivi karibuni
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth wacho ni chanjo mag tuo mar polio ok nyal kelo hinyruok bang' nonro mosetim kuom nyithindo ma nyocha otho

English: MoH to begin third round of polio vaccination in Mandera, Wajir and Garissa
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya kuanza awamu ya tatu ya chanjo ya polio huko Mandera, Wajir na Garissa
Dholuo: Migawo mar Thieth chako chanjo mar adek mar tuo mar polio e gwenge mag Mandera, Wajir kod Garissa

English: Gov't targets to administer polio vaccine to 7.4 million children below 5 years during the vaccination campaign set to begin on Thursday
Kiswahili: Serikali inalenga kutoa chanjo ya polio kwa watoto milioni 7.4 walio chini ya umri wa miaka 5 wakati wa kampeni ya chanjo inayotarajiwa kuanza Alhamisi
Dholuo: Sirkal oketo chenro mar chiwo chanjo mar polio ne nyithindo milion 7.4 ma hikgi okalo 5 e kinde kampen mar chanjo mabiro chakore Tich Ang'wen

English: Everyone deserves respect and support in their mental health journey. Let's break the stigma and build a world where we prioritize well-being for all.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili heshima na usaidizi katika safari yake ya afya ya akili. Tuvunje unyanyapaa na tujenge ulimwengu ambapo tunaweka kipaumbele ustawi kwa wote.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ka ng'ato onego omi luor kendo oriw lwedo e wuodhe mar rito ngimane mar paro. Weuru walos piny ma ji duto nyalo dakie maber.

English: It's okay not to be okay! There is no health without mental health!
Kiswahili: Ni sawa kutokuwa sawa! Hakuna afya bila afya ya akili!
Dholuo: Ok rach bedo ng'at ma ok ng'at maber! Ngima ok nyal bedo maber ka ok watang' gi tuoche mag paro!

English: FGM is a traumatic experience that leaves a lasting psychological mark & may adversely affect the mental health of the victims
Kiswahili: Ukeketaji ni tukio la kiwewe ambalo huacha alama ya kisaikolojia ya kudumu na linaweza kuathiri vibaya afya ya akili ya waathiriwa.
Dholuo: Tuwo mar FGM en gima kelo lit ahinya e chuny ng'ato kendo mano nyalo ketho paro mar ng'at motimne timno

English: Measles jab drive: Immunization drive to focus on children aged between 9-18 months
Kiswahili: Kichocheo cha chanjo dhidi ya surua: Kichocheo cha chanjo kitalenga watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 9-18
Dholuo: Campaign mar chamo adhola: Campaign mar kano adhola ne nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind dweche 9-18.

English: The ongoing measles-rubella, tetanus vaccination drive enters the fourth day
Kiswahili: Kampeni inayoendelea ya chanjo ya surua-rubela, pepopunda inaingia siku ya nne
Dholuo: Chenro mar chanjo mar measles-rubella, tetanus donjo e odiechieng' mar ang'wen

English: By paying attention to those around you, you might save a life! Prioritising mental health in the workplace is just as crucial for those working from . Mental health challenges can affect anyone; they don't discriminate. Wherever you are working from, taking care of your mental health can improve your productivity and overall happiness. Lets break the stigma and make mental health a priority!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwajali wale walio karibu nawe, unaweza kuokoa maisha! Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili mahali pa kazi ni muhimu vile vile kwa wale wanaofanya kazi kutoka nyumbani. Changamoto za afya ya akili zinaweza kumathiri mtu yeyote; hazibagui. Popote unapofanyia kazi, kutunza afya yako ya akili kunaweza kuboresha uzalishaji wako na furaha yako kwa ujumla. Tuvunje unyanyapaa na tufanye afya ya akili kuwa kipaumbele!
Dholuo: Kuom dewo joma ni machiegni kodi, inyalo reso ngima ng'ato! Keto ngima mar paro obed motelo e kar tich en gima dwarore ahinya ne jogo matiyo e pacho. Chandruoge mag paro nyalo yudo ng'ato ang'ata; ok ginyal yudo ng'at machielo. Kata bed ni itiyo kanye, rito pachi nyalo miyo iti maber kendo ibed mamor. Weuru waketh kido mar wichkuot, kendo wami ngima mar paro obed gimaduong' moloyo!

English: (v) improving market access for the smallholders through better supply chain management. The Vision aims at adding value to our farm and livestock products.
Kiswahili: (v) kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima wadogo kupitia usimamizi bora wa mnyororo wa ugavi. Maono yanalenga kuongeza thamani kwa mazao yetu ya shambani na mifugo.
Dholuo: (v) Timo dongruok ne joma nigi ohala matindo kokalo kuom tiyo gi yore mabeyo mag rito gik moko. Neno no geto medo nengo mar pur gi pith kod yuto marwa.

English: ... Agricultural Resources; Provide Agricultural... Mission â€œTo provide timely support services that increase productivity, value addition and market access for the...
Kiswahili: ... Rasilimali za Kilimo; Kutoa Kilimo... Dhamira â€œKutoa huduma za usaidizi kwa wakati unaofaa zinazoongeza tija, kuongeza thamani na ufikiaji wa soko kwa...
Dholuo: mwandu mag pith chiwo kony e kinde mowinjore makonyo ahinya e medo nyak mar yien, kelo nengo momedore, kendo kelo ohala ne.......

English: ... digital agriculture to facilitate sustainability and cost-efficiency. Is climate-smart agriculture enough? Despite the multiple benefits...
Kiswahili: ... kilimo cha kidijitali ili kurahisisha uendelevu na ufanisi wa gharama. Je, kilimo kinachozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi kinatosha? Licha ya faida nyingi...
Dholuo: ...Pidho ma nya sani okony e loso kod tieko nengo mag chiemo. Be timo pur e bwo chal mar kor lwasi oromo? kata obedo ni nitie ber mang'eny....

English: ... digital financial services, climate-smart agriculture and other digital tools that make agricultural value chains more efficient and inclusive.

Dholuo: Insuarans konyo e chulo gik makelo hinyruok nikech pi, mach, kata yamo mager. Ndikri kar insurance mondo iyud kony e saa masira

English: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizo katika mazingira magumu zinaweza kupata msaada wa pesa taslimu wa serikali wakati wa majanga kupitia mifumo ya pesa za simu.
Dholuo: Joot ma nigi chandruok nyalo yudo kony ma sirkal chiwo e kinde masiche kokalo kuom chenro mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kutambua dalili za kiwewe na kutoa huduma ya kwanza ya kisaikolojia kwa manusura wa majanga.
Dholuo: Puonjri fwenyo chal mar tuwo moro ma ne oyudo ng'ato ka en e masira kendo ikony joma oyudo masira.

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Kiswahili: Wazee wanahitaji mipango maalum ya uokoaji. Tambua walezi na makazi yanayoweza kufikiwa mapema.
Dholuo: Joma hikgi ng'eny onego otim chenro mar wuok e utegi, kendo onego ging'e joma rito nyithindgi kod kuonde dak ma ginyalo dhiye chon.

English: Village loudspeakers, SMS alerts, and radio broadcasts help disseminate disaster warnings quickly.
Kiswahili: Vipaza sauti vya kijijini, arifa za SMS, na matangazo ya redio husaidia kusambaza maonyo ya maafa haraka.
Dholuo: Auja, weche ma ji oroga kokalo kuom SMS, kod nyakalondo konyo e lando siem mag masiche mapiyo.

English: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
Kiswahili: Wanafamilia waliopotea wanaweza kufuatiliwa kupitia majukwaa ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya na mitandao ya kijamii.
Dholuo: Joma olal bang' masira inyalo yud kuonde ma gintie kokalo kuom riwruok mar Kenya Red Cross kod social media.

English: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Simu ya usaidizi ya kitaifa 1195 inapatikana wakati wote ili kutoa msaada wa haraka kwa manusura wa unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia.
Dholuo: namba sime milandoe masich dhaw e kind dichwo gi dhako, en namba 1195 ma yudore e piny mangima.

English: All public health facilities in Kenya offer free medical services for gender-based violence survivors.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyote vya afya vya umma nchini Kenya hutoa huduma za matibabu bila malipo kwa waathiriwa wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
Dholuo: Ute thieth duto mag Kenya chiwo thieth maonge chudo ne joma osetho nikech timbe gero.

English: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.
Kiswahili: Mitandao ya usaidizi wa jamii huwasaidia waathirika kwa kutoa nafasi salama, watu wa kujitolea waliofunzwa, programu za uwezeshaji, na marejeleo yaliyoratibiwa huku ikipa kipaumbele usalama na usiri.
Dholuo: Oganda ma konyo ji konyo joma otony kuom chiwo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie, joma otiego, koda chenro mag konyo ji mondo obed gi teko, kendo gikonyogi e yo mochanore ka giketo weche motudore gi ritruok kod weche mopondo obed motelo.

English: Risk assessment tools help identify individuals at high risk of experiencing or perpetrating violence to enable targeted interventions.
Kiswahili: Zana za tathmini ya hatari husaidia kutambua watu walio katika hatari kubwa ya kupitia au kufanya vurugu ili kuwezesha hatua zinazolengwa.
Dholuo: nonro mag chal mar chandruok konyo e fwenyo joma kale mahundu kod ywarruok mondo omi okonygi yudo kony mowinjore.

English: Strategic communication campaigns promote non-violent norms and responsible media coverage of gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Kampeni za mawasiliano ya kimkakati zinakuza kanuni zisizo za vurugu na uandishi wa habari unaowajibika kuhusu vurugu zinazotokana na jinsia kwenye vyombo vya habari.
Dholuo: Chenro mag tieko ywarruok e kind mon gi chuo onego osir mbaka e wi wechegi

English: High-density informal settlements require community-led safety efforts to reduce violence.
Kiswahili: Makazi yasiyo rasmi yenye msongamano mkubwa yanahitaji juhudi za usalama zinazoongozwa na jamii ili kupunguza vurugu.
Dholuo: Joma odak e mier ma nigi ji mang'eny ahinya dwaro ni ji otim kinda mondo gikony e tieko timbe mahundu.

English: Religious institutions influence community norms. Clergy training and counseling support safe and equitable environments.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za kidini zinaathiri kanuni za jamii. Mafunzo na ushauri nasaha wa makasisi huunga mkono mazingira salama na yenye usawa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mag dinde chiko chike mag oganda. Tiego jotend din kendo chiwo puonj konyo mondo ji obed gi ngima maber.

English: Women living with HIV face increased risks and barriers. Integrated health, counseling, and legal services provide essential support.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanaoishi na VVU wanakabiliwa na hatari na vikwazo vilivyoongezeka. Huduma jumuishi za afya, ushauri nasaha, na sheria hutoa msaada muhimu.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi tuo mar HIV yudo pek mang'eny minyalogeng' gi chik kod chenro marito ngima gi

English: Children experiencing trauma need psychological support available through free counseling services.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaopitia kiwewe wanahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia unaopatikana kupitia huduma za ushauri nasaha bila malipo.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma nigi tuwo mar obwongo dwaro kony ma ginyalo yudo kuom weche mag paro kokalo kuom kony ma onge chudo.

English: Street-connected children require shelters, education, and reintegration programs for safety and development.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaohusiana na mitaa wanahitaji malazi, elimu, na programu za kuwaunganisha tena na jamii kwa ajili ya usalama na maendeleo.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma onge kuonde dak dwaro kuonde dak, somo, koda chenro mag duogo e ngima mar joot mondo gibed gi ritruok kod dongruok.

English: Government and NGOs support orphaned children with essential services. Adoption and foster care follow legal guidelines.
Kiswahili: Serikali na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali huwasaidia watoto yatima kwa huduma muhimu. Uasili na malezi ya watoto wa kambo hufuata miongozo ya kisheria.
Dholuo: Sirkal kod riwruoge maok mag sirkal konyo nyithindo ma nyithi kiye gi tije madwarore.

English: Drought requires special management. Provide minerals, reduce herd size early, and conserve water.
Kiswahili: Ukame unahitaji usimamizi maalum. Toa madini, punguza ukubwa wa kundi mapema, na uhifadhi maji.
Dholuo: Rito dhok ndalo oro dwaro ikruok motedgno, ka tiyo gi pi e yo maber.

English: Internal parasites reduce productivity. Deworm regularly, rotate grazing, and test fecal samples.
Kiswahili: Vimelea vya ndani hupunguza uzalishaji. Ondoa minyoo mara kwa mara, zungusha malisho, na jaribu sampuli za kinyesi.
Dholuo: kute modak ei jamni miyo gibedo gi nyak matin, ti gi yedhe manego kutegi mondo kik gikel midekre.

English: Accurate records improve management. Track births, deaths, treatments, and vaccinations.
Kiswahili: Kumbukumbu sahihi huboresha usimamizi. Fuatilia kuzaliwa, vifo, matibabu, na chanjo.
Dholuo: Ripot moriere mag tuo kata thoo jamni, miyo pith bedo mayot

English: Floods kill animals and spread disease. Move herds to higher ground and disinfect pens after floods.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko huua wanyama na kueneza magonjwa. Huhamisha makundi hadi kwenye maeneo ya juu na kuua vijidudu baada ya mafuriko.
Dholuo: Ataro nego le kendo landonegi tuoche, kendo gologi e wi lowo kendo giduogo gi tuoche bang' ataro.

English: Community policing reduces livestock theft. Share intelligence and support police investigations.
Kiswahili: Polisi jamii hupunguza wizi wa mifugo. Shiriki akili na usaidie uchunguzi wa polisi.
Dholuo: Tiyo kod oganda konyo geng'o kuo mar dhok. Tiuru kod obila e mako jokuo

English: Disaster preparedness reduces losses. Identify evacuation routes and store emergency supplies.
Kiswahili: Utayari wa maafa hupunguza hasara. Tambua njia za uokoaji na uhifadhi vifaa vya dharura.
Dholuo: Bedo moikore ne masiche miyo ji ok lal, kendo dwarore ni ng'ato ong'e yore ma onyalo wuokie e masira kendo okan gik mochuno.

English: Water points attract thieves. Water animals by day and patrol high-risk areas.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya maji huvutia wezi. Wanyama hunyweshwa maji mchana na hulinda maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Dholuo: jomahundu ohero bede kuonde miyo chiaye. Omiyo ter chiaye modho pi odiechieng' kendo uket arita

English: Large gatherings increase theft risks. Supervise herds and coordinate with security agencies.
Kiswahili: Mikusanyiko mikubwa huongeza hatari za wizi. Simamia makundi ya wanyama na uratibu na vyombo vya usalama.
Dholuo: Chokruoge madongo miyo ji bedo gi luoro mar kwalo gik moko

English: Multiple identification methods enhance security. Brands, tags, and microchips support recovery.
Kiswahili: Mbinu nyingi za utambuzi huongeza usalama. Chapa, lebo, na microchips husaidia urejeshaji.
Dholuo: Yo mopogore opogore mag fwenyo chiaye miyo wabedo gi ritruok maber.

English: Faulty electrical systems harm animals. Inspect wiring and test for stray voltage regularly.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya umeme yenye hitilafu huwadhuru wanyama. Kagua nyaya za umeme na ujaribu volteji iliyopotea mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Ka nitie gik ma ok kare ma nyalo miyo le okethre, onego inon gik ma ok ler ma ne nitie kendo item matek mondo ine kabe nitie gik ma nyalo ketho teko mar sitima.

English: Steep water edges trap animals. Install gentle slopes and fence dangerous areas.
Kiswahili: Kingo zenye maji marefu hunasa wanyama. Weka miteremko laini na uzio maeneo hatari.
Dholuo: dho pi mapoth nyalo kiero le ma donje, ket chiel mondo le okal mabor

English: High temperatures reduce productivity. Provide shade, ventilation, and constant water.
Kiswahili: Halijoto ya juu hupunguza uzalishaji. Hutoa kivuli, uingizaji hewa, na maji yasiyobadilika.
Dholuo: liet ma malo duoko yuto mag pith piny

English: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na programu za uwekezaji zinazotangazwa wakati wa mechi za mpira wa miguu kwenye mikondo haramu. Nyingi ni njia za wizi wa data au ulaghai wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi gik ma itiyogo e lando tuke mag futball e yore ma ok kare.

English: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
Kiswahili: "DCI inachunguza mpango bandia wa 'ruzuku ya vijana wanaoanza' unaosambazwa kwenye TikTok na Instagram. Hakuna mpango kama huo unaofadhiliwa na Serikali ya Kenya."
Dholuo: "DCI nono chenro mar miriambo ma yudore e TikTok kod Instagram. onge chenro ma kamano ma sirkal mar Kenya nigo mar chiwo pesa".

English: "Be cautious of business mentorship programs advertised by influencers that ask for hefty registration fees. Many lack legal registration."
Kiswahili: "Kuwa mwangalifu na programu za ushauri wa biashara zinazotangazwa na watu wenye ushawishi wanaoomba ada kubwa za usajili. Nyingi hazina usajili wa kisheria."
Dholuo: "Tang'uru gi chenro mag puonj milande mbui, ka ikwaye pesa mangeny

English: The Judiciary warns of false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Refunds are processed only through court registries
Kiswahili: Mahakama yaonya kuhusu barua za kurejeshewa dhamana za uongo zinazotumwa kwa walalamikaji wasio na uhakika. Marejesho yanashughulikiwa kupitia sajili za mahakama pekee
Dholuo: Bura chiwo siem kuom barupe mag miriambo mag dwoko pesa kuom gowi ma oor ne joma kia kaka kot tiyo

English: "Ministry of Housing has not contracted any agents to collect payments for affordable housing units. Application is done through Boma Yangu portal only."
Kiswahili: "Wizara ya Nyumba haijawapa kazi mawakala wowote wa kukusanya malipo ya nyumba za bei nafuu. Maombi yanafanywa kupitia lango la Boma Yangu pekee."
Dholuo: "Minister of Housing ok osetiyo gi ng'ato moro amora mondo ochul pesa mag ot ma nigi nengo moromo.

English: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."
Kiswahili: "CBK inafahamu kuhusu programu za simu zinazotoza ada za 'kibali cha CRB' mapema. Maombi ya CRB yanashughulikiwa kupitia ofisi zenye leseni pekee."
Dholuo: "CBK ong'eyo ni kuonde mitimoe ohala mag simo, ichulo pesa mag 'CRB clearance' ka pok ochopo.

English: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
Kiswahili: "DCI inathibitisha kukamatwa kwa wawakilishi bandia wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaodai kushirikiana na Mpango wa Chakula Duniani Kaskazini mwa Kenya. Daima thibitisha kupitia usajili rasmi wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali."
Dholuo: "DCI ne omak jomariambo ni tiyo gi riwruoge kaka World Food Programme e piny Kenya.

English: "Wanafunzi wanaombwa wasitumie wasimamizi wasiojulikana kusajili HELB. Maafisa bandia wamekuwa wakichukua pesa wakiahidi kufanikisha mkopo."
Kiswahili: "Wanafunzi wanaombwa wasitumie wasimamizi wasiojulikana kusajili HELB. Maafisa bandia wamekuwa wakichukua pesa wakiahidi mkopo."
Dholuo: Nyithi mbalariany osekwer mondo kik kichom joma gikia e manyo helb, nikech kuo pesa matimore e yorego

English: Communications Authority warns of cloned betting apps circulating on Telegram. Many steal your phone data and banking information
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano yaonya kuhusu programu za kamari zilizotengenezwa kwa njia ya kloni zinazosambaa kwenye Telegram. Nyingi huiba data ya simu yako na taarifa za benki
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Weche Loso Wacho e Wi Weche mag Intanet, chiwo siem ni nitie program mag goyo tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi ma yudore e Telegram.

English: "We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.
Kiswahili: "Tunawasihi Wakenya kuthibitisha ofa za kazi kutoka kwa mashirika ya ndege, hasa Emirates na Qatar Airways. Ulaghai mwingi unaoahidi ajira za viwanja vya ndege umeripotiwa.
Dholuo: "Wakwayo jo Kenya mondo onon tije milando e kambi ndeke kaka Emirates kod Qatar Airways

English: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented
Kiswahili: EACC inachunguza watu wanaojifanya wakaguzi wa wizara wanaoomba rushwa kutoka shule ndogo. Ukaguzi wote umepangwa rasmi na kuandikwa.
Dholuo: EACC nono joma nyiso ni gin jorit-tinda mag sirkal kendo manyo asoya e skunde matindo.

English: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."
Kiswahili: "DCI yaonya dhidi ya matapeli wanaouza 'ardhi bandia ya kanisa' huko Kayole na Ruai. Thibitisha hati za umiliki katika Wizara ya Ardhi kabla ya kufanya malipo yoyote."
Dholuo: "DCI chiwo siem ne joma wuondo ji ma uso 'piny mag kanisa' e Kayole kod Ruai.

English: NSSF alerts contributors to disregard WhatsApp messages claiming there is a special withdrawal window for those over 40. No such provision exists.
Kiswahili: NSSF yawatahadharisha wachangiaji kupuuza jumbe za WhatsApp wakidai kuna dirisha maalum la kujiondoa kwa wale walio na umri wa zaidi ya miaka 40. Hakuna kifungu kama hicho kilichopo.
Dholuo: NSSF okwedo ote miore hatsApp ka giwacho ni nitie thuolo makende mar weyo solro ni jogo ma hikgi oloyo 40.

English: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na programu za uwekezaji zinazotangazwa wakati wa mechi za mpira wa miguu kwenye matangazo haramu. Nyingi ni njia za wizi wa data au ulaghai wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi chenro mag keno ma ilandoga saa tuke e Intanet

English: EACC warns of imposters offering job placements at parastatals for upfront cash. All official job listings are published on PSC and organization websites.
Kiswahili: EACC yaonya kuhusu matapeli wanaotoa nafasi za kazi katika mashirika ya umma kwa pesa taslimu mapema. Orodha zote rasmi za kazi huchapishwa kwenye tovuti za PSC na mashirika.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne joma wuondore ni chiwo tije e sirkal kaluwore gi pesa

English: "People have been sent 'Safaricom refund claim' links that look like the real site. Safaricom does not issue refunds without an official claim form."
Kiswahili: "Watu wametumiwa viungo vya 'Safaricom refund claim' vinavyofanana na tovuti halisi. Safaricom haitoi marejesho bila fomu rasmi ya madai."
Dholuo: ji mangeny oseyudo wach mamiriambo ni safaricom dwoko pesa. Kambi no osekwedo wachno

English: "Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms."
Kiswahili: "Walaghai wanaojifanya waangalizi wa uchaguzi wamekuwa wakiomba pesa kutoka kwa wagombea kwa ajili ya kibali bandia. IEBC haitozi ada kwa fomu za kibali."
Dholuo: "Joma wuondore ni gin jorit mag yiero osebedo ka kwayo joma dwaro yudo rusa mag wuondruok pesa.

English: We advise Kenyans not to share photos of their ID, NHIF or voters card on Facebook job groups. These details are being harvested for fraud
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri Wakenya kutoshiriki picha za vitambulisho vyao, NHIF au kadi za wapiga kura kwenye vikundi vya kazi vya Facebook. Maelezo haya yanakusanywa kwa ajili ya ulaghai.
Dholuo: Wachiwo ne jo Kenya rieko mar weyo keto picha mag ID, NHIF kata kad mar joma oyiero e grup mag tich e Facebook.

English: NSSF has suspended several field agents found collecting cash for 'special processing. NSSF does not charge for fast-tracking services
Kiswahili: NSSF imewasimamisha kazi mawakala kadhaa wa shambani waliopatikana wakikusanya pesa kwa ajili ya 'usindikaji maalum. NSSF haitozi malipo kwa huduma za haraka
Dholuo: NSSF osegolo jotich makwayo pesa kuom jopiny eka migi kony

English: Several students have lost fees to fake school accounts shared on WhatsApp. Always pay school fees through officially designated bank accounts.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi kadhaa wamepoteza karo kutokana na akaunti bandia za shule zinazoshirikiwa kwenye WhatsApp. Lipa karo za shule kila wakati kupitia akaunti za benki zilizoteuliwa rasmi.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mang'eny oselalo osuru nikech gik ma ne giwacho e skul ma ne gin miriambo ma ne gichiwo e WhatsApp.

English: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money."
Kiswahili: Matangazo hayo ya kazi kwa 'mawakala wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaoajiri wahesabuji' bila mahojiano ni ulaghai. Thibitisha na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kabla ya kutuma pesa.
Dholuo: Lendo mag tich michiwo gi NGOs maonge intaviw gin mag miriambo

English: "The Ministry of Agriculture has disowned individuals collecting registration fees for 'subsidized fertilisers. All legitimate lists are displayed at ward offices."
Kiswahili: "Wizara ya Kilimo imewakataa watu wanaokusanya ada za usajili kwa 'mbolea zilizofadhiliwa. Orodha zote halali zinaonyeshwa katika ofisi za kata."
Dholuo: jatend migao mar pur osedagi tim mar chulo pesa eka ji yud mbolea

English: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.
Kiswahili: CBK inawaonya Wakenya dhidi ya kutuma pesa kwa vikundi vya mitandao ya kijamii na kuahidi malipo ya kila wiki kutoka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji. Hizi hazidhibitiwi na ni kinyume cha sheria.
Dholuo: CBK osiemo jo Kenya ni kik gior pesa ne grube mag social media ma singo ni gibiro chulo pesa juma ka juma kuom chenro mag ohala.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a at the Lands Ministry."
Kiswahili: "Taarifa kwa umma: DCI imefunga kampuni ya ulaghai ya mali isiyohamishika inayofanya kazi kwa majina mengi huko Kiambu. Daima fanya utafutaji katika Wizara ya Ardhi."
Dholuo: DCI osemako jomatimo ohand lowo e yo morochore kiambu

English: Fake insurance brokers have been selling invalid motor covers in bus stations. Confirm your insurer through IRA public registry.
Kiswahili: Madalali wa bima bandia wamekuwa wakiuza vifuniko vya magari visivyo halali katika vituo vya mabasi. Thibitisha kampuni yako ya bima kupitia usajili wa umma wa IRA.
Dholuo: Jolok ohala mag miriambo osebedo ka uso inshuarens mag mtoka e stesen mag bas.

English: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imeonya kuhusu wafungaji bandia wa WiFi wanaofanya kazi katika maeneo ya makazi. Thibitisha watoa huduma kupitia orodha iliyoidhinishwa ya CA
Dholuo: Migao mar Fuambo gi keyo osegolo siem kuom jogo ma keto Wi-Fi e ute mag ji.

English: "Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya."
Kiswahili: "Kampeni bandia za kibinadamu zinazotumia picha zilizoibiwa zimeripotiwa kwenye Twitter. Daima thibitisha wafadhili kupitia majukwaa yanayoaminika kama M-Changa au Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya."
Dholuo: "Kampen mag konyo ji ma ok kare ma tiyo gi piche mokwal oseket e twita. Kinde duto tem neno joma golo chiwo kokalo kuom kuonde ma igeno kaka M-Changa kata Red Cross Kenya".

English: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Nairobi, jihadharini na watu wanaodai kutoa mikopo ya biashara ndani ya saa moja. Serikali haina mpango kama huo wa pesa taslimu.
Dholuo: Jood Nairobi, tang'uru gi joma wacho ni gimiyou pesa ohala dichiel.

English: Public warning: There are no County Government jobs offered via agents in town. Anyone asking for a facilitation fee is running a scam.
Kiswahili: Onyo la Umma: Hakuna kazi za Serikali ya Kaunti zinazotolewa kupitia mawakala mjini. Mtu yeyote anayeomba ada ya uwezeshaji anaendesha ulaghai.
Dholuo: Ji duto ong'eyo ni onge tije mag sirkal ma ibiro chiw kokalo kuom agents

English: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."
Kiswahili: "Tunawahimiza Wakenya kuangalia upya uhalali wa shirika lolote lisilo la kiserikali linaloomba michango kupitia malipo ya simu. Mengi yametajwa kwa ulaghai."
Dholuo: "Wakwayo jo Kenya mondo onon ane ni riwruok moro amora mar NGO ma kwayo chiwo kokalo kuom pesa mitimo e yor simo en riwruok mar oganda Nyasaye.

English: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
Kiswahili: Wezesha uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili (2FA) kwa akaunti zote za benki na mitandao ya kijamii.
Dholuo: Bed gadier gi gik moko ariyo (2FA) e wi weche duto mag bengi kod weche mag social media.

English: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari na barua pepe zinazojifanya kuwa zinatoka benki zinazoomba uthibitishaji wa akaunti.
Dholuo: Tang' gi barupe ma nyiso ni gin mag bengi

Kiswahili: Sasisha programu yako ya simu kila mwezi ili kurekebisha udhaifu wa usalama.

English: Check 'Serena_254's' profile to see if it's legit before accepting the friend request.

Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia kompyuta ya mtandao, ondoka baada ya kutumia Gmail yako!

English: Encrypt sensitive files before sharing them online.
Kiswahili: Simba faili nyeti kabla ya kuzishiriki mtandaoni.
Dholuo: ket siri e ndiko mopogore kapok iketogi e Intanet.

English: Verify charities before donating online.Fake fundraisers are common.
Kiswahili: Thibitisha mashirika ya kutoa misaada kabla ya kutoa michango mtandaoni.Michango bandia ni ya kawaida.
Dholuo: Tem ane nono riwruoge ma konyo ji kapok ichiwo kony e Intanet.

English: Secure Wi-Fi with a strong password like 'Jamhuri@1963'.
Kiswahili: Linda Wi-Fi ya nyumbani kwa kutumia nenosiri kali kama 'Jamhuri@1963'.
Dholuo: Ket Wi-Fi mar ot obed motegno ka itiyo gi wach mar sirkal motegno kaka 'Jamhuri@1963'.

English: Turn off your Bluetooth when you're not using it! Others can access your phone.
Kiswahili: Zima Bluetooth yako wakati huitumii! Wengine wanaweza kufikia simu yako.
Dholuo: Geng'i Bluetooth sama ok itiyo kode!

English: Check for ' and a padlock icon before entering payment details online.
Kiswahili: Angalia ' na aikoni ya kufuli kabla ya kuingiza maelezo ya malipo mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Non ane ' kod ranyisi mar kad mar locho kapok idonjo weche midwaro chulo e intanet.

English: If someone says 'I'm with DCI, help me fix your computer', hang up! It's a scam.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atasema 'Niko upande wa DCI, nisaidie kurekebisha kompyuta yako', kata simu! Ni ulaghai.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato owacho ni, 'An e DCI, konya loso kompyuta,' kik iwuo kode

English: Fake DHL parcel alerts are common scams.Verify via official customer service.
Kiswahili: Arifa bandia za vifurushi vya DHL ni ulaghai wa kawaida.Thibitisha kupitia huduma rasmi kwa wateja.
Dholuo: Meseg mag pasel mawuok DHL gin miriambo.

English: Visit rental properties in person. Online listings can be fake.
Kiswahili: Tembelea nyumba za kukodisha ana kwa ana. Orodha za mtandaoni zinaweza kuwa bandia.
Dholuo: Dhi e ute mipango iwuon kapok ichulo

English: Download apps only from official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka kwa maduka rasmi kama vile Google Play au Apple App Store pekee.

English: Enable 'Find My Device' on phones to track them if lost or stolen.
Kiswahili: Washa 'Tafuta Kifaa Changu' kwenye simu ili kuzifuatilia ikiwa zitapotea au kuibiwa.

English: Never share OTPs.Even with 'bank staff'. Legit banks wont ask for them.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usishiriki OTP.Hata na 'wafanyakazi wa benki'. Benki halali hazitaki kuziomba.

Kiswahili: Angalia anwani za watumaji barua pepe kwa makosa ya kuandika kama vile (ulaghai!).

English: Never leave children unattended near water bodies - drowning happens silently.
Kiswahili: Usiwaache watoto bila uangalizi karibu na vyanzo vya maji - kuzama hutokea kimya kimya.
Dholuo: Kik iwe nyithindo obed maonge jorit machiegni gi pi - tho mar pi timore aling' ling'.

English: Install smoke detectors in your for early fire warnings.
Kiswahili: Weka vifaa vya kugundua moshi nyumbani kwako kwa tahadhari za mapema za moto.
Dholuo: Ket masin mar neno iro e odi mondo ing'e ni nitie mach.

English: Learn basic swimming skills - it could save your life or someone else's.
Kiswahili: Jifunze ujuzi wa msingi wa kuogelea - inaweza kuokoa maisha yako au ya mtu mwingine.
Dholuo: Puonjri ng'eyo kaka inyalo goyo abal- inyalo reso ngimani kata ngima ng'at machielo.

English: Put emergency contacts in your phone: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
Kiswahili: Weka anwani za dharura kwenye simu yako: Polisi (999), Ambulensi (911), Zimamoto (990).
Dholuo: Ket nembni ma nyalo konyo e simo: Polis (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).

English: Teach children their full names, parents' contacts, and address.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto majina yao kamili, anwani za wazazi, na anwani ya nyumbani.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo nyingegi duto, nying jonyuolgi, kod kama gidakie.

English: Create a family emergency plan and meeting point for disasters.
Kiswahili: Unda mpango wa dharura wa familia na mahali pa kukutania majanga.
Dholuo: Tim chenro mar rito joodi e kinde masira.

English: Always supervise children when they're using playground equipment.
Kiswahili: Wasimamie watoto kila wakati wanapotumia vifaa vya uwanja wa michezo.
Dholuo: Kinde duto rit nyithindo sama gitugo.

English: Learn the Heimlich maneuver to help someone who's choking.
Kiswahili: Jifunze mbinu ya Heimlich ili kumsaidia mtu anayekabwa koo.
Dholuo: Puonjri timo kaka Heimlich itimo mondo ikony ng'at ma gimoro deyo

English: If you are riding a bodaboda, make sure the driver has a helmet and a reflective jacket.
Kiswahili: Ukiwa unaendesha bodaboda, hakikisha dereva ana kofia ya chuma na koti linaloakisi mwanga.
Dholuo: Kapo ni idwaro riembo bodaboda, tem neno ni dereba nigi osuru kod jaket ma nyiso ni idwaro riembo bodaboda.

English: Always check weather forecasts before planning outdoor activities.
Kiswahili: Daima angalia utabiri wa hali ya hewa kabla ya kupanga shughuli za nje.
Dholuo: Tem neno kaka kor lwasi biro chalo kapok ichano timo gik moko e yor lendo.

English: Make an emergency kit with a flashlight, batteries, first aid, and drinking water.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza kifaa cha dharura chenye tochi, betri, huduma ya kwanza, na maji ya kunywa.
Dholuo: Tim kit moro mar konyruok ma nigi taya, batri, konyruok, kod pi modho.

English: Never drink and drive - even small amounts of alcohol impair judgment.
Kiswahili: Usinywe pombe na kuendesha gari kamwe - hata kiasi kidogo cha pombe hudhoofisha uamuzi.
Dholuo: Kik imadh kong'o kendo kik iriemb mtoka - kata mana kong'o matin nyalo ketho ng'ado bura.

English: Always have an emergency evacuation plan for your workplace.
Kiswahili: Daima uwe na mpango wa dharura wa kuhamisha watu mahali pako pa kazi.
Dholuo: Kinde duto bed gi chenro mar reso kar tich.

English: If you have farms, clearly label fertilizers and pesticides.
Kiswahili: Kama una mashamba, weka lebo wazi kwenye mbolea na dawa za kuua wadudu.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi puothe, ket tong' maler e wi yien kod yedhe mamero.

English: Install waterproof devices on all electrical sockets in the .
Kiswahili: Sakinisha vifaa visivyopitisha maji kwenye soketi zote za umeme nyumbani.
Dholuo: Ket gik ma geng'o pi e pi e ute duto.

English: Always check depth before diving into water - neck injuries can be fatal.
Kiswahili: Daima angalia kina kabla ya kupiga mbizi ndani ya maji - majeraha ya shingo yanaweza kusababisha kifo.
Dholuo: Kinde duto tem ane nono tut pi kapok idonjo e pi nikech pi matut nyalo nego ng'ato.

English: Learn basic first aid for burns, cuts, and choking incidents.
Kiswahili: Jifunze huduma ya msingi ya kwanza kwa matukio ya kuungua, kukatwa, na kusongwa na koo.
Dholuo: Puonjri thieth mokwongo ma nyalo konyo ng'ato owang' kata ka gimoro odeye

English: Emergency contacts are: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
Kiswahili: Watu wa dharura wanaowasiliana nao ni: Polisi (999), Ambulensi (911), Zimamoto (990).

English: Never leave children alone in vehicles - temperatures rise dangerously fast.
Kiswahili: Usiwaache watoto peke yao ndani ya magari - halijoto huongezeka kwa kasi hatari.
Dholuo: Kik iwe nyithindo obed kendgi e mtokni nikech liet medore mapiyo.

English: Always have a working flashlight and extra batteries at .
Kiswahili: Daima uwe na tochi inayofanya kazi na betri za ziada nyumbani.
Dholuo: Kinde duto bed gi taya mar taya kod batri mamoko e odi.

English: Always lock doors and windows when leaving , even for short periods.
Kiswahili: Funga milango na madirisha kila wakati unapoondoka nyumbani, hata kwa muda mfupi.
Dholuo: Kinde duto ilor dhoot koda dirisa sama iwuok e ot, kata mana kuom kinde matin.

English: Install security lights around your property to deter burglars.
Kiswahili: Weka taa za usalama kuzunguka mali yako ili kuzuia wezi.
Dholuo: Ket ler mar sirkal e alwora mar utegi mondo irit jomecho.

English: Join or start a neighborhood watch program in your area.
Kiswahili: Jiunge au anza programu ya ulinzi wa ujirani katika eneo lako.
Dholuo: Bed achiel kuom joma biro rito alwora ma idakie.

English: Take photos of your valuables and record serial numbers for identification.
Kiswahili: Piga picha za vitu vyako vya thamani na uandike nambari za mfululizo kwa ajili ya utambulisho.
Dholuo: Kaw picha mag gik ma nengogi tek kendo ndikgi mondo iyudgo nying.

English: Be cautious about sharing travel plans on social media.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu kushiriki mipango ya usafiri kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.
Dholuo: Bed motang' sama ilando chenro mag wuoth e yoregi mag tudruok.

English: Mark your property with UV pens or engraving to help recovery if stolen.
Kiswahili: Weka alama kwenye mali yako kwa kalamu za UV au mchoro ili kusaidia kurejesha ikiwa imeibiwa.
Dholuo: Ket ranyisi mar gik ma in-go gi piche mag UV kata gik ma ondik mondo okonyi yudo gik ma in-go ka owalgi.

English: Install peepholes in exterior doors to identify visitors before opening.
Kiswahili: Weka vizuizi vya macho kwenye milango ya nje ili kuwatambua wageni kabla ya kufungua.
Dholuo: Keturu kuonde ma ji nyalo ng'iyoe dhoot mondo ging'e ka pok giyawo.

English: Park in well-lit areas at night and check surroundings before exiting vehicle.
Kiswahili: Egesha gari katika maeneo yenye mwanga wa kutosha usiku na angalia mazingira kabla ya kutoka.
Dholuo: Par kar dak e alwora ma ler ler nitie gotieno kendo ne kama idakie kapok iwuok e mtoka.

English: Teach domestic staff to verify identities before opening gates/doors.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe wafanyakazi wa majumbani kuthibitisha utambulisho wao kabla ya kufungua malango/milango.
Dholuo: Puonj jotich manie ot mondo onon kitgi kapok giyawo dhoot.

Kiswahili: Thibitisha sifa za wafanyakazi wa huduma kabla ya kuruhusu ufikiaji wa mali.

English: Install security cameras at entry points and make them visible.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha kamera za usalama kwenye sehemu za kuingilia na uzifanye zionekane.
Dholuo: Ket kamera mag sirkal e kuonde ma idonjoe kendo iketgi e yo ma nenore.

English: Be aware of common scams like fake lottery winnings or inheritance claims.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu ulaghai wa kawaida kama vile ushindi bandia wa bahati nasibu au madai ya urithi.
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi timbe mag wuond kaka loso loso loso tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi kata kawo mwandu.

English: Don't resist during armed robbery - your safety is more valuable than property.
Kiswahili: Usipinge wakati wa wizi wa kutumia silaha - usalama wako una thamani zaidi kuliko mali.
Dholuo: Kik ikwed sama ikwalo gimoro gi gige lweny nikech rito ngima ng'ato en gima duong' moloyo mwandu.

English: Shred documents containing personal information before disposal.
Kiswahili: Kata vipande vya hati zenye taarifa binafsi kabla ya kuzitupa.

Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika vita dhidi ya ufisadi. Kuwa sehemu ya suluhisho.

Kiswahili: Rushwa hudhoofisha kaunti. Chukua msimamo! Kudumisha maadili katika utumishi wa umma na kuunga mkono mipango ya kupambana na ufisadi.

Kiswahili: Mchakato wa kujitangaza kiotomatiki sasa unaendelea. Dumisha uadilifu kwa kufuata sheria mtandaoni leo.
Dholuo: Tim mar nyiso ni in ng'at ma ok kare koro tiyo gi thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: Embrace innovation for greater impact. Ethical leadership starts with you.
Kiswahili: Kubali uvumbuzi kwa athari kubwa zaidi. Uongozi wa kimaadili huanza na wewe.
Dholuo: Ti gi lony e timo gik manyien mondo omi ibed gi nyak.

Kiswahili: Hati za upekuzi ni zana za uchunguzi, si kesi za jinai. Tetea sheria, tetea uadilifu.

English: Visit the ASK Eldoret Show and stand with us in the fight against corruption. Together we can safeguard Kenya's future.
Kiswahili: Tembelea Kipindi cha ASK Eldoret na ushirikiane nasi katika mapambano dhidi ya ufisadi. Kwa pamoja tunaweza kulinda mustakabali wa Kenya.

Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika Kaunti ya Nandi: ongeza uelewa, endeleza maadili, na usimame nasi dhidi ya ufisadi.

English: Be cautious of strangers asking for personal or financial information.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya wageni wanaouliza taarifa binafsi au za kifedha.
Dholuo: Tang' gi joma ok ing'eyo ma kwayo ng'ato weche mag ohala.

English: Install window security film to make glass harder to break.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha filamu ya usalama ya dirisha ili kufanya kioo kiwe kigumu kuvunjika.
Dholuo: Ket film mar rito dirisa mondo omi yien obed matek ketho.

English: Don't leave ladders or tools outside that could help burglars gain access.
Kiswahili: Usiache ngazi au vifaa nje ambavyo vinaweza kuwasaidia wezi kupata njia ya kuingia.
Dholuo: Kik iwe gik moko ma nyalo konyo jomecho donjo e odno.

English: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wageni wanaotoa msaada usioombwa na ATM au benki.
Dholuo: Tang' gi joma ok ing'eyo ma nyalo konyi tiyo gi gige pesa kata gige bengi.

English: Install motion-activated lights in dark areas around your property.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha taa zinazowezesha mwendo katika maeneo yenye giza karibu na nyumba yako.
Dholuo: Ket ler ma rieny e alwora ma mudho nitie.

English: Don't leave spare keys in obvious places like under doormats or flowerpots.
Kiswahili: Usiache funguo za ziada katika sehemu zinazoonekana wazi kama vile chini ya mikeka ya mlango au vyungu vya maua.

English: We urge citizens to continue volunteering information that will lead to the arrest of Francis Gaitho.
Kiswahili: Tunawasihi raia kuendelea kutoa taarifa za kujitolea zitakazopelekea kukamatwa kwa Francis Gaitho.

Kiswahili: Tuendelee kuchukua jukumu letu katika kuzuia ugaidi kwa kushiriki taarifa kuhusu shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka na mamlaka husika.

Kiswahili: Uvunjifu wa amani, uchochezi, uporaji, na uharibifu wa mali bado ni kinyume cha sheria.

Kiswahili: Usiache vitu vya thamani vikionekana kwenye gari lako unapoegesha gari.

Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya mbinu za 'wizi wa usumbufu' katika maeneo ya umma.

Kiswahili: Usiache pochi au pochi bila mtu yeyote kwenye mikokoteni ya ununuzi au sehemu za umma.
